<<<FILE path="app\.github\workflows\deploy.yaml" type="yaml">>>

name: build and deploy
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Setup Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to DockerHub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: fladx
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: fladx/teachify-backend-new:latest
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to Server via SSH
        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1.2.2
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.SSH_HOST }}
          username: root
          key: ${{ secrets.SSH_KEY }}
          script: |
            cd /root/teachify/dev-teachify
            docker-compose pull
            docker-compose up -d --remove-orphans

<<<FILE path="app\auth-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\auth\client\GoogleOauthClient.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.auth.client

import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonProperty
import org.springframework.core.ParameterizedTypeReference
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders
import org.springframework.http.MediaType
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.util.LinkedMultiValueMap
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient
import ru.teachify.auth.config.google.GoogleOauthConfig

@Component
class GoogleOauthClient(
    private val config: GoogleOauthConfig,
    private val restClient: RestClient
) {

    fun exchangeCode(code: String): Map<String, Any?> {
        val form = LinkedMultiValueMap<String, String>().apply {
            add("code", code)
            add("client_id", config.clientId)
            add("client_secret", config.clientSecret)
            add("redirect_uri", config.redirectUri)
            add("grant_type", "authorization_code")
        }

        val response = restClient.post()
            .uri(config.tokenUri)
            .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_FORM_URLENCODED)
            .body(form)
            .retrieve()
            .toEntity(object : ParameterizedTypeReference<Map<String, Any?>>() {})

        return response.body ?: emptyMap()
    }

    fun fetchUserInfo(accessToken: String): GoogleUserInfoResponse {
        val response = restClient.get()
            .uri("https://openidconnect.googleapis.com/v1/userinfo")
            .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer $accessToken")
            .retrieve()
            .body(GoogleUserInfoResponse::class.java)

        return response ?: throw IllegalStateException("Failed to load Google user info")
    }
}

data class GoogleUserInfoResponse(
    val sub: String,
    val email: String?,
    val name: String?,
    val picture: String?,
    val locale: String?,
    @param:JsonProperty("given_name")
    val givenName: String?,
    @param:JsonProperty("family_name")
    val familyName: String?,
    @param:JsonProperty("email_verified")
    val emailVerified: Boolean?
)

package ru.teachify.auth.config.google

import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationProperties
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration

@Configuration
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = "google.oauth")
class GoogleOauthConfig {
    lateinit var clientId: String
    lateinit var clientSecret: String
    lateinit var redirectUri: String
    var scopes: List<String> = listOf()
    lateinit var authUri: String
    lateinit var tokenUri: String

    fun scopeAsString(): String = scopes.joinToString(" ")
}

<<<FILE path="app\auth-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\auth\service\AuthService.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.auth.service

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.auth.web.dto.*
import ru.teachify.common.domain.error.NotFoundException
import ru.teachify.security.UserProvider
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.web.controller.UserController
import ru.teachify.users.application.usecase.*
import ru.teachify.users.domain.error.CredentialsInvalidException
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*
import javax.crypto.Mac
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec

@Service
class AuthService(
    private val createUserUseCase: CreateUserUseCase,
    private val jwtService: JwtService,
    private val verifyUserCredentialsUseCase: VerifyUserCredentialsUseCase,
    private val userProvider: UserProvider,
    private val getTelegramAccount: GetTelegramAccountUseCase,
    private val createTelegramAccountUseCase: CreateTelegramAccountUseCase,
    private val userController: UserController,
    private val acceptInvitationUseCase: AcceptInvitationUseCase
) {

    @Value("\${telegram.bot.token}")
    lateinit var botToken: String

    @Transactional
    fun register(body: RegisterRequest): TokenResponse {
        val user = createUserUseCase.execute(body.email, body.password)
        val token = jwtService.generateAccessToken(user.id)
        return TokenResponse(token)
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    fun login(body: LoginRequest): TokenResponse {
        val userId = verifyUserCredentialsUseCase.execute(body.email, body.password)

        val token = jwtService.generateAccessToken(userId)
        return TokenResponse(token)
    }

    @Transactional
    fun authTelegram(body: TelegramAuthRequest): TokenResponse {
        if (!body.isValid()) {
            throw CredentialsInvalidException()
        }

        lateinit var userId: UUID
        try {
            userId = userProvider.getCurrentUserId()
            userController.getUser(userId)
            try {
                getTelegramAccount.byId(body.id)
            } catch (_: NotFoundException) {
                createTelegramAccountUseCase.execute(
                    CreateTelegramAccountCommand(
                        userId = userId,
                        telegramId = body.id,
                        username = body.username,
                        firstName = body.firstName,
                        lastName = body.lastName
                    )
                )
            }
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            try {
                val tgAccount = getTelegramAccount.byId(body.id)
                userId = tgAccount.userId
            } catch (_: NotFoundException) {
                val newUser = userController.createEmptyUser()
                createTelegramAccountUseCase.execute(
                    CreateTelegramAccountCommand(
                        userId = newUser.id,
                        telegramId = body.id,
                        username = body.username,
                        firstName = body.firstName,
                        lastName = body.lastName
                    )
                )
                userId = newUser.id
            }
        }
        val token = jwtService.generateAccessToken(userId)
        return TokenResponse(token)
    }

    fun TelegramAuthRequest.isValid(maxAgeSeconds: Long = 86400): Boolean {
        val dataMap = listOfNotNull(
            "auth_date=$authDate",
            firstName?.let { "first_name=$it" },
            lastName?.let { "last_name=$it" },
            photoUrl?.let { "photo_url=$it" },
            "id=$id",
            username?.let { "username=$it" }
        ).sorted()

        val dataCheckString = dataMap.joinToString("\n")

        val secretKey = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
            .digest(botToken.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))

        val mac = Mac.getInstance("HmacSHA256")
        mac.init(SecretKeySpec(secretKey, "HmacSHA256"))
        val hmac = mac.doFinal(dataCheckString.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
        val calculatedHash = hmac.joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }

        if (!calculatedHash.equals(hash, ignoreCase = true)) {
            return false
        }

        val now = Instant.now().epochSecond
        return authDate >= now - maxAgeSeconds
    }

    @Transactional
    fun acceptInviteByTelegram(body: AcceptInviteTelegramRequest): TokenResponse {
        if (!body.telegramAuthRequest.isValid()) {
            throw CredentialsInvalidException()
        }

        val user = acceptInvitationUseCase.execute(body.code, null, null)

        createTelegramAccountUseCase.execute(
            CreateTelegramAccountCommand(
                userId = user.id,
                telegramId = body.telegramAuthRequest.id,
                username = body.telegramAuthRequest.username,
                firstName = body.telegramAuthRequest.firstName,
                lastName = body.telegramAuthRequest.lastName
            )
        )

        val token = jwtService.generateAccessToken(user.id)
        return TokenResponse(token)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\auth-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\auth\service\GoogleOauthService.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.auth.service

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import org.springframework.web.util.UriComponentsBuilder
import ru.teachify.auth.client.GoogleOauthClient
import ru.teachify.auth.config.google.GoogleOauthConfig
import ru.teachify.security.UserProvider
import ru.teachify.users.application.usecase.*
import java.util.*

@Service
class GoogleOauthService(
    private val config: GoogleOauthConfig,
    private val googleOauthClient: GoogleOauthClient,
    private val userProvider: UserProvider,
    private val linkGoogleAccountUseCase: LinkGoogleAccountUseCase,
    private val findGoogleAccountByGoogleIdUseCase: FindGoogleAccountByGoogleIdUseCase,
    private val createUserUseCase: CreateUserUseCase,
    private val findUserByEmailUseCase: FindUserByEmailUseCase,
    private val jwtService: JwtService,
    private val stateService: GoogleOauthStateService
) {

    fun buildLink(): String {
        val encodedState = stateService.encode()
        val isUserAuthenticated = tryGetCurrentUserId() != null

        val builder = UriComponentsBuilder.fromUriString(config.authUri)
            .queryParam("client_id", config.clientId)
            .queryParam("redirect_uri", config.redirectUri)
            .queryParam("response_type", "code")
            .queryParam("scope", config.scopeAsString())
            .queryParam("access_type", "offline")
            .queryParam("include_granted_scopes", "true")
            .queryParam("state", encodedState)

        if (isUserAuthenticated) {
            builder.queryParam("prompt", "consent")
        }

        return builder.build()
            .encode()
            .toUriString()
    }

    @Transactional
    fun handleCallback(code: String, state: String?): GoogleOauthResult {
        try {
            stateService.decode(state)

            val tokenMap = googleOauthClient.exchangeCode(code)
            val accessToken = tokenMap["access_token"] as? String
                ?: throw IllegalStateException("No access_token in Google response")
            val refreshToken = tokenMap["refresh_token"] as? String

            val userInfo = googleOauthClient.fetchUserInfo(accessToken)
            val googleId = userInfo.sub
            val email = userInfo.email

            val currentUserId = tryGetCurrentUserId()
            return if (currentUserId != null) {
                handleLinkFlow(currentUserId, googleId, accessToken, refreshToken)
            } else {
                handleAnonymousFlow(googleId, accessToken, refreshToken, email)
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            throw IllegalStateException("Failed to link Google account: ${e.message}", e)
        }
    }

    private fun handleLinkFlow(
        userId: UUID,
        googleId: String,
        accessToken: String,
        refreshToken: String?
    ): GoogleOauthResult {
        val command = LinkGoogleAccountCommand(
            userId = userId,
            googleId = googleId,
            accessToken = accessToken,
            refreshToken = refreshToken
        )
        linkGoogleAccountUseCase.execute(command)
        return GoogleOauthResult.Linked()
    }

    private fun handleAnonymousFlow(
        googleId: String,
        accessToken: String,
        refreshToken: String?,
        email: String?
    ): GoogleOauthResult.Authenticated {
        val existingAccount = findGoogleAccountByGoogleIdUseCase.execute(googleId)
        return if (existingAccount != null) {
            handleExistingAccountLogin(existingAccount, googleId, accessToken, refreshToken)
        } else {
            handleRegisterFlow(googleId, accessToken, refreshToken, email)
        }
    }

    private fun handleExistingAccountLogin(
        existingAccount: ru.teachify.users.domain.model.GoogleAccount,
        googleId: String,
        accessToken: String,
        refreshToken: String?
    ): GoogleOauthResult.Authenticated {
        val command = LinkGoogleAccountCommand(
            userId = existingAccount.userId,
            googleId = googleId,
            accessToken = accessToken,
            refreshToken = refreshToken
        )
        linkGoogleAccountUseCase.execute(command)

        val token = jwtService.generateAccessToken(existingAccount.userId)
        return GoogleOauthResult.Authenticated(token, GoogleOauthPurpose.LOGIN)
    }

    private fun handleRegisterFlow(
        googleId: String,
        accessToken: String,
        refreshToken: String?,
        email: String?
    ): GoogleOauthResult.Authenticated {
        val resolvedEmail = email ?: throw IllegalStateException("Google account does not contain an email address")
        val user = findUserByEmailUseCase.execute(resolvedEmail)
            ?: createUserUseCase.execute(resolvedEmail, null)

        val command = LinkGoogleAccountCommand(
            userId = user.id,
            googleId = googleId,
            accessToken = accessToken,
            refreshToken = refreshToken ?: throw IllegalStateException("No refresh_token in Google response")
        )
        linkGoogleAccountUseCase.execute(command)

        val token = jwtService.generateAccessToken(user.id)
        return GoogleOauthResult.Authenticated(token, GoogleOauthPurpose.REGISTER)
    }

    private fun tryGetCurrentUserId(): UUID? = runCatching { userProvider.getCurrentUserId() }.getOrNull()
}

<<<FILE path="app\auth-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\auth\service\GoogleOauthStateService.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.auth.service

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*
import javax.crypto.Mac
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec

enum class GoogleOauthPurpose {
    LINK,
    REGISTER,
    LOGIN
}

data class GoogleOauthState(
    val nonce: String,
    val issuedAt: Instant
)

sealed interface GoogleOauthResult {
    data class Authenticated(val token: String, val purpose: GoogleOauthPurpose) : GoogleOauthResult
    data class Linked(val purpose: GoogleOauthPurpose = GoogleOauthPurpose.LINK) : GoogleOauthResult
}

@Component
class GoogleOauthStateService(
    @param:Value("\${jwt.secret}")
    private val secret: String
) {

    private val encoder = Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding()
    private val decoder = Base64.getUrlDecoder()

    fun encode(): String {
        val nonce = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val issuedAt = Instant.now().epochSecond
        val payload = listOf(nonce, issuedAt.toString()).joinToString(DELIMITER)
        val payloadBytes = payload.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
        val signature = sign(payloadBytes)
        return encoder.encodeToString(payloadBytes) + SEPARATOR + encoder.encodeToString(signature)
    }

    fun decode(state: String?): GoogleOauthState {
        if (state.isNullOrBlank()) {
            return GoogleOauthState(EMPTY_NONCE, Instant.now())
        }

        val parts = state.split(SEPARATOR)
        if (parts.size != 2) {
            // Р›РµРіР°СЃРё СЃРѕСЃС‚РѕСЏРЅРёРµ Р±РµР· РїРѕРґРїРёСЃРё вЂ” РїСЂРёРЅРёРјР°РµРј, РЅРѕ Р±РµР· nonce
            return GoogleOauthState(state, Instant.now())
        }

        val payloadBytes = runCatching { decoder.decode(parts[0]) }
            .getOrElse { throw IllegalArgumentException("Failed to decode Google OAuth state payload") }
        val providedSignature = runCatching { decoder.decode(parts[1]) }
            .getOrElse { throw IllegalArgumentException("Failed to decode Google OAuth state signature") }
        val expectedSignature = sign(payloadBytes)
        if (!MessageDigest.isEqual(expectedSignature, providedSignature)) {
            throw IllegalArgumentException("Invalid Google OAuth state signature")
        }

        val payload = String(payloadBytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
        val tokens = payload.split(DELIMITER)
        if (tokens.size != 2) {
            throw IllegalArgumentException("Invalid Google OAuth state payload structure")
        }

        val nonce = tokens[0]
        val issuedAtEpoch = tokens[1].toLongOrNull()
            ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Invalid issuedAt value in Google OAuth state")

        return GoogleOauthState(nonce, Instant.ofEpochSecond(issuedAtEpoch))
    }

    private fun sign(payload: ByteArray): ByteArray {
        val mac = Mac.getInstance(HMAC_ALGORITHM)
        val key = SecretKeySpec(secret.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8), HMAC_ALGORITHM)
        mac.init(key)
        return mac.doFinal(payload)
    }

    private companion object {
        const val SEPARATOR = "."
        const val DELIMITER = ":"
        const val HMAC_ALGORITHM = "HmacSHA256"
        const val EMPTY_NONCE = ""
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\auth-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\auth\service\JwtService.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.auth.service

import io.jsonwebtoken.Jwts
import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import ru.teachify.security.JwtSettings
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@Service
class JwtService(
    private val props: JwtSettings
) {
    fun generateAccessToken(userId: UUID): String {
        val now = Instant.now()
        val expiresAt = now.plusSeconds(props.accessTokenTtlMinutes * 60)
        val key = Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(props.secret.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
        return Jwts.builder()
            .subject(userId.toString())
            .issuer(props.issuer)
            .issuedAt(Date.from(now))
            .expiration(Date.from(expiresAt))
            .signWith(key)
            .compact()
    }
}

package ru.teachify.auth.web

import ru.teachify.auth.service.JwtService
import ru.teachify.auth.web.dto.*

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/auth")
class AuthController(
    private val authService: AuthService,
    private val jwtService: JwtService,
) {

    @PostMapping("/register")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    fun register(@Valid @RequestBody body: RegisterRequest): TokenResponse {
        return authService.register(body)
    }

    @PostMapping("/login")
    fun login(@Valid @RequestBody body: LoginRequest): TokenResponse {
        return authService.login(body)
    }

    @PostMapping("/telegram")
    fun authByTelegram(@Valid @RequestBody body: TelegramAuthRequest): TokenResponse {
        return authService.authTelegram(body)
    }

    @PostMapping("/telegram/invite/accept")
    fun acceptInviteByTelegram(@Valid @RequestBody body: AcceptInviteTelegramRequest): TokenResponse {
        return authService.acceptInviteByTelegram(body)
    }
}

package ru.teachify.auth.web

import org.springframework.context.annotation.Profile
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController
import ru.teachify.auth.service.JwtService
import ru.teachify.auth.web.dto.TokenResponse
import ru.teachify.users.application.usecase.CreateUserUseCase
import ru.teachify.users.application.usecase.VerifyUserCredentialsUseCase
import ru.teachify.users.domain.error.CredentialsInvalidException

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/auth/dev")
@Profile("dev")
class DevController(
    private val jwtService: JwtService,
    private val verifyUserCredentialsUseCase: VerifyUserCredentialsUseCase,
    private val createUserUseCase: CreateUserUseCase
) {

    @PostMapping("/login")
    fun autoLogin(): TokenResponse {
        val email = "test@test.ru"
        val password = "12345678"

        try {
            val userId = verifyUserCredentialsUseCase.execute(email, password)
            val token = jwtService.generateAccessToken(userId)
            return TokenResponse(token)
        } catch (e: CredentialsInvalidException) {
            val newUser = createUserUseCase.execute(
                email = email,
                rawPassword = password,
            )
            val token = jwtService.generateAccessToken(newUser.id)
            return TokenResponse(token)
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\auth-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\auth\web\GoogleOauthController.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.auth.web

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
import ru.teachify.auth.service.GoogleOauthResult
import ru.teachify.auth.service.GoogleOauthService
import ru.teachify.auth.web.dto.GoogleOauthCallbackResponse

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/auth/google")
class GoogleOauthController(
    private val oauthService: GoogleOauthService
) {

    @GetMapping("/url")
    fun getUrl(): String {
        val link = oauthService.buildLink()
        return link
    }

    @PostMapping("/callback")
    fun callback(
        @RequestParam code: String,
        @RequestParam(required = false) state: String?
    ): GoogleOauthCallbackResponse {
        return when (val result = oauthService.handleCallback(code, state)) {
            is GoogleOauthResult.Authenticated -> GoogleOauthCallbackResponse(
                status = "authenticated",
                purpose = result.purpose,
                token = result.token
            )
            is GoogleOauthResult.Linked -> GoogleOauthCallbackResponse(
                status = "linked",
                purpose = result.purpose,
                token = null
            )
        }
    }
}

package ru.teachify.auth.service

import io.mockk.every
import io.mockk.mockk
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test
import ru.teachify.auth.web.dto.LoginRequest
import ru.teachify.auth.web.dto.RegisterRequest
import ru.teachify.auth.web.dto.TelegramAuthRequest
import ru.teachify.auth.web.dto.TokenResponse
import ru.teachify.common.domain.error.NotFoundException
import ru.teachify.security.UserProvider
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.web.controller.UserController
import ru.teachify.users.application.usecase.*
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.User
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*
import javax.crypto.Mac
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec

class AuthServiceTest {

    private val createUserUseCase: CreateUserUseCase = mockk()
    private val verifyUserCredentialsUseCase: VerifyUserCredentialsUseCase = mockk()
    private val getTelegramAccountUseCase: GetTelegramAccountUseCase = mockk()
    private val createTelegramAccountUseCase: CreateTelegramAccountUseCase = mockk()
    private val userProvider: UserProvider = mockk()
    private val userController: UserController = mockk()
    private val acceptInvitationUseCase = mockk<AcceptInvitationUseCase>()

    private val jwtService: JwtService = mockk()

    private fun buildService(): AuthService = AuthService(
        createUserUseCase = createUserUseCase,
        jwtService = jwtService,
        verifyUserCredentialsUseCase = verifyUserCredentialsUseCase,
        userProvider = userProvider,
        getTelegramAccount = getTelegramAccountUseCase,
        createTelegramAccountUseCase = createTelegramAccountUseCase,
        userController = userController,
        acceptInvitationUseCase = acceptInvitationUseCase
    ).apply {
        botToken = "TEST_BOT_TOKEN"
    }

    @Test
    fun `register should create user and return token`() {
        val userId = UUID.randomUUID()
        val user = User.fromPersistence(userId, "test@example.com", null, "hash", null, Instant.now())
        every { createUserUseCase.execute("test@example.com", "password123") } returns user
        every { jwtService.generateAccessToken(userId) } returns "token123"

        val response = buildService().register(RegisterRequest(email = "test@example.com", password = "password123"))

        assertEquals("token123", response.token)
    }

    @Test
    fun `login should verify credentials and return token`() {
        val userId = UUID.randomUUID()
        every { verifyUserCredentialsUseCase.execute("test@example.com", "password123") } returns userId
        every { jwtService.generateAccessToken(userId) } returns "token456"

        val response = buildService().login(LoginRequest(email = "test@example.com", password = "password123"))

        assertEquals("token456", response.token)
    }

    @Test
    fun `authTelegram should get or create user and return token`() {
        val currentUserId = UUID.randomUUID()
        val now = Instant.now().epochSecond
        val req = TelegramAuthRequest(
            id = 100L,
            firstName = null,
            lastName = null,
            username = null,
            photoUrl = null,
            authDate = now,
            hash = ""
        )
        val fixed = req.copy(hash = telegramHash("TEST_BOT_TOKEN", req))

        every { userProvider.getCurrentUserId() } returns currentUserId
        every { userController.getUser(currentUserId) } returns mockk(relaxed = true)
        every { getTelegramAccountUseCase.byId(100L) } throws NotFoundException("TelegramAccount", "telegramId=100")
        every { createTelegramAccountUseCase.execute(any()) } returns mockk(relaxed = true)
        every { jwtService.generateAccessToken(currentUserId) } returns "token789"

        val response: TokenResponse = buildService().authTelegram(fixed)

        assertEquals("token789", response.token)
    }

    private fun telegramHash(botToken: String, req: TelegramAuthRequest): String {
        val dataMap = listOfNotNull(
            "auth_date=${req.authDate}",
            req.firstName?.let { "first_name=$it" },
            req.lastName?.let { "last_name=$it" },
            req.photoUrl?.let { "photo_url=$it" },
            "id=${req.id}",
            req.username?.let { "username=$it" }
        ).sorted()

        val dataCheckString = dataMap.joinToString("\n")
        val secretKey = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(botToken.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
        val mac = Mac.getInstance("HmacSHA256")
        mac.init(SecretKeySpec(secretKey, "HmacSHA256"))
        val hmac = mac.doFinal(dataCheckString.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
        return hmac.joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
    }
}

        val uri = URI(url)
        val params = (uri.rawQuery ?: "")
            .split("&")
            .mapNotNull {
                val parts = it.split("=", limit = 2)
                if (parts.size == 2) {
                    parts[0] to URLDecoder.decode(parts[1], StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
                } else null
            }.toMap()

        assertEquals("test_client_id", params["client_id"])
        assertEquals("generated_state", params["state"])
        assertEquals("true", params["include_granted_scopes"])
        assertFalse(params.containsKey("prompt"))

    }

        every { userProvider.getCurrentUserId() } returns userId

        val url = service.buildLink()

        val uri = URI(url)
        val params = uri.query.split("&").associate {
            val parts = it.split("=", limit = 2)

        assertTrue(result is GoogleOauthResult.Linked)
        verify {
            linkUseCase.execute(match {
                it.userId == userId &&
                        it.googleId == "google-sub" &&
                        it.accessToken == "access-token" &&

        val newUserId = UUID.randomUUID()
        val newUser = mockk<User> {
            every { id } returns newUserId
        }

        every { stateService.decode(state) } returns GoogleOauthState("nonce", Instant.now())
        every { oauthClient.exchangeCode("code") } returns mapOf(
            "access_token" to "access-token",
            "refresh_token" to "refresh-token"
        )
        every { oauthClient.fetchUserInfo("access-token") } returns GoogleUserInfoResponse(

            emailVerified = true
        )
        every { findGoogleAccountUseCase.execute("google-sub") } returns null
        every { findUserByEmailUseCase.execute("user@example.com") } returns null
        every { createUserUseCase.execute("user@example.com", null) } returns newUser
        every { linkUseCase.execute(any()) } just Runs
        every { jwtService.generateAccessToken(newUserId) } returns "jwt-token"
        every { userProvider.getCurrentUserId() } throws IllegalStateException("no user")

        val result = service.handleCallback("code", state)

        assertTrue(result is GoogleOauthResult.Authenticated)
        val auth = result as GoogleOauthResult.Authenticated
        assertEquals("jwt-token", auth.token)
        assertEquals(GoogleOauthPurpose.REGISTER, auth.purpose)
        verify { linkUseCase.execute(match { it.userId == newUserId && it.refreshToken == "refresh-token" }) }
    }

    @Test
    fun `handleCallback should log user in when google account exists`() {
        val state = "login_state"
        val existingUserId = UUID.randomUUID()
        val account = mockk<GoogleAccount> {
            every { userId } returns existingUserId
            every { calendarId } returns null
        }

        every { stateService.decode(state) } returns GoogleOauthState("nonce", Instant.now())
        every { oauthClient.exchangeCode("code") } returns mapOf("access_token" to "access-token")
        every { oauthClient.fetchUserInfo("access-token") } returns GoogleUserInfoResponse(
            sub = "google-sub",
            email = "user@example.com",
            name = null,
            picture = null,
            locale = null,
            givenName = null,
            familyName = null,
            emailVerified = true
        )
        every { findGoogleAccountUseCase.execute("google-sub") } returns account
        every { linkUseCase.execute(any()) } just Runs
        every { jwtService.generateAccessToken(existingUserId) } returns "jwt-token"
        every { userProvider.getCurrentUserId() } throws IllegalStateException("no user")

        val result = service.handleCallback("code", state)

        assertTrue(result is GoogleOauthResult.Authenticated)
        val auth = result as GoogleOauthResult.Authenticated
        assertEquals("jwt-token", auth.token)
        assertEquals(GoogleOauthPurpose.LOGIN, auth.purpose)
        verify { linkUseCase.execute(match { it.userId == existingUserId && it.googleId == "google-sub" }) }
    }

    @Test
    fun `handleCallback should throw when access_token missing`() {
        every { stateService.decode(null) } returns GoogleOauthState("n", Instant.now())
        every { oauthClient.exchangeCode("code") } returns emptyMap()
        every { userProvider.getCurrentUserId() } throws IllegalStateException("no user")

        val ex = assertThrows<IllegalStateException> {
            service.handleCallback("code", null)
        }
        assertTrue(ex.message!!.contains("No access_token"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `handleCallback should wrap underlying exceptions`() {
        every { stateService.decode(null) } returns GoogleOauthState("n", Instant.now())
        every { oauthClient.exchangeCode("code") } throws RuntimeException("boom")
        every { userProvider.getCurrentUserId() } throws IllegalStateException("no user")

        val ex = assertThrows<IllegalStateException> {
            service.handleCallback("code", null)
        }
        assertTrue(ex.message!!.contains("Failed to link Google account"))
        assertTrue(ex.cause is RuntimeException)
    }
}

package ru.teachify.auth.service

import io.jsonwebtoken.Jwts
import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test
import ru.teachify.security.JwtSettings
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.util.*

class JwtServiceTest {

    @Test
    fun `generateAccessToken should produce signed JWT with expected claims`() {
        val secret = "a".repeat(64) // HMAC-SHA requires sufficiently long secret
        val props = JwtSettings(
            secret = secret,
            issuer = "teachify-auth-test",
            accessTokenTtlMinutes = 5
        )
        val service = JwtService(props)

        val userId = UUID.randomUUID()
        val token = service.generateAccessToken(userId)

        assertNotNull(token)

        val key = Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(secret.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
        val parsed = Jwts.parser()
            .verifyWith(key)
            .build()
            .parseSignedClaims(token)
            .payload

        assertEquals(userId.toString(), parsed.subject)
        assertEquals(props.issuer, parsed.issuer)
        assertNotNull(parsed.expiration)
        assertNotNull(parsed.issuedAt)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\auth-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\auth\client\GoogleOauthClient.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.auth.client

import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonProperty
import org.springframework.core.ParameterizedTypeReference
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders
import org.springframework.http.MediaType
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.util.LinkedMultiValueMap
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient
import ru.teachify.auth.config.google.GoogleOauthConfig

@Component
class GoogleOauthClient(
    private val config: GoogleOauthConfig,
    private val restClient: RestClient
) {

    fun exchangeCode(code: String): Map<String, Any?> {
        val form = LinkedMultiValueMap<String, String>().apply {
            add("code", code)
            add("client_id", config.clientId)
            add("client_secret", config.clientSecret)
            add("redirect_uri", config.redirectUri)
            add("grant_type", "authorization_code")
        }

        val response = restClient.post()
            .uri(config.tokenUri)
            .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_FORM_URLENCODED)
            .body(form)
            .retrieve()
            .toEntity(object : ParameterizedTypeReference<Map<String, Any?>>() {})

        return response.body ?: emptyMap()
    }

    fun fetchUserInfo(accessToken: String): GoogleUserInfoResponse {
        val response = restClient.get()
            .uri("https://openidconnect.googleapis.com/v1/userinfo")
            .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer $accessToken")
            .retrieve()
            .body(GoogleUserInfoResponse::class.java)

        return response ?: throw IllegalStateException("Failed to load Google user info")
    }
}

data class GoogleUserInfoResponse(
    val sub: String,
    val email: String?,
    val name: String?,
    val picture: String?,
    val locale: String?,
    @param:JsonProperty("given_name")
    val givenName: String?,
    @param:JsonProperty("family_name")
    val familyName: String?,
    @param:JsonProperty("email_verified")
    val emailVerified: Boolean?
)

<<<FILE path="app\auth-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\auth\service\AuthService.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.auth.service

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.auth.web.dto.*
import ru.teachify.common.domain.error.NotFoundException
import ru.teachify.security.UserProvider
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.web.controller.UserController
import ru.teachify.users.application.usecase.*
import ru.teachify.users.domain.error.CredentialsInvalidException
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*
import javax.crypto.Mac
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec

@Service
class AuthService(
    private val createUserUseCase: CreateUserUseCase,
    private val jwtService: JwtService,
    private val verifyUserCredentialsUseCase: VerifyUserCredentialsUseCase,
    private val userProvider: UserProvider,
    private val getTelegramAccount: GetTelegramAccountUseCase,
    private val createTelegramAccountUseCase: CreateTelegramAccountUseCase,
    private val userController: UserController,
    private val acceptInvitationUseCase: AcceptInvitationUseCase
) {

    @Value("\${telegram.bot.token}")
    lateinit var botToken: String

    @Transactional
    fun register(body: RegisterRequest): TokenResponse {
        val user = createUserUseCase.execute(body.email, body.password)
        val token = jwtService.generateAccessToken(user.id)
        return TokenResponse(token)
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    fun login(body: LoginRequest): TokenResponse {
        val userId = verifyUserCredentialsUseCase.execute(body.email, body.password)

        val token = jwtService.generateAccessToken(userId)
        return TokenResponse(token)
    }

    @Transactional
    fun authTelegram(body: TelegramAuthRequest): TokenResponse {
        if (!body.isValid()) {
            throw CredentialsInvalidException()
        }

        lateinit var userId: UUID
        try {
            userId = userProvider.getCurrentUserId()
            userController.getUser(userId)
            try {
                getTelegramAccount.byId(body.id)
            } catch (_: NotFoundException) {
                createTelegramAccountUseCase.execute(
                    CreateTelegramAccountCommand(
                        userId = userId,
                        telegramId = body.id,
                        username = body.username,
                        firstName = body.firstName,
                        lastName = body.lastName
                    )
                )
            }
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            try {
                val tgAccount = getTelegramAccount.byId(body.id)
                userId = tgAccount.userId
            } catch (_: NotFoundException) {
                val newUser = userController.createEmptyUser()
                createTelegramAccountUseCase.execute(
                    CreateTelegramAccountCommand(
                        userId = newUser.id,
                        telegramId = body.id,
                        username = body.username,
                        firstName = body.firstName,
                        lastName = body.lastName
                    )
                )
                userId = newUser.id
            }
        }
        val token = jwtService.generateAccessToken(userId)
        return TokenResponse(token)
    }

    fun TelegramAuthRequest.isValid(maxAgeSeconds: Long = 86400): Boolean {
        val dataMap = listOfNotNull(
            "auth_date=$authDate",
            firstName?.let { "first_name=$it" },
            lastName?.let { "last_name=$it" },
            photoUrl?.let { "photo_url=$it" },
            "id=$id",
            username?.let { "username=$it" }
        ).sorted()

        val dataCheckString = dataMap.joinToString("\n")

        val secretKey = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
            .digest(botToken.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))

        val mac = Mac.getInstance("HmacSHA256")
        mac.init(SecretKeySpec(secretKey, "HmacSHA256"))
        val hmac = mac.doFinal(dataCheckString.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
        val calculatedHash = hmac.joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }

        if (!calculatedHash.equals(hash, ignoreCase = true)) {
            return false
        }

        val now = Instant.now().epochSecond
        return authDate >= now - maxAgeSeconds
    }

    @Transactional
    fun acceptInviteByTelegram(body: AcceptInviteTelegramRequest): TokenResponse {
        if (!body.telegramAuthRequest.isValid()) {
            throw CredentialsInvalidException()
        }

        val user = acceptInvitationUseCase.execute(body.code, null, null)

        createTelegramAccountUseCase.execute(
            CreateTelegramAccountCommand(
                userId = user.id,
                telegramId = body.telegramAuthRequest.id,
                username = body.telegramAuthRequest.username,
                firstName = body.telegramAuthRequest.firstName,
                lastName = body.telegramAuthRequest.lastName
            )
        )

        val token = jwtService.generateAccessToken(user.id)
        return TokenResponse(token)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\auth-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\auth\service\GoogleOauthService.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.auth.service

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import org.springframework.web.util.UriComponentsBuilder
import ru.teachify.auth.client.GoogleOauthClient
import ru.teachify.auth.config.google.GoogleOauthConfig
import ru.teachify.security.UserProvider
import ru.teachify.users.application.usecase.*
import java.util.*

@Service
class GoogleOauthService(
    private val config: GoogleOauthConfig,
    private val googleOauthClient: GoogleOauthClient,
    private val userProvider: UserProvider,
    private val linkGoogleAccountUseCase: LinkGoogleAccountUseCase,
    private val findGoogleAccountByGoogleIdUseCase: FindGoogleAccountByGoogleIdUseCase,
    private val createUserUseCase: CreateUserUseCase,
    private val findUserByEmailUseCase: FindUserByEmailUseCase,
    private val jwtService: JwtService,
    private val stateService: GoogleOauthStateService
) {

    fun buildLink(): String {
        val encodedState = stateService.encode()
        val isUserAuthenticated = tryGetCurrentUserId() != null

        val builder = UriComponentsBuilder.fromUriString(config.authUri)
            .queryParam("client_id", config.clientId)
            .queryParam("redirect_uri", config.redirectUri)
            .queryParam("response_type", "code")
            .queryParam("scope", config.scopeAsString())
            .queryParam("access_type", "offline")
            .queryParam("include_granted_scopes", "true")
            .queryParam("state", encodedState)

        if (isUserAuthenticated) {
            builder.queryParam("prompt", "consent")
        }

        return builder.build()
            .encode()
            .toUriString()
    }

    @Transactional
    fun handleCallback(code: String, state: String?): GoogleOauthResult {
        try {
            stateService.decode(state)

            val tokenMap = googleOauthClient.exchangeCode(code)
            val accessToken = tokenMap["access_token"] as? String
                ?: throw IllegalStateException("No access_token in Google response")
            val refreshToken = tokenMap["refresh_token"] as? String

            val userInfo = googleOauthClient.fetchUserInfo(accessToken)
            val googleId = userInfo.sub
            val email = userInfo.email

            val currentUserId = tryGetCurrentUserId()
            return if (currentUserId != null) {
                handleLinkFlow(currentUserId, googleId, accessToken, refreshToken)
            } else {
                handleAnonymousFlow(googleId, accessToken, refreshToken, email)
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            throw IllegalStateException("Failed to link Google account: ${e.message}", e)
        }
    }

    private fun handleLinkFlow(
        userId: UUID,
        googleId: String,
        accessToken: String,
        refreshToken: String?
    ): GoogleOauthResult {
        val command = LinkGoogleAccountCommand(
            userId = userId,
            googleId = googleId,
            accessToken = accessToken,
            refreshToken = refreshToken
        )
        linkGoogleAccountUseCase.execute(command)
        return GoogleOauthResult.Linked()
    }

    private fun handleAnonymousFlow(
        googleId: String,
        accessToken: String,
        refreshToken: String?,
        email: String?
    ): GoogleOauthResult.Authenticated {
        val existingAccount = findGoogleAccountByGoogleIdUseCase.execute(googleId)
        return if (existingAccount != null) {
            handleExistingAccountLogin(existingAccount, googleId, accessToken, refreshToken)
        } else {
            handleRegisterFlow(googleId, accessToken, refreshToken, email)
        }
    }

    private fun handleExistingAccountLogin(
        existingAccount: ru.teachify.users.domain.model.GoogleAccount,
        googleId: String,
        accessToken: String,
        refreshToken: String?
    ): GoogleOauthResult.Authenticated {
        val command = LinkGoogleAccountCommand(
            userId = existingAccount.userId,
            googleId = googleId,
            accessToken = accessToken,
            refreshToken = refreshToken
        )
        linkGoogleAccountUseCase.execute(command)

        val token = jwtService.generateAccessToken(existingAccount.userId)
        return GoogleOauthResult.Authenticated(token, GoogleOauthPurpose.LOGIN)
    }

    private fun handleRegisterFlow(
        googleId: String,
        accessToken: String,
        refreshToken: String?,
        email: String?
    ): GoogleOauthResult.Authenticated {
        val resolvedEmail = email ?: throw IllegalStateException("Google account does not contain an email address")
        val user = findUserByEmailUseCase.execute(resolvedEmail)
            ?: createUserUseCase.execute(resolvedEmail, null)

        val command = LinkGoogleAccountCommand(
            userId = user.id,
            googleId = googleId,
            accessToken = accessToken,
            refreshToken = refreshToken ?: throw IllegalStateException("No refresh_token in Google response")
        )
        linkGoogleAccountUseCase.execute(command)

        val token = jwtService.generateAccessToken(user.id)
        return GoogleOauthResult.Authenticated(token, GoogleOauthPurpose.REGISTER)
    }

    private fun tryGetCurrentUserId(): UUID? = runCatching { userProvider.getCurrentUserId() }.getOrNull()
}

<<<FILE path="app\auth-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\auth\service\GoogleOauthStateService.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.auth.service

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*
import javax.crypto.Mac
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec

enum class GoogleOauthPurpose {
    LINK,
    REGISTER,
    LOGIN
}

data class GoogleOauthState(
    val nonce: String,
    val issuedAt: Instant
)

sealed interface GoogleOauthResult {
    data class Authenticated(val token: String, val purpose: GoogleOauthPurpose) : GoogleOauthResult
    data class Linked(val purpose: GoogleOauthPurpose = GoogleOauthPurpose.LINK) : GoogleOauthResult
}

@Component
class GoogleOauthStateService(
    @param:Value("\${jwt.secret}")
    private val secret: String
) {

    private val encoder = Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding()
    private val decoder = Base64.getUrlDecoder()

    fun encode(): String {
        val nonce = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val issuedAt = Instant.now().epochSecond
        val payload = listOf(nonce, issuedAt.toString()).joinToString(DELIMITER)
        val payloadBytes = payload.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
        val signature = sign(payloadBytes)
        return encoder.encodeToString(payloadBytes) + SEPARATOR + encoder.encodeToString(signature)
    }

    fun decode(state: String?): GoogleOauthState {
        if (state.isNullOrBlank()) {
            return GoogleOauthState(EMPTY_NONCE, Instant.now())
        }

        val parts = state.split(SEPARATOR)
        if (parts.size != 2) {
            // Р›РµРіР°СЃРё СЃРѕСЃС‚РѕСЏРЅРёРµ Р±РµР· РїРѕРґРїРёСЃРё вЂ” РїСЂРёРЅРёРјР°РµРј, РЅРѕ Р±РµР· nonce
            return GoogleOauthState(state, Instant.now())
        }

        val payloadBytes = runCatching { decoder.decode(parts[0]) }
            .getOrElse { throw IllegalArgumentException("Failed to decode Google OAuth state payload") }
        val providedSignature = runCatching { decoder.decode(parts[1]) }
            .getOrElse { throw IllegalArgumentException("Failed to decode Google OAuth state signature") }
        val expectedSignature = sign(payloadBytes)
        if (!MessageDigest.isEqual(expectedSignature, providedSignature)) {
            throw IllegalArgumentException("Invalid Google OAuth state signature")
        }

        val payload = String(payloadBytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
        val tokens = payload.split(DELIMITER)
        if (tokens.size != 2) {
            throw IllegalArgumentException("Invalid Google OAuth state payload structure")
        }

        val nonce = tokens[0]
        val issuedAtEpoch = tokens[1].toLongOrNull()
            ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Invalid issuedAt value in Google OAuth state")

        return GoogleOauthState(nonce, Instant.ofEpochSecond(issuedAtEpoch))
    }

    private fun sign(payload: ByteArray): ByteArray {
        val mac = Mac.getInstance(HMAC_ALGORITHM)
        val key = SecretKeySpec(secret.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8), HMAC_ALGORITHM)
        mac.init(key)
        return mac.doFinal(payload)
    }

    private companion object {
        const val SEPARATOR = "."
        const val DELIMITER = ":"
        const val HMAC_ALGORITHM = "HmacSHA256"
        const val EMPTY_NONCE = ""
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\auth-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\auth\service\JwtService.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.auth.service

import io.jsonwebtoken.Jwts
import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import ru.teachify.security.JwtSettings
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@Service
class JwtService(
    private val props: JwtSettings
) {
    fun generateAccessToken(userId: UUID): String {
        val now = Instant.now()
        val expiresAt = now.plusSeconds(props.accessTokenTtlMinutes * 60)
        val key = Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(props.secret.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
        return Jwts.builder()
            .subject(userId.toString())
            .issuer(props.issuer)
            .issuedAt(Date.from(now))
            .expiration(Date.from(expiresAt))
            .signWith(key)
            .compact()
    }
}

package ru.teachify.auth.web

package ru.teachify.auth.web

import org.springframework.context.annotation.Profile
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController
import ru.teachify.auth.service.JwtService
import ru.teachify.auth.web.dto.TokenResponse
import ru.teachify.users.application.usecase.CreateUserUseCase
import ru.teachify.users.application.usecase.VerifyUserCredentialsUseCase
import ru.teachify.users.domain.error.CredentialsInvalidException

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/auth/dev")
@Profile("dev")
class DevController(
    private val jwtService: JwtService,
    private val verifyUserCredentialsUseCase: VerifyUserCredentialsUseCase,
    private val createUserUseCase: CreateUserUseCase
) {

    @PostMapping("/login")
    fun autoLogin(): TokenResponse {
        val email = "test@test.ru"
        val password = "12345678"

        try {
            val userId = verifyUserCredentialsUseCase.execute(email, password)
            val token = jwtService.generateAccessToken(userId)
            return TokenResponse(token)
        } catch (e: CredentialsInvalidException) {
            val newUser = createUserUseCase.execute(
                email = email,
                rawPassword = password,
            )
            val token = jwtService.generateAccessToken(newUser.id)
            return TokenResponse(token)
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\auth-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\auth\web\GoogleOauthController.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.auth.web

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
import ru.teachify.auth.service.GoogleOauthResult
import ru.teachify.auth.service.GoogleOauthService
import ru.teachify.auth.web.dto.GoogleOauthCallbackResponse

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/auth/google")
class GoogleOauthController(
    private val oauthService: GoogleOauthService
) {

    @GetMapping("/url")
    fun getUrl(): String {
        val link = oauthService.buildLink()
        return link
    }

    @PostMapping("/callback")
    fun callback(
        @RequestParam code: String,
        @RequestParam(required = false) state: String?
    ): GoogleOauthCallbackResponse {
        return when (val result = oauthService.handleCallback(code, state)) {
            is GoogleOauthResult.Authenticated -> GoogleOauthCallbackResponse(
                status = "authenticated",
                purpose = result.purpose,
                token = result.token
            )
            is GoogleOauthResult.Linked -> GoogleOauthCallbackResponse(
                status = "linked",
                purpose = result.purpose,
                token = null
            )
        }
    }
}

package ru.teachify.auth.service

import io.mockk.every
import io.mockk.mockk
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test
import ru.teachify.auth.web.dto.LoginRequest
import ru.teachify.auth.web.dto.RegisterRequest
import ru.teachify.auth.web.dto.TelegramAuthRequest
import ru.teachify.auth.web.dto.TokenResponse
import ru.teachify.common.domain.error.NotFoundException
import ru.teachify.security.UserProvider
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.web.controller.UserController
import ru.teachify.users.application.usecase.*
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.User
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*
import javax.crypto.Mac
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec

class AuthServiceTest {

    private val createUserUseCase: CreateUserUseCase = mockk()
    private val verifyUserCredentialsUseCase: VerifyUserCredentialsUseCase = mockk()
    private val getTelegramAccountUseCase: GetTelegramAccountUseCase = mockk()
    private val createTelegramAccountUseCase: CreateTelegramAccountUseCase = mockk()
    private val userProvider: UserProvider = mockk()
    private val userController: UserController = mockk()
    private val acceptInvitationUseCase = mockk<AcceptInvitationUseCase>()

    private val jwtService: JwtService = mockk()

    private fun buildService(): AuthService = AuthService(
        createUserUseCase = createUserUseCase,
        jwtService = jwtService,
        verifyUserCredentialsUseCase = verifyUserCredentialsUseCase,
        userProvider = userProvider,
        getTelegramAccount = getTelegramAccountUseCase,
        createTelegramAccountUseCase = createTelegramAccountUseCase,
        userController = userController,
        acceptInvitationUseCase = acceptInvitationUseCase
    ).apply {
        botToken = "TEST_BOT_TOKEN"
    }

    @Test
    fun `register should create user and return token`() {
        val userId = UUID.randomUUID()
        val user = User.fromPersistence(userId, "test@example.com", null, "hash", null, Instant.now())
        every { createUserUseCase.execute("test@example.com", "password123") } returns user
        every { jwtService.generateAccessToken(userId) } returns "token123"

        val response = buildService().register(RegisterRequest(email = "test@example.com", password = "password123"))

        assertEquals("token123", response.token)
    }

    @Test
    fun `login should verify credentials and return token`() {
        val userId = UUID.randomUUID()
        every { verifyUserCredentialsUseCase.execute("test@example.com", "password123") } returns userId
        every { jwtService.generateAccessToken(userId) } returns "token456"

        val response = buildService().login(LoginRequest(email = "test@example.com", password = "password123"))

        assertEquals("token456", response.token)
    }

    @Test
    fun `authTelegram should get or create user and return token`() {
        val currentUserId = UUID.randomUUID()
        val now = Instant.now().epochSecond
        val req = TelegramAuthRequest(
            id = 100L,
            firstName = null,
            lastName = null,
            username = null,
            photoUrl = null,
            authDate = now,
            hash = ""
        )
        val fixed = req.copy(hash = telegramHash("TEST_BOT_TOKEN", req))

        every { userProvider.getCurrentUserId() } returns currentUserId
        every { userController.getUser(currentUserId) } returns mockk(relaxed = true)
        every { getTelegramAccountUseCase.byId(100L) } throws NotFoundException("TelegramAccount", "telegramId=100")
        every { createTelegramAccountUseCase.execute(any()) } returns mockk(relaxed = true)
        every { jwtService.generateAccessToken(currentUserId) } returns "token789"

        val response: TokenResponse = buildService().authTelegram(fixed)

        assertEquals("token789", response.token)
    }

    private fun telegramHash(botToken: String, req: TelegramAuthRequest): String {
        val dataMap = listOfNotNull(
            "auth_date=${req.authDate}",
            req.firstName?.let { "first_name=$it" },
            req.lastName?.let { "last_name=$it" },
            req.photoUrl?.let { "photo_url=$it" },
            "id=${req.id}",
            req.username?.let { "username=$it" }
        ).sorted()

        val dataCheckString = dataMap.joinToString("\n")
        val secretKey = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(botToken.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
        val mac = Mac.getInstance("HmacSHA256")
        mac.init(SecretKeySpec(secretKey, "HmacSHA256"))
        val hmac = mac.doFinal(dataCheckString.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
        return hmac.joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
    }
}

import io.mockk.*

class GoogleOauthServiceTest {

    private lateinit var config: GoogleOauthConfig

    private lateinit var userProvider: UserProvider
    private lateinit var linkUseCase: LinkGoogleAccountUseCase
    private lateinit var findGoogleAccountUseCase: FindGoogleAccountByGoogleIdUseCase
    private lateinit var createUserUseCase: CreateUserUseCase
    private lateinit var findUserByEmailUseCase: FindUserByEmailUseCase
    private lateinit var jwtService: JwtService

        config = mockk()
        oauthClient = mockk()
        userProvider = mockk()
        linkUseCase = mockk()
        findGoogleAccountUseCase = mockk()
        createUserUseCase = mockk()
        findUserByEmailUseCase = mockk()
        jwtService = mockk()
        stateService = mockk()

        service = GoogleOauthService(
            config = config,
            googleOauthClient = oauthClient,
            userProvider = userProvider,
            linkGoogleAccountUseCase = linkUseCase,
            findGoogleAccountByGoogleIdUseCase = findGoogleAccountUseCase,
            createUserUseCase = createUserUseCase,
            findUserByEmailUseCase = findUserByEmailUseCase,
            jwtService = jwtService,
            stateService = stateService
        )

        every { config.authUri } returns "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth"
        every { config.clientId } returns "test_client_id"
        every { config.redirectUri } returns "http://localhost:8080/callback"
        every { config.scopeAsString() } returns "profile email calendar.events calendar"
        every { stateService.encode() } returns "encoded_state"
        every { userProvider.getCurrentUserId() } throws IllegalStateException("no user")
    }

    @Test
    fun `buildLink should include encoded state for anonymous user`() {
        every { stateService.encode() } returns "generated_state"
        every { userProvider.getCurrentUserId() } throws IllegalStateException("no user")

        val url = service.buildLink()

        val uri = URI(url)
        val params = (uri.rawQuery ?: "")
            .split("&")
            .mapNotNull {
                val parts = it.split("=", limit = 2)
                if (parts.size == 2) {
                    parts[0] to URLDecoder.decode(parts[1], StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
                } else null
            }.toMap()

        assertEquals("test_client_id", params["client_id"])
        assertEquals("generated_state", params["state"])
        assertEquals("true", params["include_granted_scopes"])
        assertFalse(params.containsKey("prompt"))
        verify(exactly = 1) { stateService.encode() }
    }

    @Test
    fun `buildLink should request consent when user authenticated`() {
        val userId = UUID.randomUUID()
        every { stateService.encode() } returns "state"
        every { userProvider.getCurrentUserId() } returns userId

        val url = service.buildLink()

        val uri = URI(url)
        val params = uri.query.split("&").associate {
            val parts = it.split("=", limit = 2)
            parts[0] to URLDecoder.decode(parts.getOrElse(1) { "" }, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
        }

        assertEquals("consent", params["prompt"])
    }

    @Test
    fun `handleCallback should link google account for authenticated user`() {
        val state = "link_state"
        val userId = UUID.randomUUID()
        every { stateService.decode(state) } returns GoogleOauthState("nonce", Instant.now())
        every { oauthClient.exchangeCode("code") } returns mapOf(

            "refresh_token" to "refresh-token"

            picture = null,
            locale = null,
            givenName = null,
            familyName = null,
            emailVerified = true
        )
        every { userProvider.getCurrentUserId() } returns userId
        every { linkUseCase.execute(any()) } just Runs

        val result = service.handleCallback("code", state)

        assertTrue(result is GoogleOauthResult.Linked)
        verify {
            linkUseCase.execute(match {
                it.userId == userId &&
                        it.googleId == "google-sub" &&
                        it.accessToken == "access-token" &&

    @Test

        every { stateService.decode(null) } returns GoogleOauthState("n", Instant.now())
        every { oauthClient.exchangeCode("code") } returns emptyMap()
        every { userProvider.getCurrentUserId() } throws IllegalStateException("no user")

        val ex = assertThrows<IllegalStateException> {

        assertTrue(ex.message!!.contains("No access_token"))
    }

    @Test

        every { stateService.decode(null) } returns GoogleOauthState("n", Instant.now())

        assertTrue(ex.cause is RuntimeException)
    }

package ru.teachify.auth.service

import io.jsonwebtoken.Jwts
import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test
import ru.teachify.security.JwtSettings
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.util.*

class JwtServiceTest {

    @Test
    fun `generateAccessToken should produce signed JWT with expected claims`() {
        val secret = "a".repeat(64) // HMAC-SHA requires sufficiently long secret
        val props = JwtSettings(
            secret = secret,
            issuer = "teachify-auth-test",
            accessTokenTtlMinutes = 5
        )
        val service = JwtService(props)

        val userId = UUID.randomUUID()
        val token = service.generateAccessToken(userId)

        assertNotNull(token)

        val key = Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(secret.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
        val parsed = Jwts.parser()
            .verifyWith(key)
            .build()
            .parseSignedClaims(token)
            .payload

        assertEquals(userId.toString(), parsed.subject)
        assertEquals(props.issuer, parsed.issuer)
        assertNotNull(parsed.expiration)
        assertNotNull(parsed.issuedAt)
    }
}

package ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.adapter

import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.entity.AccountEntity
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.entity.ContractAccountEntity
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.mapper.toDomain
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.mapper.toEntity
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.repository.AccountJpaRepository
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.repository.ContractAccountJpaRepository
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.repository.TransactionJpaRepository
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.Account
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.ContractAccount
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.Transaction
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.repository.AccountRepository
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.repository.ContractAccountRepository
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.repository.TransactionRepository
import java.util.*

@Component
class ContractAccountRepositoryAdapter(
    private val repo: ContractAccountJpaRepository
) : AccountRepositoryAdapter<ContractAccount, ContractAccountEntity>(
    jpaRepository = repo,
    toEntity = { it.toEntity() },
    toDomain = { it.toDomain() }
), ContractAccountRepository {

    override fun findByContractId(contractId: UUID): ContractAccount? {
        return repo.findByContractId(contractId)?.toDomain()
    }

    override fun findIdByContractId(contractId: UUID): UUID? {
        return repo.findIdByContractId(contractId)
    }
}

abstract class AccountRepositoryAdapter<D : Account, E : AccountEntity>(
    private val jpaRepository: AccountJpaRepository<E, UUID>,
    private val toEntity: (D) -> E,
    private val toDomain: (E) -> D
) : AccountRepository<D> {

    override fun findById(id: UUID): D? =
        jpaRepository.findById(id).orElse(null)?.let(toDomain)

    override fun save(account: D): D =
        jpaRepository.save(toEntity(account)).let(toDomain)

    override fun findByIdForUpdate(id: UUID): D? =
        jpaRepository.findByIdForUpdate(id)?.let(toDomain)

    override fun findAll(): List<D> =
        jpaRepository.findAll().map(toDomain)
}

@Component
class TransactionRepositoryAdapter(
    private val repo: TransactionJpaRepository
) : TransactionRepository {
    override fun save(tx: Transaction): Transaction = repo.save(tx.toEntity()).toDomain()

    override fun listByAccountId(accountId: UUID, limit: Int): List<Transaction> {
        val page = PageRequest.of(0, limit.coerceAtMost(100)) // cap to prevent huge queries
        return repo.findAllByAccountIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(accountId, page).map { it.toDomain() }
    }

    override fun netAmountByAccountId(accountId: UUID): java.math.BigDecimal {
        return repo.netAmountByAccountId(accountId) ?: java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO
    }
}

package ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.entity

import jakarta.persistence.*
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.TransactionType
import java.math.BigDecimal
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

/**

@Entity
@Table(name = "accounts", schema = "billing")
@Inheritance(strategy = InheritanceType.JOINED)
abstract class AccountEntity(

    @Id
    @Column(name = "id", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    var id: UUID,

    @Column(nullable = false)
    var balance: BigDecimal,

    @Column(name = "created_at", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    var createdAt: Instant,
)

@Entity
@Table(name = "contract_accounts", schema = "billing")
class ContractAccountEntity(
    id: UUID,
    balance: BigDecimal,
    createdAt: Instant,

    @Column(name = "contract_id", nullable = false, unique = true)
    var contractId: UUID,
) : AccountEntity(id, balance, createdAt)

@Entity
@Table(name = "transactions", schema = "billing")
class TransactionEntity(

    @Id
    @Column(name = "id", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    var id: UUID,

    @Column(name = "account_id", nullable = false)
    var accountId: UUID,

    @Column(nullable = false)
    var amount: BigDecimal,

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(nullable = false)
    var type: TransactionType,

    @Column(name = "description")
    var description: String?,

    @Column(name = "created_at", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    var createdAt: Instant
)

package ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.repository

import jakarta.persistence.LockModeType
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Lock
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.entity.AccountEntity
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.entity.ContractAccountEntity
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.entity.TransactionEntity
import java.math.BigDecimal
import java.util.*

interface AccountJpaRepository<E : AccountEntity, ID> : JpaRepository<E, ID> {
    @Lock(LockModeType.PESSIMISTIC_WRITE)
    @Query("select e from #{#entityName} e where e.id = :id")
    fun findByIdForUpdate(id: ID): E?
}

interface ContractAccountJpaRepository : AccountJpaRepository<ContractAccountEntity, UUID> {
    fun findByContractId(contractId: UUID): ContractAccountEntity?

    @Query("select ca.id from ContractAccountEntity ca where ca.contractId = :contractId")
    fun findIdByContractId(contractId: UUID): UUID?
}

interface TransactionJpaRepository : JpaRepository<TransactionEntity, UUID> {
    fun findAllByAccountIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(accountId: UUID, pageable: Pageable): List<TransactionEntity>

    @Query(
        """
        select coalesce(sum(case when t.type = ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.TransactionType.DEPOSIT then t.amount else 0 end), 0)
             - coalesce(sum(case when t.type = ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.TransactionType.CHARGE then t.amount else 0 end), 0)
        from TransactionEntity t
        where t.accountId = :accountId
        """
    )
    fun netAmountByAccountId(accountId: UUID): BigDecimal?
}

package ru.teachify.billing.adapter.web

import jakarta.validation.Valid
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.web.dto.AdjustBalanceRequest
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.web.dto.BaseAccountDto
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.web.dto.TransactionDto
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.web.dto.toDto
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.AdjustBalanceCommand
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.AdjustBalanceUseCase
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.GetContractAccountUseCase
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.GetTransactionUseCase
import java.util.*

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/billing")
class AccountController(
    private val getContractAccount: GetContractAccountUseCase,
    private val adjustBalance: AdjustBalanceUseCase,
    private val transactionUseCase: GetTransactionUseCase
) {

    @PostMapping("/accounts/adjust-balance")
    fun adjustBalance(@Valid @RequestBody req: AdjustBalanceRequest): TransactionDto {
        val command = AdjustBalanceCommand(
            accountId = req.accountId,
            amount = req.amount,
            type = req.type,
            description = req.description
        )
        return adjustBalance.execute(command).toDto()
    }

    @GetMapping("/accounts/{accountId}")
    fun getAccountById(@PathVariable accountId: UUID): BaseAccountDto {
        return getContractAccount.byId(accountId).toDto()
    }


    @GetMapping("/accounts/by-contract/{contractId}")
    fun getAccountByContractId(@PathVariable contractId: UUID): BaseAccountDto {
        return getContractAccount.byContractId(contractId).toDto()
    }

    @GetMapping("/accounts/{accountId}/transactions")
    fun listTransactions(@PathVariable accountId: UUID, @RequestParam limit: Int = 100): List<TransactionDto> {
        return transactionUseCase.allByAccountId(accountId, limit).map {
            it.toDto()
        }
    }
}

package ru.teachify.billing.application.interactor

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.AdjustBalanceCommand
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.AdjustBalanceUseCase
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.GetAccountUseCase
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.GetContractAccountUseCase
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.Account
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.ContractAccount
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.Transaction
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.TransactionType
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.repository.AccountRepository
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.repository.ContractAccountRepository
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.repository.TransactionRepository
import ru.teachify.common.domain.error.NotFoundException
import java.util.*

abstract class AbstractAccountInteractor<D : Account>(
    private val repository: AccountRepository<D>,
) : GetAccountUseCase<D> {

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    override fun byId(id: UUID): D =
        repository.findById(id) ?: throw NotFoundException("Account", "id=$id")

    @Transactional
    override fun byIdForUpdate(id: UUID): D =
        repository.findByIdForUpdate(id) ?: throw NotFoundException("Account", "id=$id")
}

@Service
class GetContractAccountInteractor(
    private val contractAccountRepository: ContractAccountRepository,
) : AbstractAccountInteractor<ContractAccount>(contractAccountRepository), GetContractAccountUseCase {

    override fun byContractId(contractId: UUID): ContractAccount {
        return contractAccountRepository.findByContractId(contractId)
            ?: contractAccountRepository.save(ContractAccount.create(contractId))
    }
}

@Service
class AdjustBalanceInteractor(
    private val accountRepository: ContractAccountRepository,
    private val transactionRepository: TransactionRepository,
    private val getAccount: GetContractAccountUseCase
) : AdjustBalanceUseCase {

    private val logger = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: AdjustBalanceCommand): Transaction {
        var contractAccount = getAccount.byIdForUpdate(command.accountId)

        val tx = Transaction.create(
            accountId = contractAccount.id,
            amount = command.amount,
            type = command.type,
            description = command.description
        )

        contractAccount = when (command.type) {
            TransactionType.DEPOSIT -> contractAccount.deposit(command.amount)
            TransactionType.CHARGE -> contractAccount.charge(command.amount)
        }

        val newTx = transactionRepository.save(tx)
        accountRepository.save(contractAccount)
        logger.info {
            "Adjusted balance for account=${command.accountId}, type=${command.type}, amount=${command.amount}, newBalance=${contractAccount.balance}"
        }
        return newTx
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\billing-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\billing\application\interactor\TransactionInteractors.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.billing.application.interactor

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.GetTransactionUseCase
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.SyncAccountsUseCase
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.SyncResult
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.ContractAccount
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.Transaction
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.repository.ContractAccountRepository
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.repository.TransactionRepository
import java.util.*

@Service
class GetTransactionInteractor(
    private val transactionRepository: TransactionRepository
) : GetTransactionUseCase {
    override fun allByAccountId(
        accountId: UUID,
        limit: Int
    ): List<Transaction> {
        return transactionRepository.listByAccountId(accountId, limit)
    }
}

@Service
class SyncAccountsInteractor(
    private val contractAccountRepository: ContractAccountRepository,
    private val transactionRepository: TransactionRepository,
) : SyncAccountsUseCase {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Transactional
    override fun syncAllAccountsBalances(): SyncResult {
        val accounts = contractAccountRepository.findAll()
        var updated = 0

        accounts.forEach { account ->
            val net = transactionRepository.netAmountByAccountId(account.id)
            if (net != account.balance) {
                val updatedAccount = ContractAccount.fromPersistence(
                    id = account.id,
                    contractId = account.contractId,
                    balance = net,
                    createdAt = account.createdAt
                )
                contractAccountRepository.save(updatedAccount)
                updated++
            }
        }

        log.info { "SyncAccountsInteractor: synced ${accounts.size} accounts, updated=$updated" }
        return SyncResult(totalAccounts = accounts.size, updatedAccounts = updated)
    }
}

import ru.teachify.contract.application.usecase.GetContractUseCase

@Component
class LessonConfirmedListener(
    private val getContract: GetContractUseCase,
    private val adjustBalanceUseCase: AdjustBalanceUseCase,
    private val contractAccountRepository: ContractAccountRepository,
) {

    private val logger = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @EventListener
    @Transactional
    fun onLessonConfirmed(event: LessonCompletedEvent) {

        )
        adjustBalanceUseCase.execute(command)
        logger.info { "Processed LessonConfirmedEvent for lessonId=${event.lessonId}, contractId=${event.contractId}" }
    }
}
