<<<FILE path="app\billing-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\billing\domain\model\Account.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.billing.domain.model

import java.math.BigDecimal
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

sealed interface Account {
    val id: UUID
    val balance: BigDecimal
    val createdAt: Instant

    fun deposit(amount: BigDecimal): Account
    fun charge(amount: BigDecimal): Account
}

abstract class BaseAccount protected constructor(
    override val id: UUID,
    protected val balanceInternal: BigDecimal,
    override val createdAt: Instant
) : Account {

    override val balance: BigDecimal get() = balanceInternal

    override fun deposit(amount: BigDecimal): ContractAccount {
        require(amount > BigDecimal.ZERO) { "Amount must be > 0" }
        return copyWith(balanceInternal + amount)
    }

    override fun charge(amount: BigDecimal): ContractAccount {
        require(amount > BigDecimal.ZERO) { "Amount must be > 0" }
        return copyWith(balanceInternal - amount)
    }

    protected abstract fun copyWith(newBalance: BigDecimal): ContractAccount
}


class ContractAccount private constructor(
    id: UUID,
    val contractId: UUID,
    balance: BigDecimal,
    createdAt: Instant
) : BaseAccount(id, balance, createdAt) {

    override fun copyWith(newBalance: BigDecimal) =
        ContractAccount(id, contractId, newBalance, createdAt)

    companion object {
        fun create(contractId: UUID): ContractAccount =
            ContractAccount(UUID.randomUUID(), contractId, BigDecimal.ZERO, Instant.now())

        fun fromPersistence(id: UUID, contractId: UUID, balance: BigDecimal, createdAt: Instant) =
            ContractAccount(id, contractId, balance, createdAt)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\billing-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\billing\domain\model\Transaction.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.billing.domain.model

import java.math.BigDecimal
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

enum class TransactionType {
    DEPOSIT, CHARGE
}

class Transaction
private constructor(
    val id: UUID,
    val accountId: UUID,
    val amount: BigDecimal,
    val type: TransactionType,
    val description: String?,
    val createdAt: Instant,
) {
    companion object {
        fun create(
            accountId: UUID,
            amount: BigDecimal,
            type: TransactionType,
            description: String?
        ): Transaction {
            require(amount > BigDecimal.ZERO) { "Amount must be greater than 0" }
            val id = UUID.randomUUID()
            val now = Instant.now()
            return Transaction(id, accountId, amount, type, description, now)
        }

        fun fromPersistence(
            id: UUID,
            accountId: UUID,
            amount: BigDecimal,
            type: TransactionType,
            description: String?,
            createdAt: Instant
        ): Transaction {
            return Transaction(id, accountId, amount, type, description, createdAt)
        }
    }
}

package ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.adapter

import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.entity.AccountEntity
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.entity.ContractAccountEntity
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.mapper.toDomain
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.mapper.toEntity
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.repository.AccountJpaRepository
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.repository.ContractAccountJpaRepository
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.repository.TransactionJpaRepository
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.Account
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.ContractAccount
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.Transaction
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.repository.AccountRepository
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.repository.ContractAccountRepository
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.repository.TransactionRepository
import java.util.*

@Component
class ContractAccountRepositoryAdapter(
    private val repo: ContractAccountJpaRepository
) : AccountRepositoryAdapter<ContractAccount, ContractAccountEntity>(
    jpaRepository = repo,
    toEntity = { it.toEntity() },
    toDomain = { it.toDomain() }
), ContractAccountRepository {

    override fun findByContractId(contractId: UUID): ContractAccount? {
        return repo.findByContractId(contractId)?.toDomain()
    }

    override fun findIdByContractId(contractId: UUID): UUID? {
        return repo.findIdByContractId(contractId)
    }
}

abstract class AccountRepositoryAdapter<D : Account, E : AccountEntity>(
    private val jpaRepository: AccountJpaRepository<E, UUID>,
    private val toEntity: (D) -> E,
    private val toDomain: (E) -> D
) : AccountRepository<D> {

    override fun findById(id: UUID): D? =
        jpaRepository.findById(id).orElse(null)?.let(toDomain)

    override fun save(account: D): D =
        jpaRepository.save(toEntity(account)).let(toDomain)

    override fun findByIdForUpdate(id: UUID): D? =
        jpaRepository.findByIdForUpdate(id)?.let(toDomain)

    override fun findAll(): List<D> =
        jpaRepository.findAll().map(toDomain)
}

@Component
class TransactionRepositoryAdapter(
    private val repo: TransactionJpaRepository
) : TransactionRepository {
    override fun save(tx: Transaction): Transaction = repo.save(tx.toEntity()).toDomain()

    override fun listByAccountId(accountId: UUID, limit: Int): List<Transaction> {
        val page = PageRequest.of(0, limit.coerceAtMost(100)) // cap to prevent huge queries
        return repo.findAllByAccountIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(accountId, page).map { it.toDomain() }
    }

    override fun netAmountByAccountId(accountId: UUID): java.math.BigDecimal {
        return repo.netAmountByAccountId(accountId) ?: java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO
    }
}

package ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.repository

import jakarta.persistence.LockModeType
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Lock
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.entity.AccountEntity
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.entity.ContractAccountEntity
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.persistence.entity.TransactionEntity
import java.math.BigDecimal
import java.util.*

interface AccountJpaRepository<E : AccountEntity, ID> : JpaRepository<E, ID> {
    @Lock(LockModeType.PESSIMISTIC_WRITE)
    @Query("select e from #{#entityName} e where e.id = :id")
    fun findByIdForUpdate(id: ID): E?
}

interface ContractAccountJpaRepository : AccountJpaRepository<ContractAccountEntity, UUID> {
    fun findByContractId(contractId: UUID): ContractAccountEntity?

    @Query("select ca.id from ContractAccountEntity ca where ca.contractId = :contractId")
    fun findIdByContractId(contractId: UUID): UUID?
}

interface TransactionJpaRepository : JpaRepository<TransactionEntity, UUID> {
    fun findAllByAccountIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(accountId: UUID, pageable: Pageable): List<TransactionEntity>

    @Query(
        """
        select coalesce(sum(case when t.type = ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.TransactionType.DEPOSIT then t.amount else 0 end), 0)
             - coalesce(sum(case when t.type = ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.TransactionType.CHARGE then t.amount else 0 end), 0)
        from TransactionEntity t
        where t.accountId = :accountId
        """
    )
    fun netAmountByAccountId(accountId: UUID): BigDecimal?
}

package ru.teachify.billing.adapter.web

import jakarta.validation.Valid
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.web.dto.AdjustBalanceRequest
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.web.dto.BaseAccountDto
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.web.dto.TransactionDto
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.web.dto.toDto
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.AdjustBalanceCommand
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.AdjustBalanceUseCase
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.GetContractAccountUseCase
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.GetTransactionUseCase
import java.util.*

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/billing")
class AccountController(
    private val getContractAccount: GetContractAccountUseCase,
    private val adjustBalance: AdjustBalanceUseCase,
    private val transactionUseCase: GetTransactionUseCase
) {

    @PostMapping("/accounts/adjust-balance")
    fun adjustBalance(@Valid @RequestBody req: AdjustBalanceRequest): TransactionDto {
        val command = AdjustBalanceCommand(
            accountId = req.accountId,
            amount = req.amount,
            type = req.type,
            description = req.description
        )
        return adjustBalance.execute(command).toDto()
    }

    @GetMapping("/accounts/{accountId}")
    fun getAccountById(@PathVariable accountId: UUID): BaseAccountDto {
        return getContractAccount.byId(accountId).toDto()
    }


    @GetMapping("/accounts/by-contract/{contractId}")
    fun getAccountByContractId(@PathVariable contractId: UUID): BaseAccountDto {
        return getContractAccount.byContractId(contractId).toDto()
    }

    @GetMapping("/accounts/{accountId}/transactions")
    fun listTransactions(@PathVariable accountId: UUID, @RequestParam limit: Int = 100): List<TransactionDto> {
        return transactionUseCase.allByAccountId(accountId, limit).map {
            it.toDto()
        }
    }
}

package ru.teachify.billing.application.interactor

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.AdjustBalanceCommand
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.AdjustBalanceUseCase
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.GetAccountUseCase
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.GetContractAccountUseCase
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.Account
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.ContractAccount
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.Transaction
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.TransactionType
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.repository.AccountRepository
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.repository.ContractAccountRepository
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.repository.TransactionRepository
import ru.teachify.common.domain.error.NotFoundException
import java.util.*

abstract class AbstractAccountInteractor<D : Account>(
    private val repository: AccountRepository<D>,
) : GetAccountUseCase<D> {

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    override fun byId(id: UUID): D =
        repository.findById(id) ?: throw NotFoundException("Account", "id=$id")

    @Transactional
    override fun byIdForUpdate(id: UUID): D =
        repository.findByIdForUpdate(id) ?: throw NotFoundException("Account", "id=$id")
}

@Service
class GetContractAccountInteractor(
    private val contractAccountRepository: ContractAccountRepository,
) : AbstractAccountInteractor<ContractAccount>(contractAccountRepository), GetContractAccountUseCase {

    override fun byContractId(contractId: UUID): ContractAccount {
        return contractAccountRepository.findByContractId(contractId)
            ?: contractAccountRepository.save(ContractAccount.create(contractId))
    }
}

@Service
class AdjustBalanceInteractor(
    private val accountRepository: ContractAccountRepository,
    private val transactionRepository: TransactionRepository,
    private val getAccount: GetContractAccountUseCase
) : AdjustBalanceUseCase {

    private val logger = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: AdjustBalanceCommand): Transaction {
        var contractAccount = getAccount.byIdForUpdate(command.accountId)

        val tx = Transaction.create(
            accountId = contractAccount.id,
            amount = command.amount,
            type = command.type,
            description = command.description
        )

        contractAccount = when (command.type) {
            TransactionType.DEPOSIT -> contractAccount.deposit(command.amount)
            TransactionType.CHARGE -> contractAccount.charge(command.amount)
        }

        val newTx = transactionRepository.save(tx)
        accountRepository.save(contractAccount)
        logger.info {
            "Adjusted balance for account=${command.accountId}, type=${command.type}, amount=${command.amount}, newBalance=${contractAccount.balance}"
        }
        return newTx
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\billing-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\billing\application\interactor\TransactionInteractors.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.billing.application.interactor

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.GetTransactionUseCase
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.SyncAccountsUseCase
import ru.teachify.billing.application.usecase.SyncResult
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.ContractAccount
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.model.Transaction
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.repository.ContractAccountRepository
import ru.teachify.billing.domain.repository.TransactionRepository
import java.util.*

@Service
class GetTransactionInteractor(
    private val transactionRepository: TransactionRepository
) : GetTransactionUseCase {
    override fun allByAccountId(
        accountId: UUID,
        limit: Int
    ): List<Transaction> {
        return transactionRepository.listByAccountId(accountId, limit)
    }
}

@Service
class SyncAccountsInteractor(
    private val contractAccountRepository: ContractAccountRepository,
    private val transactionRepository: TransactionRepository,
) : SyncAccountsUseCase {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Transactional
    override fun syncAllAccountsBalances(): SyncResult {
        val accounts = contractAccountRepository.findAll()
        var updated = 0

        accounts.forEach { account ->
            val net = transactionRepository.netAmountByAccountId(account.id)
            if (net != account.balance) {
                val updatedAccount = ContractAccount.fromPersistence(
                    id = account.id,
                    contractId = account.contractId,
                    balance = net,
                    createdAt = account.createdAt
                )
                contractAccountRepository.save(updatedAccount)
                updated++
            }
        }

        log.info { "SyncAccountsInteractor: synced ${accounts.size} accounts, updated=$updated" }
        return SyncResult(totalAccounts = accounts.size, updatedAccounts = updated)
    }
}

@Component

    private val adjustBalanceUseCase: AdjustBalanceUseCase,

    private val logger = KotlinLogging.logger {}

        )
        adjustBalanceUseCase.execute(command)
        logger.info { "Processed LessonConfirmedEvent for lessonId=${event.lessonId}, contractId=${event.contractId}" }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\billing-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\billing\domain\model\Account.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.billing.domain.model

import java.math.BigDecimal
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

sealed interface Account {
    val id: UUID
    val balance: BigDecimal
    val createdAt: Instant

    fun deposit(amount: BigDecimal): Account
    fun charge(amount: BigDecimal): Account
}

abstract class BaseAccount protected constructor(
    override val id: UUID,
    protected val balanceInternal: BigDecimal,
    override val createdAt: Instant
) : Account {

    override val balance: BigDecimal get() = balanceInternal

    override fun deposit(amount: BigDecimal): ContractAccount {
        require(amount > BigDecimal.ZERO) { "Amount must be > 0" }
        return copyWith(balanceInternal + amount)
    }

    override fun charge(amount: BigDecimal): ContractAccount {
        require(amount > BigDecimal.ZERO) { "Amount must be > 0" }
        return copyWith(balanceInternal - amount)
    }

    protected abstract fun copyWith(newBalance: BigDecimal): ContractAccount
}


class ContractAccount private constructor(
    id: UUID,
    val contractId: UUID,
    balance: BigDecimal,
    createdAt: Instant
) : BaseAccount(id, balance, createdAt) {

    override fun copyWith(newBalance: BigDecimal) =
        ContractAccount(id, contractId, newBalance, createdAt)

    companion object {
        fun create(contractId: UUID): ContractAccount =
            ContractAccount(UUID.randomUUID(), contractId, BigDecimal.ZERO, Instant.now())

        fun fromPersistence(id: UUID, contractId: UUID, balance: BigDecimal, createdAt: Instant) =
            ContractAccount(id, contractId, balance, createdAt)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\billing-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\billing\domain\model\Transaction.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.billing.domain.model

import java.math.BigDecimal
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

enum class TransactionType {
    DEPOSIT, CHARGE
}

class Transaction
private constructor(
    val id: UUID,
    val accountId: UUID,
    val amount: BigDecimal,
    val type: TransactionType,
    val description: String?,
    val createdAt: Instant,
) {
    companion object {
        fun create(
            accountId: UUID,
            amount: BigDecimal,
            type: TransactionType,
            description: String?
        ): Transaction {
            require(amount > BigDecimal.ZERO) { "Amount must be greater than 0" }
            val id = UUID.randomUUID()
            val now = Instant.now()
            return Transaction(id, accountId, amount, type, description, now)
        }

        fun fromPersistence(
            id: UUID,
            accountId: UUID,
            amount: BigDecimal,
            type: TransactionType,
            description: String?,
            createdAt: Instant
        ): Transaction {
            return Transaction(id, accountId, amount, type, description, createdAt)
        }
    }
}

create schema if not exists billing;
set search_path to billing;

create table if not exists accounts
(
    id         uuid primary key        default gen_random_uuid(),
    balance    numeric(18, 2) not null default 0,
    created_at timestamptz    not null default now()
);

create table if not exists contract_accounts
(
    id          uuid primary key references accounts (id) on delete cascade,
    contract_id uuid unique not null,
    created_at  timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists transactions
(
    id         uuid primary key     default gen_random_uuid(),
    account_id uuid        not null references accounts (id) on delete cascade,
    amount      numeric(18, 2) not null,
    type        text           not null,
    description text,
    created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

package ru.teachify.config

import org.flywaydb.core.Flyway
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.flyway.FlywayMigrationInitializer
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration
import javax.sql.DataSource

@Configuration
class FlywayConfig(
    private val dataSource: DataSource
) {
    @Bean
    fun flywayUsers(): Flyway = Flyway.configure()
        .dataSource(dataSource)
        .schemas("users")
        .defaultSchema("users")
        .locations("classpath:db/migration/users")
        .load()

    @Bean
    fun flywayMigrationInitializerUsers(flywayUsers: Flyway) = FlywayMigrationInitializer(flywayUsers)

    @Bean
    fun flywayContracts(): Flyway = Flyway.configure()
        .dataSource(dataSource)
        .schemas("contracts")
        .defaultSchema("contracts")
        .locations("classpath:db/migration/contracts")
        .load()

    @Bean
    fun flywayMigrationInitializerContracts(flywayContracts: Flyway) = FlywayMigrationInitializer(flywayContracts)

    @Bean
    fun flywayLessons(): Flyway = Flyway.configure()
        .dataSource(dataSource)
        .schemas("lessons")
        .defaultSchema("lessons")
        .locations("classpath:db/migration/lesson")
        .load()

    @Bean
    fun flywayMigrationInitializerLessons(flywayLessons: Flyway) = FlywayMigrationInitializer(flywayLessons)

        .dataSource(dataSource)

<<<FILE path="app\bin\main\ru\teachify\config\RestClientConfig.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.config

import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders
import org.springframework.http.MediaType
import org.springframework.http.client.JdkClientHttpRequestFactory
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient
import ru.teachify.common.security.AuthPropagationInterceptor
import java.net.http.HttpClient

@Configuration
class RestClientConfig {

    @Bean
    fun restClient(
        builder: RestClient.Builder,
        authPropagationInterceptor: AuthPropagationInterceptor
    ): RestClient {
        val jdkFactory = JdkClientHttpRequestFactory(
            HttpClient.newBuilder()
                .version(HttpClient.Version.HTTP_2)
                .build()
        )

        return builder
            .requestFactory(jdkFactory)
            .requestInterceptor(authPropagationInterceptor)
            .defaultHeader(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_TYPE, MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
            .build()
    }

    @Bean("serviceAccountRestClient")
    fun serviceAccountRestClient(builder: RestClient.Builder): RestClient {
        val jdkFactory = JdkClientHttpRequestFactory(
            HttpClient.newBuilder()
                .version(HttpClient.Version.HTTP_2)
                .build()
        )

        return builder
            .requestFactory(jdkFactory)
            .defaultHeader(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_TYPE, MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
            .build()
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\bin\main\ru\teachify\config\SecurityConfig.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.config

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.method.configuration.EnableMethodSecurity
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.configuration.EnableWebSecurity
import org.springframework.security.config.http.SessionCreationPolicy
import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain
import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter
import ru.teachify.security.JwtAuthenticationFilter

@Configuration
@EnableWebSecurity
@EnableMethodSecurity(prePostEnabled = true)
class SecurityConfig {

    @Bean
    fun securityFilterChain(http: HttpSecurity, jwtAuthenticationFilter: JwtAuthenticationFilter): SecurityFilterChain {
        http
            .csrf { it.disable() }
            .sessionManagement { it.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS) }
            .authorizeHttpRequests {
                it
                    .requestMatchers(
                        "/api/auth/**",
                        "/actuator/**",
                        "/swagger-ui/**",
                        "/v3/api-docs/**",
                        "/swagger-ui.html",
                        "/api/invitations/accept",
                        "/api/public/availability-slots/**"
                    )
                    .permitAll()
                    .requestMatchers("/api/internal/**")
                    .hasRole("SERVICE")
                    .requestMatchers("/api/billing/accounts/adjust-balance")
                    .hasAnyRole("SERVICE", "TUTOR")
                    .anyRequest().authenticated()
            }
            .exceptionHandling {
                it.authenticationEntryPoint { _, response, _ ->
                    response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_UNAUTHORIZED)
                }
            }
            .addFilterBefore(jwtAuthenticationFilter, UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter::class.java)
        return http.build()
    }
}

@Component
class SecurityLoggingFilter : OncePerRequestFilter() {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger { }

    override fun doFilterInternal(
        request: HttpServletRequest,
        response: HttpServletResponse,
        filterChain: FilterChain
    ) {
        log.info { "вћЎпёЏ ${request.method} ${request.requestURI} Auth=${request.userPrincipal?.name}" }
        filterChain.doFilter(request, response)
        log.info { "в¬…пёЏ ${response.status} ${request.requestURI}" }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\bin\main\ru\teachify\handler\GlobalExceptionHandler.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.handler

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity
import org.springframework.web.bind.MethodArgumentNotValidException
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice
import org.springframework.web.method.annotation.MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException
import ru.teachify.common.domain.error.DomainException
import ru.teachify.common.domain.error.NotFoundException
import ru.teachify.common.dto.ErrorResponse
import ru.teachify.common.dto.FieldViolation
import ru.teachify.users.domain.error.CredentialsInvalidException

@RestControllerAdvice
class GlobalExceptionHandler {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @ExceptionHandler(NotFoundException::class)
    fun handleNotFound(ex: NotFoundException, request: HttpServletRequest): ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> {
        log.error(ex) { "Not Found: ${ex.message.toString()}" }
        return buildResponse(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, ex, request)
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(CredentialsInvalidException::class)
    fun handleCredentialsInvalid(ex: CredentialsInvalidException, request: HttpServletRequest): ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> {
        log.error(ex) { "Credentials Invalid: ${ex.message.toString()}" }
        return buildResponse(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, ex, request)
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(DomainException::class)
    fun handleDomain(ex: DomainException, request: HttpServletRequest): ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> {
        log.error(ex) { "Domain error: ${ex.message}" }
        return buildResponse(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, ex, request)
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException::class)
    fun handleMethodArgumentNotValid(
        ex: MethodArgumentNotValidException,
        request: HttpServletRequest
    ): ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> {
        val violations = ex.bindingResult.fieldErrors.map {
            FieldViolation(field = it.field, message = it.defaultMessage ?: "Invalid value")
        }
        val body = ErrorResponse(
            code = "VALIDATION_ERROR",
            message = "Validation failed",
            path = request.requestURI,
            fields = violations
        )
        log.error(ex) { "Validation error: ${ex.message}, violations: $violations" }
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST).body(body)
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException::class)
    fun handleTypeMismatch(
        ex: MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException,
        request: HttpServletRequest
    ): ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> {
        val body = ErrorResponse(
            code = "TYPE_MISMATCH",
            message = ex.message,
            path = request.requestURI
        )
        log.error(ex) { "Type mismatch error: ${ex.message}" }
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST).body(body)
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(Exception::class)
    fun handleOther(ex: Exception, request: HttpServletRequest): ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> {
        log.error(ex) { "Unhandled error: ${ex.message}" }
        return buildResponse(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, ex, request, code = "INTERNAL_ERROR")
    }

    private fun buildResponse(
        status: HttpStatus,
        ex: Exception,
        request: HttpServletRequest,
        code: String? = (ex as? DomainException)?.errorCode
    ): ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> {
        val body = ErrorResponse(
            code = code,
            message = ex.message,
            path = request.requestURI
        )
        return ResponseEntity.status(status).body(body)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\bin\main\ru\teachify\web\log\RequestLoggingFilter.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.web.log

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter

@Component
class RequestLoggingFilter : OncePerRequestFilter() {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    override fun doFilterInternal(
        request: HttpServletRequest,
        response: HttpServletResponse,
        filterChain: FilterChain
    ) {
        val method = request.method
        val uri = request.requestURI
        val query = request.queryString?.let { "?$it" } ?: ""
        val ip = request.getHeader("X-Forwarded-For")?.split(',')?.firstOrNull()?.trim()
            ?: request.remoteAddr

        log.debug { "HTTP $method $uri$query from IP=$ip" }

        filterChain.doFilter(request, response)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\bin\test\ru\teachify\security\JwtIntegrationTest.kt" type="kt">>>

 package ru.teachify.security

import io.jsonwebtoken.Jwts
import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys
import org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired
import org.springframework.boot.test.autoconfigure.web.servlet.AutoConfigureMockMvc
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.TestConfiguration
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Primary
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.http.MediaType
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.get
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@SpringBootTest
@AutoConfigureMockMvc
class JwtIntegrationTest @Autowired constructor(
    private val mockMvc: MockMvc,
    private val jwtSettings: JwtSettings
) {

    @TestConfiguration
    class MockRoleResolverConfig {
        @Bean
        @Primary
        fun userRoleResolver(): UserRoleResolver = object : UserRoleResolver {
            override fun resolveRolesForUser(userId: UUID): Set<String> {
                return if (userId.toString().endsWith("1")) setOf("TUTOR") else setOf("STUDENT")
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `tutor role can access tutor endpoint`() {
        val userId = UUID.fromString("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001")
        val token = generateToken(userId)

        val result = mockMvc.get("/api/test-secured/tutor") {
            header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer $token")
            accept = MediaType.TEXT_PLAIN
        }.andReturn()

        assertThat(result.response.status).isEqualTo(HttpStatus.OK.value())
        assertThat(result.response.contentAsString).isEqualTo("ok-tutor")
    }

    @Test
    fun `student role forbidden on tutor endpoint`() {
        val userId = UUID.fromString("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002")
        val token = generateToken(userId)

        val result = mockMvc.get("/api/test-secured/tutor") {
            header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer $token")
            accept = MediaType.TEXT_PLAIN
        }.andReturn()

        assertThat(result.response.status).isEqualTo(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN.value())
    }

    private fun generateToken(userId: UUID): String {
        val now = Date.from(Instant.now())
        val exp = Date.from(Instant.now().plusSeconds(3600))
        val key = Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(jwtSettings.secret.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
        return Jwts.builder()
            .subject(userId.toString())
            .issuer(jwtSettings.issuer)
            .issuedAt(now)
            .expiration(exp)
            .signWith(key)
            .compact()
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\calendar-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\calendar\listener\GoogleAccountLinkListener.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.calendar.listener

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.transaction.event.TransactionalEventListener
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.EnsureGoogleCalendarRequest
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.GoogleCalendarService
import ru.teachify.common.client.UserServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.google.event.GoogleAccountLinkedEvent

@Component
class GoogleAccountLinkListener(
    private val googleCalendarService: GoogleCalendarService,
    private val userServiceClient: UserServiceClient
) {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @TransactionalEventListener
    fun onGoogleAccountLinked(event: GoogleAccountLinkedEvent) {
        if (event.accessToken.isBlank()) {
            log.warn { "Skip Google calendar ensure: empty access token for user=${event.userId}" }
            return
        }

        runCatching {
            val response = googleCalendarService.ensureCalendar(
                EnsureGoogleCalendarRequest(
                    userId = event.userId,
                    accessToken = event.accessToken,
                    refreshToken = event.refreshToken
                )
            )
            userServiceClient.updateGoogleCalendarId(event.userId, response.calendarId)
            log.info {
                "Google calendar ensured for user=${event.userId}, created=${response.created}"
            }
        }.onFailure {
            log.warn(it) { "Failed to ensure Google calendar for user=${event.userId}" }
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\calendar-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\calendar\listener\GoogleAccountUnlinkListener.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.calendar.listener

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.transaction.event.TransactionalEventListener
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.GoogleCalendarCleanupService
import ru.teachify.common.client.LessonServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.google.event.GoogleAccountUnlinkedEvent

@Component
class GoogleAccountUnlinkListener(
    private val cleanupService: GoogleCalendarCleanupService,
    private val lessonServiceClient: LessonServiceClient
) {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @TransactionalEventListener
    fun onGoogleAccountUnlinked(event: GoogleAccountUnlinkedEvent) {
        log.info { "Received unlinked event for user=${event.userId}, removing calendar=${event.calendarId}" }

        runCatching {
            cleanupService.removeCalendar(event.accessToken, null, event.calendarId)
        }.onFailure {
            log.warn(it) { "Failed to remove calendar for user=${event.userId}" }
        }

        runCatching {
            lessonServiceClient.cleanupGoogleEvents(event.userId)
            log.info { "Requested Google events cleanup for user=${event.userId}" }
        }.onFailure {
            log.warn(it) { "Failed to cleanup Google events for user=${event.userId}" }
        }
    }
}

package ru.teachify.calendar.listener

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.context.event.EventListener
import org.springframework.core.task.AsyncTaskExecutor
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.transaction.event.TransactionalEventListener
import ru.teachify.calendar.mapper.toEventRequest
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.GoogleAccessTokenRefresher
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.GoogleLessonEventQueue
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.LessonSyncTask
import ru.teachify.calendar.web.client.GoogleCalendarClient
import ru.teachify.common.client.ContractServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.client.GoogleAccountDto
import ru.teachify.common.client.LessonServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.client.UserServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.lesson.event.LessonCreatedEvent
import ru.teachify.common.lesson.event.LessonDeletedEvent
import ru.teachify.common.lesson.event.LessonUpdatedEvent
import ru.teachify.common.lesson.event.ScheduleLessonsDeletedEvent
import java.util.*

@Component
class GoogleLessonEventListener(
    private val queue: GoogleLessonEventQueue,
    private val contractServiceClient: ContractServiceClient,
    private val userServiceClient: UserServiceClient,
    private val lessonServiceClient: LessonServiceClient,
    private val googleCalendarClient: GoogleCalendarClient,
    private val accessTokenRefresher: GoogleAccessTokenRefresher,
    private val taskExecutor: AsyncTaskExecutor
) {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @TransactionalEventListener
    fun onLessonCreated(event: LessonCreatedEvent) {
        log.info { "Received lesson created event for lesson=${event.lessonId}, contract=${event.contractId}" }

        taskExecutor.execute {
            runCatching {
                val accounts = getLinkedAccountsForContract(event.contractId)
                if (accounts.isEmpty()) {
                    log.debug { "No linked Google calendars to sync for lesson=${event.lessonId}" }
                    return@runCatching
                }

                val tasks = accounts.map { account ->
                    LessonSyncTask(
                        userId = account.userId,
                        event = event
                    )
                }
                queue.enqueueAll(tasks)
            }.onFailure {
                log.warn(it) { "Failed to prepare Google calendar sync tasks for lesson=${event.lessonId}" }
            }
        }
    }

    @TransactionalEventListener
    fun onLessonUpdated(event: LessonUpdatedEvent) {
        log.debug { "Received lesson updated event for lesson=${event.lessonId}" }
        taskExecutor.execute {
            runCatching { handleLessonUpdate(event) }
                .onFailure {
                    log.warn(it) { "Failed to handle Google calendar update for lesson=${event.lessonId}" }
                }
        }
    }

    @EventListener
    fun onLessonDeleted(event: LessonDeletedEvent) {
        log.debug { "Received lesson deleted event for lesson=${event.lessonId}" }
        taskExecutor.execute {
            runCatching { handleLessonDelete(event) }
                .onFailure {
                    log.warn(it) { "Failed to handle Google calendar deletion for lesson=${event.lessonId}" }
                }
        }
    }

    @EventListener
    fun onScheduleLessonsDeleted(event: ScheduleLessonsDeletedEvent) {
        log.info { "Received batch delete event for schedule=${event.scheduleId}, count=${event.items.size}" }
        taskExecutor.execute {
            runCatching { handleScheduleLessonsDelete(event) }
                .onFailure {
                    log.warn(it) { "Failed to handle batch Google calendar deletion for schedule=${event.scheduleId}" }
                }
        }
    }

    private fun handleLessonUpdate(event: LessonUpdatedEvent) {
        val mapping = lessonServiceClient.getGoogleEventMapping(event.lessonId)
        if (mapping == null) {
            log.debug { "No Google event mapping for lesson=${event.lessonId}, skipping update" }
            return
        }

        val studentName = runCatching {
            val contract = contractServiceClient.getContract(event.contractId)
            val profile = userServiceClient.getProfile(contract.clientProfileId)
            profile.displayName
        }.getOrNull()

        val request = event.toEventRequest(studentName)

        getLinkedAccountsForContract(event.contractId).forEach { account ->
            withTokenRefresh(account, "update lesson=${event.lessonId}") { token ->
                googleCalendarClient.updateEvent(token, account.calendarId!!, mapping.googleEventId, request)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun handleLessonDelete(event: LessonDeletedEvent) {
        val mapping = lessonServiceClient.getGoogleEventMapping(event.lessonId)
        if (mapping == null) {
            log.debug { "No Google event mapping for lesson=${event.lessonId}, skipping delete" }
            return
        }

        getLinkedAccountsForContract(event.contractId).forEach { account ->
            withTokenRefresh(account, "delete lesson=${event.lessonId}") { token ->
                googleCalendarClient.deleteEventsBatch(token, account.calendarId!!, listOf(mapping.googleEventId))
            }
        }

        runCatching {
            lessonServiceClient.deleteGoogleEventMapping(event.lessonId)
            log.info { "Deleted Google event mapping for lesson=${event.lessonId}" }
        }.onFailure {
            log.warn(it) { "Failed to delete Google event mapping for lesson=${event.lessonId}" }
        }
    }

    private fun handleScheduleLessonsDelete(event: ScheduleLessonsDeletedEvent) {
        val eventIds = event.items.mapNotNull { it.googleEventId }
        if (eventIds.isEmpty()) {
            log.debug { "No Google events to delete for schedule=${event.scheduleId}" }
            return
        }

        val accounts = getLinkedAccountsForContract(event.contractId)
        if (accounts.isEmpty()) {
            log.debug { "No linked accounts for contract=${event.contractId}, skipping batch delete" }
            return
        }

        accounts.forEach { account ->
            withTokenRefresh(account, "batch delete for schedule=${event.scheduleId}") { token ->
                eventIds.chunked(50).forEach { chunk ->
                    googleCalendarClient.deleteEventsBatch(token, account.calendarId!!, chunk)
                }
            }
        }

        log.info { "Successfully processed batch deletion of ${eventIds.size} events for schedule=${event.scheduleId}" }
    }

    private fun getLinkedAccountsForContract(contractId: UUID): List<GoogleAccountDto> {
        val contract = contractServiceClient.getContract(contractId)
        val profileIds = listOf(contract.performerProfileId)

        return profileIds.mapNotNull { profileId ->
            try {
                val profile = userServiceClient.getProfile(profileId)
                val account = userServiceClient.getGoogleAccount(profile.userId)
                if (account?.calendarId.isNullOrBlank()) null else account
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                log.warn(e) { "Failed to resolve Google account for profile=$profileId" }
                null
            }
        }
    }

    private fun withTokenRefresh(
        account: GoogleAccountDto,
        actionDescription: String,
        action: (String) -> Unit
    ) {
        val userId = account.userId
        val accessToken = account.accessToken

        val firstAttempt = runCatching { action(accessToken) }
        if (firstAttempt.isSuccess) {
            log.debug { "Successfully executed $actionDescription for user=$userId" }
            return
        }

        val refreshToken = account.refreshToken
        if (refreshToken.isNullOrBlank()) {
            log.warn(firstAttempt.exceptionOrNull()) {
                "Failed to $actionDescription for user=$userId: no refresh token available"
            }
            return
        }

        val refreshedToken = accessTokenRefresher.refresh(refreshToken)
        if (refreshedToken.isNullOrBlank()) {
            log.warn(firstAttempt.exceptionOrNull()) {
                "Failed to refresh token for $actionDescription for user=$userId"
            }
            return
        }

        runCatching {
            action(refreshedToken)
            userServiceClient.updateGoogleAccessToken(userId, refreshedToken)
        }.onSuccess {
            log.debug { "Successfully executed $actionDescription for user=$userId after token refresh" }
        }.onFailure {
            log.warn(it) { "Failed to $actionDescription for user=$userId even after refreshing token" }
        }
    }
}

package ru.teachify.calendar.mapper

import ru.teachify.calendar.web.client.GoogleCalendarEventRequest
import ru.teachify.calendar.web.client.GoogleDateTime
import ru.teachify.common.client.LessonDto
import ru.teachify.common.lesson.event.LessonCreatedEvent
import ru.teachify.common.lesson.event.LessonUpdatedEvent
import java.time.Duration
import java.util.*

fun LessonDto.toEventRequest(studentName: String? = null): GoogleCalendarEventRequest {
    return GoogleCalendarEventRequest(
        summary = studentName ?: "Teachify lesson",
        description = buildDescription(id, contractId, scheduleId),
        start = GoogleDateTime(startAt),
        end = GoogleDateTime(startAt.plus(Duration.ofMinutes(durationMinutes)))
    )
}

fun LessonUpdatedEvent.toEventRequest(studentName: String? = null): GoogleCalendarEventRequest {
    return GoogleCalendarEventRequest(
        summary = studentName ?: "Teachify lesson",
        description = buildDescription(lessonId, contractId, scheduleId),
        start = GoogleDateTime(startAt),
        end = GoogleDateTime(startAt.plus(this.duration))
    )
}


fun LessonCreatedEvent.toEventRequest(studentName: String? = null): GoogleCalendarEventRequest {
    return GoogleCalendarEventRequest(
        summary = studentName ?: "Teachify lesson",
        description = buildDescription(lessonId, contractId, scheduleId),
        start = GoogleDateTime(startAt),
        end = GoogleDateTime(startAt.plus(this.duration))
    )
}

private fun buildDescription(lessonId: UUID, contractId: UUID, scheduleId: UUID?): String {
    return buildString {
        append("Lesson ID: ").append(lessonId)
        append("\nContract: ").append(contractId)
        scheduleId?.let { append("\nSchedule: ").append(it) }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\calendar-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\calendar\service\GoogleAccessTokenRefresher.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.calendar.service

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.core.ParameterizedTypeReference
import org.springframework.http.MediaType
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.util.LinkedMultiValueMap
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient
import ru.teachify.calendar.config.GoogleOauthProperties

@Component
class GoogleAccessTokenRefresher(
    private val restClient: RestClient,
    private val oauthProperties: GoogleOauthProperties
) {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    fun refresh(refreshToken: String?): String? {
        if (refreshToken.isNullOrBlank()) {
            return null
        }

        return try {
            val form = LinkedMultiValueMap<String, String>().apply {
                add("client_id", oauthProperties.clientId)
                add("client_secret", oauthProperties.clientSecret)
                add("refresh_token", refreshToken)
                add("grant_type", "refresh_token")
            }

            val response = restClient.post()
                .uri(oauthProperties.tokenUri)
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_FORM_URLENCODED)
                .body(form)
                .retrieve()
                .body(object : ParameterizedTypeReference<Map<String, Any>>() {})

            val token = response?.get("access_token") as? String
            if (token.isNullOrBlank()) {
                log.warn { "Refresh token response did not contain access_token" }
            }
            token
        } catch (ex: Exception) {
            log.warn(ex) { "Failed to refresh Google access token" }
            null
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\calendar-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\calendar\service\GoogleCalendarCleanupService.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.calendar.service

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import ru.teachify.calendar.web.client.GoogleCalendarClient

@Service
class GoogleCalendarCleanupService(
    private val accessTokenRefresher: GoogleAccessTokenRefresher,
    private val googleCalendarClient: GoogleCalendarClient
) {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    fun removeCalendar(accessToken: String?, refreshToken: String?, calendarId: String?) {
        if (calendarId.isNullOrBlank()) {
            return
        }

        var token = accessToken
        if (token.isNullOrBlank()) {
            token = accessTokenRefresher.refresh(refreshToken)
        }

        if (token.isNullOrBlank()) {
            log.warn { "Skip Google calendar deletion for calendarId=$calendarId: no valid access token" }
            return
        }

        val deleted = runCatching {
            googleCalendarClient.deleteCalendar(token, calendarId)
            true
        }.getOrElse {
            log.warn(it) { "Failed to delete Google calendar $calendarId with current token" }
            false
        }

        if (!deleted && !refreshToken.isNullOrBlank()) {
            val refreshedToken = accessTokenRefresher.refresh(refreshToken)
            if (!refreshedToken.isNullOrBlank()) {
                runCatching {
                    googleCalendarClient.deleteCalendar(refreshedToken, calendarId)
                    log.info { "Google calendar deleted after refreshing token: calendarId=$calendarId" }
                }.onFailure {
                    log.warn(it) { "Failed to delete Google calendar $calendarId after refreshing token" }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package ru.teachify.calendar.service

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import ru.teachify.calendar.mapper.toEventRequest
import ru.teachify.calendar.web.client.GoogleCalendarClient
import ru.teachify.common.client.UserServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.lesson.event.LessonUpdatedEvent
import java.util.*

@Service
class GoogleCalendarService(
    private val googleCalendarClient: GoogleCalendarClient,
    private val userServiceClient: UserServiceClient,
    private val lessonSyncService: GoogleLessonSyncService,
    private val cleanupService: GoogleCalendarCleanupService,
    private val accessTokenRefresher: GoogleAccessTokenRefresher
) {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    fun ensureCalendar(request: EnsureGoogleCalendarRequest): EnsureGoogleCalendarResponse {
        val result = googleCalendarClient.ensureCalendar(
            accessToken = request.accessToken,
            summary = TEACHIFY_CALENDAR_SUMMARY,
        )

        lessonSyncService.syncIfNeeded(
            userId = request.userId,
            calendarId = result.calendarId,
            accessToken = request.accessToken,
            created = result.created
        )

        return EnsureGoogleCalendarResponse(
            calendarId = result.calendarId,
            created = result.created
        )
    }

    fun deleteCalendar(request: DeleteGoogleCalendarRequest) {
        cleanupService.removeCalendar(request.accessToken, request.refreshToken, request.calendarId)
    }

    fun updateEvent(
        userId: UUID,
        calendarId: String,
        eventId: String,
        accessToken: String,
        refreshToken: String?,
        event: LessonUpdatedEvent
    ) {
        val request = event.toEventRequest()

        val firstAttempt = runCatching {
            googleCalendarClient.updateEvent(accessToken, calendarId, eventId, request)
        }

        if (firstAttempt.isSuccess) {
            return
        }

        if (refreshToken.isNullOrBlank()) {
            log.warn(firstAttempt.exceptionOrNull()) {
                "Failed to update Google event for lesson=${event.lessonId} without refresh token"
            }
            return
        }

        val refreshedToken = accessTokenRefresher.refresh(refreshToken)
        if (refreshedToken.isNullOrBlank()) {
            log.warn(firstAttempt.exceptionOrNull()) {
                "Failed to refresh token when updating Google event for lesson=${event.lessonId}"
            }
            return
        }

        val secondAttempt = runCatching {
            googleCalendarClient.updateEvent(refreshedToken, calendarId, eventId, request)
        }

        if (secondAttempt.isSuccess) {
            runCatching { userServiceClient.updateGoogleAccessToken(userId, refreshedToken) }
                .onFailure { log.warn(it) { "Failed to persist refreshed token for user=$userId" } }
        } else {
            log.warn(secondAttempt.exceptionOrNull()) {
                "Failed to update Google event for lesson=${event.lessonId} even after refreshing token"
            }
        }
    }

    fun deleteEvent(eventId: String) {

        // РќРѕ СЌС‚Рѕ СЃР»РѕР¶РЅРѕ, РїРѕСЌС‚РѕРјСѓ СѓРїСЂРѕС‰Р°РµРј: РїСЂРѕСЃС‚Рѕ РїС‹С‚Р°РµРјСЃСЏ СѓРґР°Р»РёС‚СЊ С‡РµСЂРµР· batch API
        // Р’ СЂРµР°Р»СЊРЅРѕСЃС‚Рё РЅСѓР¶РЅР° Р±РѕР»РµРµ СЃР»РѕР¶РЅР°СЏ Р»РѕРіРёРєР° СЃ РїРѕРёСЃРєРѕРј РІСЃРµС… Р°РєРєР°СѓРЅС‚РѕРІ
        log.info { "Deleting Google calendar event: eventId=$eventId" }

package ru.teachify.calendar.service

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import ru.teachify.calendar.config.GoogleLessonSyncProperties
import ru.teachify.calendar.mapper.toEventRequest
import ru.teachify.calendar.web.client.GoogleCalendarClient
import ru.teachify.calendar.web.client.GoogleCalendarEventRequest
import ru.teachify.common.client.ContractServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.client.GoogleAccountDto
import ru.teachify.common.client.LessonServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.client.UserServiceClient
import java.util.*

@Service
class GoogleLessonEventProcessor(
    private val queue: GoogleLessonEventQueue,
    private val properties: GoogleLessonSyncProperties,
    private val userServiceClient: UserServiceClient,
    private val googleCalendarClient: GoogleCalendarClient,
    private val lessonServiceClient: LessonServiceClient,
    private val contractServiceClient: ContractServiceClient,
    private val accessTokenRefresher: GoogleAccessTokenRefresher
) {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Scheduled(fixedDelayString = "\${google.calendar.lesson-sync.batch-interval:5s}")
    fun processQueue() {
        val tasks = queue.drain(properties.batchSize)
        if (tasks.isEmpty()) {
            return
        }

        log.debug { "Processing ${tasks.size} Google lesson sync tasks, queueSize=${queue.size()}" }
        tasks.groupBy { it.userId }.forEach { (userId, userTasks) ->
            processUserTasks(userId, userTasks)
        }
    }

    private fun processUserTasks(userId: UUID, tasks: List<LessonSyncTask>) {
        val eligibleTasks = tasks.filter { it.attempt < properties.maxAttempts }
        if (eligibleTasks.isEmpty()) {
            log.warn { "Dropping Google sync tasks for user=$userId: exceeded max attempts (${properties.maxAttempts})" }
            return
        }

        val account = userServiceClient.getGoogleAccount(userId)
        if (account == null || account.calendarId.isNullOrBlank()) {
            log.info { "Skip Google sync for user=$userId: no linked calendar" }
            return
        }

        val distinctTasks = eligibleTasks.distinctBy { it.event.lessonId }

        val contractIds = distinctTasks.map { it.event.contractId }.distinct()
        val studentNames = fetchStudentNames(contractIds)

        val requests = distinctTasks
            .sortedBy { it.event.startAt }
            .map { it.event.toEventRequest(studentNames[it.event.contractId]) }

        if (requests.isEmpty()) {
            return
        }

        val success = sendBatchAndSaveMappings(userId, account, distinctTasks, requests)
        if (success) {
            log.info { "Synchronized ${requests.size} lessons to Google calendar for user=$userId" }
        } else {
            scheduleRetry(distinctTasks)
        }
    }

    private fun fetchStudentNames(contractIds: Collection<UUID>): Map<UUID, String> {
        val result = mutableMapOf<UUID, String>()
        contractIds.forEach { contractId ->
            runCatching {
                val contract = contractServiceClient.getContract(contractId)
                val profile = userServiceClient.getProfile(contract.clientProfileId)
                profile.displayName?.let { result[contractId] = it }
            }.onFailure {
                log.warn(it) { "Failed to resolve student name for contract=$contractId" }
            }
        }
        return result
    }

    private fun sendBatchAndSaveMappings(
        userId: UUID,
        account: GoogleAccountDto,
        tasks: List<LessonSyncTask>,
        requests: List<GoogleCalendarEventRequest>
    ): Boolean {
        val calendarId = account.calendarId ?: return false
        val accessToken = account.accessToken

        val firstAttempt = runCatching {
            val createdEvents = googleCalendarClient.createEventsBatch(accessToken, calendarId, requests)
            saveMappings(tasks, createdEvents)
        }

        if (firstAttempt.isSuccess) {
            return true
        }

        val refreshToken = account.refreshToken
        if (refreshToken.isNullOrBlank()) {
            log.warn(firstAttempt.exceptionOrNull()) {
                "Failed to sync Google calendar for user=$userId without refresh token"
            }
            return false
        }

        val refreshedToken = accessTokenRefresher.refresh(refreshToken)
        if (refreshedToken.isNullOrBlank()) {
            log.warn(firstAttempt.exceptionOrNull()) {
                "Failed to refresh Google access token for user=$userId"
            }
            return false
        }

        val secondAttempt = runCatching {
            val createdEvents = googleCalendarClient.createEventsBatch(refreshedToken, calendarId, requests)
            saveMappings(tasks, createdEvents)
        }

        if (secondAttempt.isSuccess) {
            runCatching { userServiceClient.updateGoogleAccessToken(userId, refreshedToken) }
                .onFailure { log.warn(it) { "Failed to persist refreshed Google access token for user=$userId" } }
            return true
        }

        log.warn(secondAttempt.exceptionOrNull()) {
            "Failed to sync Google calendar for user=$userId even after refreshing token"
        }
        return false
    }

    private fun saveMappings(tasks: List<LessonSyncTask>, createdEvents: Map<Int, String>) {
        createdEvents.forEach { (index, eventId) ->
            val task = tasks.getOrNull(index)
            if (task != null) {
                runCatching {
                    lessonServiceClient.storeGoogleEventMapping(task.event.lessonId, eventId)
                }.onFailure {
                    log.warn(it) { "Failed to save Google event mapping for lesson=${task.event.lessonId}" }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun scheduleRetry(tasks: List<LessonSyncTask>) {
        val retryable = tasks.mapNotNull { task ->
            val next = task.nextAttempt()
            if (next.attempt < properties.maxAttempts) next else null
        }

        if (retryable.isEmpty()) {
            return
        }

        Thread.ofVirtual()
            .name("teachify-calendar-retry-${System.nanoTime()}")
            .start {
                try {
                    Thread.sleep(properties.retryDelay.toMillis())
                } catch (_: InterruptedException) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt()
                }
                queue.enqueueAll(retryable)
                log.info {
                    "Re-queued ${retryable.size} Google lesson sync tasks with retry delay=${properties.retryDelay}"
                }
            }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\calendar-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\calendar\service\GoogleLessonEventQueue.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.calendar.service

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import ru.teachify.common.lesson.event.LessonCreatedEvent
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.UUID
import java.util.concurrent.LinkedBlockingQueue

@Component
class GoogleLessonEventQueue {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}
    private val queue = LinkedBlockingQueue<LessonSyncTask>()

    fun enqueue(task: LessonSyncTask) {
        queue.offer(task)
        log.debug {
            "Queued lesson sync task for user=${task.userId}, lesson=${task.event.lessonId}, attempt=${task.attempt}, queueSize=${queue.size}"
        }
    }

    fun enqueueAll(tasks: Collection<LessonSyncTask>) {
        tasks.forEach(::enqueue)
    }

    fun drain(maxItems: Int): List<LessonSyncTask> {
        if (maxItems <= 0) return emptyList()
        val drained = mutableListOf<LessonSyncTask>()
        queue.drainTo(drained, maxItems)
        return drained
    }

    fun size(): Int = queue.size
}

data class LessonSyncTask(
    val userId: UUID,
    val event: LessonCreatedEvent,
    val attempt: Int = 0,
    val firstQueuedAt: Instant = Instant.now()
) {
    fun nextAttempt(): LessonSyncTask = copy(attempt = attempt + 1)
}

package ru.teachify.calendar.service

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import ru.teachify.calendar.mapper.toEventRequest
import ru.teachify.calendar.web.client.GoogleCalendarClient
import ru.teachify.common.client.ContractServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.client.LessonServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.client.UserServiceClient
import java.time.DayOfWeek
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.ZoneOffset
import java.time.ZonedDateTime
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit
import java.time.temporal.TemporalAdjusters
import java.util.*

@Service
class GoogleLessonSyncService(
    private val userServiceClient: UserServiceClient,
    private val contractServiceClient: ContractServiceClient,
    private val lessonServiceClient: LessonServiceClient,
    private val googleCalendarClient: GoogleCalendarClient,
    @param:Value("\${google.calendar.lesson-migration-days-ahead}")
    private val daysAhead: Long
) {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    fun syncIfNeeded(userId: UUID, calendarId: String, accessToken: String, created: Boolean) {
        if (!created) return
        Thread.ofVirtual().name("teachify-calendar-sync-$userId").start {
            runCatching {
                syncLessons(userId, calendarId, accessToken)
            }.onFailure {
                log.warn(it) { "Failed to sync lessons to Google Calendar for user=$userId" }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun syncLessons(userId: UUID, calendarId: String, accessToken: String) {
        val user = userServiceClient.getUser(userId)
        val profile = user.activeProfile ?: run {
            log.info { "Skip Google sync for user=$userId: no active profile" }
            return
        }

        val now = Instant.now()
        val from = startOfPreviousWeekUtc()
        val to = now.plus(daysAhead, ChronoUnit.DAYS)

        val profileType = profile.profileType ?: profile.details?.profileType
        if (profileType != "TUTOR") {
            log.info { "Skip Google sync for user=$userId: only TUTOR profiles supported for now" }
            return
        }

        val contracts = contractServiceClient.getByPerformer(profile.id)

        if (contracts.isEmpty()) {
            log.info { "Skip Google sync for user=$userId: no active contracts" }
            return
        }

        val studentNames = contracts.associate { contract ->
            val name = runCatching {
                userServiceClient.getProfile(contract.clientProfileId).displayName
            }.getOrNull()
            contract.id to name
        }

        val lessons = contracts.flatMap { contract ->
            lessonServiceClient.listByContract(contract.id, from, to)
        }

        if (lessons.isEmpty()) {
            log.info { "No lessons to migrate for user=$userId in calendar=$calendarId" }
            return
        }

        val events = lessons.map { it.toEventRequest(studentNames[it.contractId]) }
        log.info { "Exporting ${events.size} lessons to Google calendar id=$calendarId for user=$userId" }
        runCatching {
            val createdEvents = googleCalendarClient.createEventsBatch(accessToken, calendarId, events)

            if (createdEvents.size != events.size) {
                log.warn { "Requested ${events.size} events creation, but created ${createdEvents.size}. Some events might have failed." }
            }

            createdEvents.forEach { (index, googleEventId) ->
                val lesson = lessons.getOrNull(index)
                if (lesson != null) {
                    runCatching {
                        lessonServiceClient.storeGoogleEventMapping(lesson.id, googleEventId)
                    }.onFailure {
                        log.warn(it) { "Failed to save Google event mapping for lesson=${lesson.id}" }
                    }
                } else {
                    log.warn { "Received Google event ID for unknown index $index" }
                }
            }
        }.onFailure {
            log.warn(it) { "Failed to batch create calendar events for user=$userId" }
        }
    }

    private fun startOfPreviousWeekUtc(): Instant {
        val zone = ZoneOffset.UTC
        val now = ZonedDateTime.now(zone)

        val startOfCurrentWeek = now
            .with(TemporalAdjusters.previousOrSame(DayOfWeek.MONDAY))
            .withHour(0).withMinute(0).withSecond(0).withNano(0)

        return startOfCurrentWeek
            .minusWeeks(1)
            .toInstant()
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\calendar-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\calendar\web\client\GoogleCalendarClient.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.calendar.web.client

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper
import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders
import org.springframework.http.MediaType
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@Component
class GoogleCalendarClient(
    private val restClient: RestClient,
    private val objectMapper: ObjectMapper
) {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    fun ensureCalendar(accessToken: String, summary: String, timeZone: String? = null): CalendarEnsureResult {
        val existing = findCalendar(accessToken, summary)
        if (existing != null) {
            return CalendarEnsureResult(existing, created = false)
        }
        val created = createCalendar(accessToken, summary, timeZone)
        return CalendarEnsureResult(created, created = true)
    }

    private fun findCalendar(accessToken: String, summary: String): String? {
        val response = restClient.get()
            .uri("https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/users/me/calendarList")
            .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer $accessToken")
            .retrieve()
            .body(CalendarListResponse::class.java)

        return response?.items
            ?.firstOrNull { it.summary.equals(summary, ignoreCase = true) }
            ?.id
    }

    private fun createCalendar(accessToken: String, summary: String, timeZone: String?): String {
        val request = mutableMapOf<String, Any>(
            "summary" to summary
        )
        if (timeZone != null) {
            request["timeZone"] = timeZone
        }

        val response = restClient.post()
            .uri("https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars")
            .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer $accessToken")
            .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
            .body(request)
            .retrieve()
            .body(CalendarResponse::class.java)
            ?: throw IllegalStateException("Failed to create Teachify calendar in Google")

        return response.id
    }

    fun createEventsBatch(
        accessToken: String,
        calendarId: String,
        requests: List<GoogleCalendarEventRequest>
    ): Map<Int, String> {
        if (requests.isEmpty()) return emptyMap()

        val boundary = "batch_${UUID.randomUUID()}"
        val payload = buildString {
            requests.forEachIndexed { index, request ->
                append("--$boundary\r\n")
                append("Content-Type: application/http\r\n")
                append("Content-Transfer-Encoding: binary\r\n")
                append("Content-ID: $index\r\n\r\n")
                append("POST /calendar/v3/calendars/$calendarId/events\r\n")
                append("Content-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8\r\n\r\n")
                append(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(request))
                append("\r\n")
            }
            append("--$boundary--\r\n")
        }

        val response = restClient.post()
            .uri("https://www.googleapis.com/batch/calendar/v3")
            .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer $accessToken")
            .header(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_TYPE, "multipart/mixed; boundary=$boundary")
            .body(payload)
            .retrieve()
            .body(String::class.java)

        return parseBatchResponse(response ?: "")
    }

    fun updateEvent(
        accessToken: String,
        calendarId: String,
        eventId: String,
        request: GoogleCalendarEventRequest
    ) {
        restClient.put()
            .uri("https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/{calendarId}/events/{eventId}", calendarId, eventId)
            .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer $accessToken")
            .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
            .body(request)
            .retrieve()
            .toBodilessEntity()
    }

    fun deleteEventsBatch(accessToken: String, calendarId: String, eventIds: List<String>) {
        if (eventIds.isEmpty()) return

        val boundary = "batch_${UUID.randomUUID()}"
        val payload = buildString {
            eventIds.forEachIndexed { index, eventId ->
                append("--$boundary\r\n")
                append("Content-Type: application/http\r\n")
                append("Content-Transfer-Encoding: binary\r\n")
                append("Content-ID: $index\r\n\r\n")
                append("DELETE /calendar/v3/calendars/$calendarId/events/$eventId\r\n\r\n")
            }
            append("--$boundary--\r\n")
        }

        restClient.post()
            .uri("https://www.googleapis.com/batch/calendar/v3")
            .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer $accessToken")
            .header(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_TYPE, "multipart/mixed; boundary=$boundary")
            .body(payload)
            .retrieve()
            .toBodilessEntity()
    }

    fun deleteCalendar(accessToken: String, calendarId: String) {
        restClient.delete()
            .uri("https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/{calendarId}", calendarId)
            .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer $accessToken")
            .retrieve()
            .toBodilessEntity()
    }

    private fun parseBatchResponse(response: String): Map<Int, String> {
        val result = mutableMapOf<Int, String>()
        val parts = response.split(Regex("--batch[a-zA-Z0-9_\\-]*"))

        for (part in parts) {
            if (part.isBlank() || part == "--") continue

            try {
                val contentIdMatch =
                    Regex("Content-ID:\\s*<?(?:response-)?(\\d+)>?", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE).find(part)
                val index = contentIdMatch?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toIntOrNull()

                if (index != null) {
                    val jsonStart = part.indexOf("{")
                    val jsonEnd = part.lastIndexOf("}") + 1
                    if (jsonStart >= 0 && jsonEnd > jsonStart) {
                        val json = part.substring(jsonStart, jsonEnd)
                        val eventResponse = objectMapper.readValue(json, Map::class.java)

                        if (eventResponse.containsKey("error")) {
                            log.warn { "Google Calendar batch error for index $index: ${eventResponse["error"]}" }
                        } else {
                            (eventResponse["id"] as? String)?.let { eventId ->
                                result[index] = eventId
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                log.warn(e) { "Failed to parse batch response part" }
            }
        }

        return result
    }

    private data class CalendarListResponse(
        val items: List<CalendarItem> = emptyList()
    )

    private data class CalendarItem(
        val id: String,
        val summary: String
    )

    private data class CalendarResponse(
        val id: String
    )
}

data class CalendarEnsureResult(
    val calendarId: String,
    val created: Boolean
)

data class GoogleCalendarEventRequest(
    val summary: String,
    val description: String?,
    val start: GoogleDateTime,
    val end: GoogleDateTime
)

data class GoogleDateTime(
    val dateTime: Instant,
    val timeZone: String? = null
)

package ru.teachify.calendar

import io.mockk.every
import io.mockk.justRun
import io.mockk.mockk
import io.mockk.verify
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test
import ru.teachify.common.client.CalendarEnsureResult
import ru.teachify.common.client.GoogleCalendarClient
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.DeleteGoogleCalendarRequest
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.EnsureGoogleCalendarRequest
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.GoogleCalendarCleanupService
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.GoogleCalendarService
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.GoogleLessonSyncService
import java.util.UUID

class GoogleCalendarServiceTest {

    private lateinit var calendarClient: GoogleCalendarClient
    private lateinit var lessonSyncService: GoogleLessonSyncService
    private lateinit var cleanupService: GoogleCalendarCleanupService
    private lateinit var service: GoogleCalendarService

    @BeforeEach
    fun setup() {
        calendarClient = mockk()
        lessonSyncService = mockk()
        cleanupService = mockk()
        service = GoogleCalendarService(calendarClient, lessonSyncService, cleanupService)
    }

    @Test
    fun `ensureCalendar should ensure and trigger sync`() {
        val userId = UUID.randomUUID()
        every { calendarClient.ensureCalendar("access", any(), any()) } returns CalendarEnsureResult("calendar-id", created = true)
        justRun { lessonSyncService.syncIfNeeded(userId, "calendar-id", "access", true) }

        service.ensureCalendar(EnsureGoogleCalendarRequest(userId, "access", "refresh"))

        verify { calendarClient.ensureCalendar("access", any(), any()) }
        verify { lessonSyncService.syncIfNeeded(userId, "calendar-id", "access", true) }
    }

    @Test
    fun `deleteCalendar should delegate to cleanup service`() {
        val request = DeleteGoogleCalendarRequest("access", "refresh", "calendar")
        justRun { cleanupService.removeCalendar("access", "refresh", "calendar") }

        service.deleteCalendar(request)

        verify { cleanupService.removeCalendar("access", "refresh", "calendar") }
    }
}
