package ru.teachify.calendar.service

import io.mockk.Runs
import io.mockk.clearAllMocks
import io.mockk.every
import io.mockk.just
import io.mockk.mockk
import io.mockk.verify
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test
import ru.teachify.common.client.GoogleAccountClient
import ru.teachify.common.client.GoogleAccountDto
import ru.teachify.common.client.GoogleCalendarClient
import ru.teachify.calendar.config.GoogleLessonSyncProperties
import ru.teachify.common.lesson.event.LessonCreatedEvent
import java.time.Duration
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.UUID

class GoogleLessonEventProcessorTest {

    private val queue = GoogleLessonEventQueue()
    private val properties = GoogleLessonSyncProperties().apply {
        batchSize = 10
        batchInterval = Duration.ofSeconds(1)
        maxAttempts = 3
        retryDelay = Duration.ZERO
    }
    private val googleAccountClient = mockk<GoogleAccountClient>(relaxed = true)
    private val googleCalendarClient = mockk<GoogleCalendarClient>(relaxed = true)
    private val accessTokenRefresher = mockk<GoogleAccessTokenRefresher>()

    private val processor = GoogleLessonEventProcessor(
        queue = queue,
        properties = properties,
        googleAccountClient = googleAccountClient,
        googleCalendarClient = googleCalendarClient,
        accessTokenRefresher = accessTokenRefresher
    )

    @BeforeEach
    fun setUp() {
        clearAllMocks()
    }

    @AfterEach
    fun tearDown() {
        queue.drain(100)
    }

    @Test
    fun `processQueue should send batch when account exists`() {
        val userId = UUID.randomUUID()
        val event = sampleEvent()
        queue.enqueue(LessonSyncTask(userId = userId, event = event))

        every { googleAccountClient.getAccount(userId) } returns GoogleAccountDto(userId, "access", "refresh", "calendar")
        every { googleCalendarClient.createEventsBatch("access", "calendar", any()) } returns Unit

        processor.processQueue()

        verify(exactly = 1) { googleCalendarClient.createEventsBatch("access", "calendar", match { it.size == 1 }) }
    }

    @Test
    fun `processQueue should refresh token on failure`() {
        val userId = UUID.randomUUID()
        val event = sampleEvent()
        queue.enqueue(LessonSyncTask(userId = userId, event = event))

        every { googleAccountClient.getAccount(userId) } returns GoogleAccountDto(userId, "stale", "refresh-token", "calendar")
        every { googleCalendarClient.createEventsBatch("stale", "calendar", any()) } throws RuntimeException("unauthorized")
        every { accessTokenRefresher.refresh("refresh-token") } returns "new-token"
        every { googleCalendarClient.createEventsBatch("new-token", "calendar", any()) } returns Unit
        every { googleAccountClient.updateAccessToken(userId, "new-token") } just Runs

        processor.processQueue()

        verify(exactly = 1) { googleCalendarClient.createEventsBatch("stale", "calendar", any()) }
        verify(exactly = 1) { accessTokenRefresher.refresh("refresh-token") }
        verify(exactly = 1) { googleCalendarClient.createEventsBatch("new-token", "calendar", any()) }
        verify(exactly = 1) { googleAccountClient.updateAccessToken(userId, "new-token") }
    }

    @Test
    fun `processQueue should schedule retry when sync fails`() {
        val userId = UUID.randomUUID()
        val event = sampleEvent()
        queue.enqueue(LessonSyncTask(userId = userId, event = event))

        every { googleAccountClient.getAccount(userId) } returns GoogleAccountDto(userId, "stale", "refresh-token", "calendar")
        every { googleCalendarClient.createEventsBatch("stale", "calendar", any()) } throws RuntimeException("unauthorized")
        every { accessTokenRefresher.refresh("refresh-token") } returns null

        processor.processQueue()

        Thread.sleep(20)
        val retryTasks = queue.drain(10)
        assertEquals(1, retryTasks.size)
        assertEquals(1, retryTasks.first().attempt)
    }

    private fun sampleEvent(): LessonCreatedEvent {
        return LessonCreatedEvent(
            lessonId = UUID.randomUUID(),
            contractId = UUID.randomUUID(),
            scheduleId = UUID.randomUUID(),
            startAt = Instant.now(),
            duration = Duration.ofMinutes(60),
            status = "SCHEDULED"
        )
    }
}

package ru.teachify.calendar.listener

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.transaction.event.TransactionalEventListener
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.EnsureGoogleCalendarRequest
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.GoogleCalendarService
import ru.teachify.common.client.UserServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.google.event.GoogleAccountLinkedEvent

@Component
class GoogleAccountLinkListener(
    private val googleCalendarService: GoogleCalendarService,
    private val userServiceClient: UserServiceClient
) {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @TransactionalEventListener
    fun onGoogleAccountLinked(event: GoogleAccountLinkedEvent) {
        if (event.accessToken.isBlank()) {
            log.warn { "Skip Google calendar ensure: empty access token for user=${event.userId}" }
            return
        }

        runCatching {
            val response = googleCalendarService.ensureCalendar(
                EnsureGoogleCalendarRequest(
                    userId = event.userId,
                    accessToken = event.accessToken,
                    refreshToken = event.refreshToken
                )
            )
            userServiceClient.updateGoogleCalendarId(event.userId, response.calendarId)
            log.info {
                "Google calendar ensured for user=${event.userId}, created=${response.created}"
            }
        }.onFailure {
            log.warn(it) { "Failed to ensure Google calendar for user=${event.userId}" }
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\calendar-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\calendar\listener\GoogleAccountUnlinkListener.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.calendar.listener

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.transaction.event.TransactionalEventListener
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.GoogleCalendarCleanupService
import ru.teachify.common.client.LessonServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.google.event.GoogleAccountUnlinkedEvent

@Component
class GoogleAccountUnlinkListener(
    private val cleanupService: GoogleCalendarCleanupService,
    private val lessonServiceClient: LessonServiceClient
) {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @TransactionalEventListener
    fun onGoogleAccountUnlinked(event: GoogleAccountUnlinkedEvent) {
        log.info { "Received unlinked event for user=${event.userId}, removing calendar=${event.calendarId}" }

        runCatching {
            cleanupService.removeCalendar(event.accessToken, null, event.calendarId)
        }.onFailure {
            log.warn(it) { "Failed to remove calendar for user=${event.userId}" }
        }

        runCatching {
            lessonServiceClient.cleanupGoogleEvents(event.userId)
            log.info { "Requested Google events cleanup for user=${event.userId}" }
        }.onFailure {
            log.warn(it) { "Failed to cleanup Google events for user=${event.userId}" }
        }
    }
}

package ru.teachify.calendar.listener

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.context.event.EventListener
import org.springframework.core.task.AsyncTaskExecutor
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.transaction.event.TransactionalEventListener
import ru.teachify.calendar.mapper.toEventRequest
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.GoogleAccessTokenRefresher
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.GoogleLessonEventQueue
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.LessonSyncTask
import ru.teachify.calendar.web.client.GoogleCalendarClient
import ru.teachify.common.client.ContractServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.client.GoogleAccountDto
import ru.teachify.common.client.LessonServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.client.UserServiceClient

import ru.teachify.common.lesson.event.ScheduleLessonsDeletedEvent

@Component
class GoogleLessonEventListener(
    private val queue: GoogleLessonEventQueue,
    private val contractServiceClient: ContractServiceClient,
    private val userServiceClient: UserServiceClient,
    private val lessonServiceClient: LessonServiceClient,
    private val googleCalendarClient: GoogleCalendarClient,
    private val accessTokenRefresher: GoogleAccessTokenRefresher,
    private val taskExecutor: AsyncTaskExecutor
) {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @TransactionalEventListener
    fun onLessonCreated(event: LessonCreatedEvent) {
        log.info { "Received lesson created event for lesson=${event.lessonId}, contract=${event.contractId}" }

        taskExecutor.execute {
            runCatching {
                val accounts = getLinkedAccountsForContract(event.contractId)
                if (accounts.isEmpty()) {
                    log.debug { "No linked Google calendars to sync for lesson=${event.lessonId}" }
                    return@runCatching
                }

                val tasks = accounts.map { account ->
                    LessonSyncTask(
                        userId = account.userId,
                        event = event
                    )
                }
                queue.enqueueAll(tasks)
            }.onFailure {
                log.warn(it) { "Failed to prepare Google calendar sync tasks for lesson=${event.lessonId}" }
            }
        }
    }

    @TransactionalEventListener
    fun onLessonUpdated(event: LessonUpdatedEvent) {
        log.debug { "Received lesson updated event for lesson=${event.lessonId}" }
        taskExecutor.execute {
            runCatching { handleLessonUpdate(event) }
                .onFailure {
                    log.warn(it) { "Failed to handle Google calendar update for lesson=${event.lessonId}" }
                }
        }
    }

    @EventListener
    fun onLessonDeleted(event: LessonDeletedEvent) {
        log.debug { "Received lesson deleted event for lesson=${event.lessonId}" }
        taskExecutor.execute {
            runCatching { handleLessonDelete(event) }
                .onFailure {
                    log.warn(it) { "Failed to handle Google calendar deletion for lesson=${event.lessonId}" }
                }
        }
    }

    @EventListener
    fun onScheduleLessonsDeleted(event: ScheduleLessonsDeletedEvent) {
        log.info { "Received batch delete event for schedule=${event.scheduleId}, count=${event.items.size}" }
        taskExecutor.execute {
            runCatching { handleScheduleLessonsDelete(event) }
                .onFailure {
                    log.warn(it) { "Failed to handle batch Google calendar deletion for schedule=${event.scheduleId}" }
                }
        }
    }

    private fun handleLessonUpdate(event: LessonUpdatedEvent) {
        val mapping = lessonServiceClient.getGoogleEventMapping(event.lessonId)
        if (mapping == null) {
            log.debug { "No Google event mapping for lesson=${event.lessonId}, skipping update" }
            return
        }

        val studentName = runCatching {
            val contract = contractServiceClient.getContract(event.contractId)
            val profile = userServiceClient.getProfile(contract.clientProfileId)
            profile.displayName
        }.getOrNull()

        val request = event.toEventRequest(studentName)

        getLinkedAccountsForContract(event.contractId).forEach { account ->
            withTokenRefresh(account, "update lesson=${event.lessonId}") { token ->
                googleCalendarClient.updateEvent(token, account.calendarId!!, mapping.googleEventId, request)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun handleLessonDelete(event: LessonDeletedEvent) {
        val mapping = lessonServiceClient.getGoogleEventMapping(event.lessonId)
        if (mapping == null) {
            log.debug { "No Google event mapping for lesson=${event.lessonId}, skipping delete" }
            return
        }

        getLinkedAccountsForContract(event.contractId).forEach { account ->
            withTokenRefresh(account, "delete lesson=${event.lessonId}") { token ->
                googleCalendarClient.deleteEventsBatch(token, account.calendarId!!, listOf(mapping.googleEventId))
            }
        }

        runCatching {
            lessonServiceClient.deleteGoogleEventMapping(event.lessonId)
            log.info { "Deleted Google event mapping for lesson=${event.lessonId}" }
        }.onFailure {
            log.warn(it) { "Failed to delete Google event mapping for lesson=${event.lessonId}" }
        }
    }

    private fun handleScheduleLessonsDelete(event: ScheduleLessonsDeletedEvent) {
        val eventIds = event.items.mapNotNull { it.googleEventId }
        if (eventIds.isEmpty()) {
            log.debug { "No Google events to delete for schedule=${event.scheduleId}" }
            return
        }

        val accounts = getLinkedAccountsForContract(event.contractId)
        if (accounts.isEmpty()) {
            log.debug { "No linked accounts for contract=${event.contractId}, skipping batch delete" }
            return
        }

        accounts.forEach { account ->
            withTokenRefresh(account, "batch delete for schedule=${event.scheduleId}") { token ->
                eventIds.chunked(50).forEach { chunk ->
                    googleCalendarClient.deleteEventsBatch(token, account.calendarId!!, chunk)
                }
            }
        }

        log.info { "Successfully processed batch deletion of ${eventIds.size} events for schedule=${event.scheduleId}" }
    }

    private fun getLinkedAccountsForContract(contractId: UUID): List<GoogleAccountDto> {
        val contract = contractServiceClient.getContract(contractId)
        val profileIds = listOf(contract.performerProfileId)

        return profileIds.mapNotNull { profileId ->
            try {
                val profile = userServiceClient.getProfile(profileId)
                val account = userServiceClient.getGoogleAccount(profile.userId)
                if (account?.calendarId.isNullOrBlank()) null else account
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                log.warn(e) { "Failed to resolve Google account for profile=$profileId" }
                null
            }
        }
    }

    private fun withTokenRefresh(
        account: GoogleAccountDto,
        actionDescription: String,
        action: (String) -> Unit
    ) {
        val userId = account.userId
        val accessToken = account.accessToken

        val firstAttempt = runCatching { action(accessToken) }
        if (firstAttempt.isSuccess) {
            log.debug { "Successfully executed $actionDescription for user=$userId" }
            return
        }

        val refreshToken = account.refreshToken
        if (refreshToken.isNullOrBlank()) {
            log.warn(firstAttempt.exceptionOrNull()) {
                "Failed to $actionDescription for user=$userId: no refresh token available"
            }
            return
        }

        val refreshedToken = accessTokenRefresher.refresh(refreshToken)
        if (refreshedToken.isNullOrBlank()) {
            log.warn(firstAttempt.exceptionOrNull()) {
                "Failed to refresh token for $actionDescription for user=$userId"
            }
            return
        }

        runCatching {
            action(refreshedToken)
            userServiceClient.updateGoogleAccessToken(userId, refreshedToken)
        }.onSuccess {
            log.debug { "Successfully executed $actionDescription for user=$userId after token refresh" }
        }.onFailure {
            log.warn(it) { "Failed to $actionDescription for user=$userId even after refreshing token" }
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\calendar-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\calendar\service\GoogleAccessTokenRefresher.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.calendar.service

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.core.ParameterizedTypeReference
import org.springframework.http.MediaType
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.util.LinkedMultiValueMap
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient
import ru.teachify.calendar.config.GoogleOauthProperties

@Component
class GoogleAccessTokenRefresher(
    private val restClient: RestClient,
    private val oauthProperties: GoogleOauthProperties
) {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    fun refresh(refreshToken: String?): String? {
        if (refreshToken.isNullOrBlank()) {
            return null
        }

        return try {
            val form = LinkedMultiValueMap<String, String>().apply {
                add("client_id", oauthProperties.clientId)
                add("client_secret", oauthProperties.clientSecret)
                add("refresh_token", refreshToken)
                add("grant_type", "refresh_token")
            }

            val response = restClient.post()
                .uri(oauthProperties.tokenUri)
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_FORM_URLENCODED)
                .body(form)
                .retrieve()
                .body(object : ParameterizedTypeReference<Map<String, Any>>() {})

            val token = response?.get("access_token") as? String
            if (token.isNullOrBlank()) {
                log.warn { "Refresh token response did not contain access_token" }
            }
            token
        } catch (ex: Exception) {
            log.warn(ex) { "Failed to refresh Google access token" }
            null
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\calendar-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\calendar\service\GoogleCalendarCleanupService.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.calendar.service

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import ru.teachify.calendar.web.client.GoogleCalendarClient

@Service
class GoogleCalendarCleanupService(
    private val accessTokenRefresher: GoogleAccessTokenRefresher,
    private val googleCalendarClient: GoogleCalendarClient
) {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    fun removeCalendar(accessToken: String?, refreshToken: String?, calendarId: String?) {
        if (calendarId.isNullOrBlank()) {
            return
        }

        var token = accessToken
        if (token.isNullOrBlank()) {
            token = accessTokenRefresher.refresh(refreshToken)
        }

        if (token.isNullOrBlank()) {
            log.warn { "Skip Google calendar deletion for calendarId=$calendarId: no valid access token" }
            return
        }

        val deleted = runCatching {
            googleCalendarClient.deleteCalendar(token, calendarId)
            true
        }.getOrElse {
            log.warn(it) { "Failed to delete Google calendar $calendarId with current token" }
            false
        }

        if (!deleted && !refreshToken.isNullOrBlank()) {
            val refreshedToken = accessTokenRefresher.refresh(refreshToken)
            if (!refreshedToken.isNullOrBlank()) {
                runCatching {
                    googleCalendarClient.deleteCalendar(refreshedToken, calendarId)
                    log.info { "Google calendar deleted after refreshing token: calendarId=$calendarId" }
                }.onFailure {
                    log.warn(it) { "Failed to delete Google calendar $calendarId after refreshing token" }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

            accessToken = request.accessToken,

<<<FILE path="app\calendar-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\calendar\service\GoogleLessonEventProcessor.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.calendar.service

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import ru.teachify.calendar.config.GoogleLessonSyncProperties
import ru.teachify.calendar.mapper.toEventRequest
import ru.teachify.calendar.web.client.GoogleCalendarClient
import ru.teachify.calendar.web.client.GoogleCalendarEventRequest
import ru.teachify.common.client.ContractServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.client.GoogleAccountDto
import ru.teachify.common.client.LessonServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.client.UserServiceClient
import java.util.*

@Service
class GoogleLessonEventProcessor(
    private val queue: GoogleLessonEventQueue,
    private val properties: GoogleLessonSyncProperties,
    private val userServiceClient: UserServiceClient,
    private val googleCalendarClient: GoogleCalendarClient,
    private val lessonServiceClient: LessonServiceClient,
    private val contractServiceClient: ContractServiceClient,
    private val accessTokenRefresher: GoogleAccessTokenRefresher
) {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Scheduled(fixedDelayString = "\${google.calendar.lesson-sync.batch-interval:5s}")
    fun processQueue() {
        val tasks = queue.drain(properties.batchSize)
        if (tasks.isEmpty()) {
            return
        }

        log.debug { "Processing ${tasks.size} Google lesson sync tasks, queueSize=${queue.size()}" }
        tasks.groupBy { it.userId }.forEach { (userId, userTasks) ->
            processUserTasks(userId, userTasks)
        }
    }

    private fun processUserTasks(userId: UUID, tasks: List<LessonSyncTask>) {
        val eligibleTasks = tasks.filter { it.attempt < properties.maxAttempts }
        if (eligibleTasks.isEmpty()) {
            log.warn { "Dropping Google sync tasks for user=$userId: exceeded max attempts (${properties.maxAttempts})" }
            return
        }

        val account = userServiceClient.getGoogleAccount(userId)
        if (account == null || account.calendarId.isNullOrBlank()) {
            log.info { "Skip Google sync for user=$userId: no linked calendar" }
            return
        }

        val distinctTasks = eligibleTasks.distinctBy { it.event.lessonId }

        val contractIds = distinctTasks.map { it.event.contractId }.distinct()
        val studentNames = fetchStudentNames(contractIds)

        val requests = distinctTasks
            .sortedBy { it.event.startAt }
            .map { it.event.toEventRequest(studentNames[it.event.contractId]) }

        if (requests.isEmpty()) {
            return
        }

        val success = sendBatchAndSaveMappings(userId, account, distinctTasks, requests)
        if (success) {
            log.info { "Synchronized ${requests.size} lessons to Google calendar for user=$userId" }
        } else {
            scheduleRetry(distinctTasks)
        }
    }

    private fun fetchStudentNames(contractIds: Collection<UUID>): Map<UUID, String> {
        val result = mutableMapOf<UUID, String>()
        contractIds.forEach { contractId ->
            runCatching {
                val contract = contractServiceClient.getContract(contractId)
                val profile = userServiceClient.getProfile(contract.clientProfileId)
                profile.displayName?.let { result[contractId] = it }
            }.onFailure {
                log.warn(it) { "Failed to resolve student name for contract=$contractId" }
            }
        }
        return result
    }

    private fun sendBatchAndSaveMappings(
        userId: UUID,
        account: GoogleAccountDto,
        tasks: List<LessonSyncTask>,
        requests: List<GoogleCalendarEventRequest>
    ): Boolean {
        val calendarId = account.calendarId ?: return false
        val accessToken = account.accessToken

        val firstAttempt = runCatching {
            val createdEvents = googleCalendarClient.createEventsBatch(accessToken, calendarId, requests)
            saveMappings(tasks, createdEvents)
        }

        if (firstAttempt.isSuccess) {
            return true
        }

        val refreshToken = account.refreshToken
        if (refreshToken.isNullOrBlank()) {
            log.warn(firstAttempt.exceptionOrNull()) {
                "Failed to sync Google calendar for user=$userId without refresh token"
            }
            return false
        }

        val refreshedToken = accessTokenRefresher.refresh(refreshToken)
        if (refreshedToken.isNullOrBlank()) {
            log.warn(firstAttempt.exceptionOrNull()) {
                "Failed to refresh Google access token for user=$userId"
            }
            return false
        }

        val secondAttempt = runCatching {
            val createdEvents = googleCalendarClient.createEventsBatch(refreshedToken, calendarId, requests)
            saveMappings(tasks, createdEvents)
        }

        if (secondAttempt.isSuccess) {
            runCatching { userServiceClient.updateGoogleAccessToken(userId, refreshedToken) }
                .onFailure { log.warn(it) { "Failed to persist refreshed Google access token for user=$userId" } }
            return true
        }

        log.warn(secondAttempt.exceptionOrNull()) {
            "Failed to sync Google calendar for user=$userId even after refreshing token"
        }
        return false
    }

    private fun saveMappings(tasks: List<LessonSyncTask>, createdEvents: Map<Int, String>) {
        createdEvents.forEach { (index, eventId) ->
            val task = tasks.getOrNull(index)
            if (task != null) {
                runCatching {
                    lessonServiceClient.storeGoogleEventMapping(task.event.lessonId, eventId)
                }.onFailure {
                    log.warn(it) { "Failed to save Google event mapping for lesson=${task.event.lessonId}" }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun scheduleRetry(tasks: List<LessonSyncTask>) {
        val retryable = tasks.mapNotNull { task ->
            val next = task.nextAttempt()
            if (next.attempt < properties.maxAttempts) next else null
        }

        if (retryable.isEmpty()) {
            return
        }

        Thread.ofVirtual()
            .name("teachify-calendar-retry-${System.nanoTime()}")
            .start {
                try {
                    Thread.sleep(properties.retryDelay.toMillis())
                } catch (_: InterruptedException) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt()
                }
                queue.enqueueAll(retryable)
                log.info {
                    "Re-queued ${retryable.size} Google lesson sync tasks with retry delay=${properties.retryDelay}"
                }
            }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\calendar-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\calendar\service\GoogleLessonEventQueue.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.calendar.service

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import ru.teachify.common.lesson.event.LessonCreatedEvent
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.UUID
import java.util.concurrent.LinkedBlockingQueue

@Component
class GoogleLessonEventQueue {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}
    private val queue = LinkedBlockingQueue<LessonSyncTask>()

    fun enqueue(task: LessonSyncTask) {
        queue.offer(task)
        log.debug {
            "Queued lesson sync task for user=${task.userId}, lesson=${task.event.lessonId}, attempt=${task.attempt}, queueSize=${queue.size}"
        }
    }

    fun enqueueAll(tasks: Collection<LessonSyncTask>) {
        tasks.forEach(::enqueue)
    }

    fun drain(maxItems: Int): List<LessonSyncTask> {
        if (maxItems <= 0) return emptyList()
        val drained = mutableListOf<LessonSyncTask>()
        queue.drainTo(drained, maxItems)
        return drained
    }

    fun size(): Int = queue.size
}

data class LessonSyncTask(
    val userId: UUID,
    val event: LessonCreatedEvent,
    val attempt: Int = 0,
    val firstQueuedAt: Instant = Instant.now()
) {
    fun nextAttempt(): LessonSyncTask = copy(attempt = attempt + 1)
}

<<<FILE path="app\calendar-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\calendar\service\GoogleLessonSyncService.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.calendar.service

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import ru.teachify.calendar.mapper.toEventRequest
import ru.teachify.calendar.web.client.GoogleCalendarClient
import ru.teachify.common.client.ContractServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.client.LessonServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.client.UserServiceClient
import java.time.DayOfWeek
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.ZoneOffset
import java.time.ZonedDateTime
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit
import java.time.temporal.TemporalAdjusters
import java.util.*

@Service
class GoogleLessonSyncService(
    private val userServiceClient: UserServiceClient,
    private val contractServiceClient: ContractServiceClient,
    private val lessonServiceClient: LessonServiceClient,
    private val googleCalendarClient: GoogleCalendarClient,
    @param:Value("\${google.calendar.lesson-migration-days-ahead}")
    private val daysAhead: Long
) {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    fun syncIfNeeded(userId: UUID, calendarId: String, accessToken: String, created: Boolean) {
        if (!created) return
        Thread.ofVirtual().name("teachify-calendar-sync-$userId").start {
            runCatching {
                syncLessons(userId, calendarId, accessToken)
            }.onFailure {
                log.warn(it) { "Failed to sync lessons to Google Calendar for user=$userId" }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun syncLessons(userId: UUID, calendarId: String, accessToken: String) {
        val user = userServiceClient.getUser(userId)
        val profile = user.activeProfile ?: run {
            log.info { "Skip Google sync for user=$userId: no active profile" }
            return
        }

        val now = Instant.now()
        val from = startOfPreviousWeekUtc()
        val to = now.plus(daysAhead, ChronoUnit.DAYS)

        val profileType = profile.profileType ?: profile.details?.profileType
        if (profileType != "TUTOR") {
            log.info { "Skip Google sync for user=$userId: only TUTOR profiles supported for now" }
            return
        }

        val contracts = contractServiceClient.getByPerformer(profile.id)

        if (contracts.isEmpty()) {
            log.info { "Skip Google sync for user=$userId: no active contracts" }
            return
        }

        val studentNames = contracts.associate { contract ->
            val name = runCatching {
                userServiceClient.getProfile(contract.clientProfileId).displayName
            }.getOrNull()
            contract.id to name
        }

        val lessons = contracts.flatMap { contract ->
            lessonServiceClient.listByContract(contract.id, from, to)
        }

        if (lessons.isEmpty()) {
            log.info { "No lessons to migrate for user=$userId in calendar=$calendarId" }
            return
        }

        val events = lessons.map { it.toEventRequest(studentNames[it.contractId]) }
        log.info { "Exporting ${events.size} lessons to Google calendar id=$calendarId for user=$userId" }
        runCatching {
            val createdEvents = googleCalendarClient.createEventsBatch(accessToken, calendarId, events)

            if (createdEvents.size != events.size) {
                log.warn { "Requested ${events.size} events creation, but created ${createdEvents.size}. Some events might have failed." }
            }

            createdEvents.forEach { (index, googleEventId) ->
                val lesson = lessons.getOrNull(index)
                if (lesson != null) {
                    runCatching {
                        lessonServiceClient.storeGoogleEventMapping(lesson.id, googleEventId)
                    }.onFailure {
                        log.warn(it) { "Failed to save Google event mapping for lesson=${lesson.id}" }
                    }
                } else {
                    log.warn { "Received Google event ID for unknown index $index" }
                }
            }
        }.onFailure {
            log.warn(it) { "Failed to batch create calendar events for user=$userId" }
        }
    }

    private fun startOfPreviousWeekUtc(): Instant {
        val zone = ZoneOffset.UTC
        val now = ZonedDateTime.now(zone)

        val startOfCurrentWeek = now
            .with(TemporalAdjusters.previousOrSame(DayOfWeek.MONDAY))
            .withHour(0).withMinute(0).withSecond(0).withNano(0)

        return startOfCurrentWeek
            .minusWeeks(1)
            .toInstant()
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\calendar-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\calendar\web\client\GoogleCalendarClient.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.calendar.web.client

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper
import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders
import org.springframework.http.MediaType
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@Component
class GoogleCalendarClient(
    private val restClient: RestClient,
    private val objectMapper: ObjectMapper
) {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    fun ensureCalendar(accessToken: String, summary: String, timeZone: String? = null): CalendarEnsureResult {
        val existing = findCalendar(accessToken, summary)
        if (existing != null) {
            return CalendarEnsureResult(existing, created = false)
        }
        val created = createCalendar(accessToken, summary, timeZone)
        return CalendarEnsureResult(created, created = true)
    }

    private fun findCalendar(accessToken: String, summary: String): String? {
        val response = restClient.get()
            .uri("https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/users/me/calendarList")
            .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer $accessToken")
            .retrieve()
            .body(CalendarListResponse::class.java)

        return response?.items
            ?.firstOrNull { it.summary.equals(summary, ignoreCase = true) }
            ?.id
    }

    private fun createCalendar(accessToken: String, summary: String, timeZone: String?): String {
        val request = mutableMapOf<String, Any>(
            "summary" to summary
        )
        if (timeZone != null) {
            request["timeZone"] = timeZone
        }

        val response = restClient.post()
            .uri("https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars")
            .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer $accessToken")
            .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
            .body(request)
            .retrieve()
            .body(CalendarResponse::class.java)
            ?: throw IllegalStateException("Failed to create Teachify calendar in Google")

        return response.id
    }

    fun createEventsBatch(
        accessToken: String,
        calendarId: String,
        requests: List<GoogleCalendarEventRequest>
    ): Map<Int, String> {
        if (requests.isEmpty()) return emptyMap()

        val boundary = "batch_${UUID.randomUUID()}"
        val payload = buildString {
            requests.forEachIndexed { index, request ->
                append("--$boundary\r\n")
                append("Content-Type: application/http\r\n")
                append("Content-Transfer-Encoding: binary\r\n")
                append("Content-ID: $index\r\n\r\n")
                append("POST /calendar/v3/calendars/$calendarId/events\r\n")
                append("Content-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8\r\n\r\n")
                append(objectMapper.writeValueAsString(request))
                append("\r\n")
            }
            append("--$boundary--\r\n")
        }

        val response = restClient.post()
            .uri("https://www.googleapis.com/batch/calendar/v3")
            .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer $accessToken")
            .header(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_TYPE, "multipart/mixed; boundary=$boundary")
            .body(payload)
            .retrieve()
            .body(String::class.java)

        return parseBatchResponse(response ?: "")
    }

    fun updateEvent(
        accessToken: String,
        calendarId: String,
        eventId: String,
        request: GoogleCalendarEventRequest
    ) {
        restClient.put()
            .uri("https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/{calendarId}/events/{eventId}", calendarId, eventId)
            .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer $accessToken")
            .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
            .body(request)
            .retrieve()
            .toBodilessEntity()
    }

    fun deleteEventsBatch(accessToken: String, calendarId: String, eventIds: List<String>) {
        if (eventIds.isEmpty()) return

        val boundary = "batch_${UUID.randomUUID()}"
        val payload = buildString {
            eventIds.forEachIndexed { index, eventId ->
                append("--$boundary\r\n")
                append("Content-Type: application/http\r\n")
                append("Content-Transfer-Encoding: binary\r\n")
                append("Content-ID: $index\r\n\r\n")
                append("DELETE /calendar/v3/calendars/$calendarId/events/$eventId\r\n\r\n")
            }
            append("--$boundary--\r\n")
        }

        restClient.post()
            .uri("https://www.googleapis.com/batch/calendar/v3")
            .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer $accessToken")
            .header(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_TYPE, "multipart/mixed; boundary=$boundary")
            .body(payload)
            .retrieve()
            .toBodilessEntity()
    }

    fun deleteCalendar(accessToken: String, calendarId: String) {
        restClient.delete()
            .uri("https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/{calendarId}", calendarId)
            .header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer $accessToken")
            .retrieve()
            .toBodilessEntity()
    }

    private fun parseBatchResponse(response: String): Map<Int, String> {
        val result = mutableMapOf<Int, String>()
        val parts = response.split(Regex("--batch[a-zA-Z0-9_\\-]*"))

        for (part in parts) {
            if (part.isBlank() || part == "--") continue

            try {
                val contentIdMatch =
                    Regex("Content-ID:\\s*<?(?:response-)?(\\d+)>?", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE).find(part)
                val index = contentIdMatch?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toIntOrNull()

                if (index != null) {
                    val jsonStart = part.indexOf("{")
                    val jsonEnd = part.lastIndexOf("}") + 1
                    if (jsonStart >= 0 && jsonEnd > jsonStart) {
                        val json = part.substring(jsonStart, jsonEnd)
                        val eventResponse = objectMapper.readValue(json, Map::class.java)

                        if (eventResponse.containsKey("error")) {
                            log.warn { "Google Calendar batch error for index $index: ${eventResponse["error"]}" }
                        } else {
                            (eventResponse["id"] as? String)?.let { eventId ->
                                result[index] = eventId
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                log.warn(e) { "Failed to parse batch response part" }
            }
        }

        return result
    }

    private data class CalendarListResponse(
        val items: List<CalendarItem> = emptyList()
    )

    private data class CalendarItem(
        val id: String,
        val summary: String
    )

    private data class CalendarResponse(
        val id: String
    )
}

data class CalendarEnsureResult(
    val calendarId: String,
    val created: Boolean
)

data class GoogleCalendarEventRequest(
    val summary: String,
    val description: String?,
    val start: GoogleDateTime,
    val end: GoogleDateTime
)

data class GoogleDateTime(
    val dateTime: Instant,
    val timeZone: String? = null
)

package ru.teachify.calendar.web

package ru.teachify.calendar

import io.mockk.every
import io.mockk.justRun
import io.mockk.mockk
import io.mockk.verify
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test
import ru.teachify.common.client.CalendarEnsureResult
import ru.teachify.common.client.GoogleCalendarClient
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.DeleteGoogleCalendarRequest
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.EnsureGoogleCalendarRequest
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.GoogleCalendarCleanupService
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.GoogleCalendarService
import ru.teachify.calendar.service.GoogleLessonSyncService
import java.util.UUID

class GoogleCalendarServiceTest {

    private lateinit var calendarClient: GoogleCalendarClient
    private lateinit var lessonSyncService: GoogleLessonSyncService
    private lateinit var cleanupService: GoogleCalendarCleanupService
    private lateinit var service: GoogleCalendarService

    @BeforeEach
    fun setup() {
        calendarClient = mockk()
        lessonSyncService = mockk()
        cleanupService = mockk()
        service = GoogleCalendarService(calendarClient, lessonSyncService, cleanupService)
    }

    @Test
    fun `ensureCalendar should ensure and trigger sync`() {
        val userId = UUID.randomUUID()
        every { calendarClient.ensureCalendar("access", any(), any()) } returns CalendarEnsureResult("calendar-id", created = true)
        justRun { lessonSyncService.syncIfNeeded(userId, "calendar-id", "access", true) }

        service.ensureCalendar(EnsureGoogleCalendarRequest(userId, "access", "refresh"))

        verify { calendarClient.ensureCalendar("access", any(), any()) }
        verify { lessonSyncService.syncIfNeeded(userId, "calendar-id", "access", true) }
    }

    @Test
    fun `deleteCalendar should delegate to cleanup service`() {
        val request = DeleteGoogleCalendarRequest("access", "refresh", "calendar")
        justRun { cleanupService.removeCalendar("access", "refresh", "calendar") }

        service.deleteCalendar(request)

        verify { cleanupService.removeCalendar("access", "refresh", "calendar") }
    }
}

package ru.teachify.calendar.service

import io.mockk.Runs
import io.mockk.clearAllMocks
import io.mockk.every
import io.mockk.just
import io.mockk.mockk
import io.mockk.verify
import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterEach
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test
import ru.teachify.common.client.GoogleAccountClient
import ru.teachify.common.client.GoogleAccountDto
import ru.teachify.common.client.GoogleCalendarClient
import ru.teachify.calendar.config.GoogleLessonSyncProperties
import ru.teachify.common.lesson.event.LessonCreatedEvent
import java.time.Duration
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.UUID

class GoogleLessonEventProcessorTest {

    private val queue = GoogleLessonEventQueue()
    private val properties = GoogleLessonSyncProperties().apply {
        batchSize = 10
        batchInterval = Duration.ofSeconds(1)
        maxAttempts = 3
        retryDelay = Duration.ZERO
    }
    private val googleAccountClient = mockk<GoogleAccountClient>(relaxed = true)
    private val googleCalendarClient = mockk<GoogleCalendarClient>(relaxed = true)
    private val accessTokenRefresher = mockk<GoogleAccessTokenRefresher>()

    private val processor = GoogleLessonEventProcessor(
        queue = queue,
        properties = properties,
        googleAccountClient = googleAccountClient,
        googleCalendarClient = googleCalendarClient,
        accessTokenRefresher = accessTokenRefresher
    )

    @BeforeEach
    fun setUp() {
        clearAllMocks()
    }

    @AfterEach
    fun tearDown() {
        queue.drain(100)
    }

    @Test
    fun `processQueue should send batch when account exists`() {
        val userId = UUID.randomUUID()
        val event = sampleEvent()
        queue.enqueue(LessonSyncTask(userId = userId, event = event))

        every { googleAccountClient.getAccount(userId) } returns GoogleAccountDto(userId, "access", "refresh", "calendar")
        every { googleCalendarClient.createEventsBatch("access", "calendar", any()) } returns Unit

        processor.processQueue()

        verify(exactly = 1) { googleCalendarClient.createEventsBatch("access", "calendar", match { it.size == 1 }) }
    }

    @Test
    fun `processQueue should refresh token on failure`() {
        val userId = UUID.randomUUID()
        val event = sampleEvent()
        queue.enqueue(LessonSyncTask(userId = userId, event = event))

        every { googleAccountClient.getAccount(userId) } returns GoogleAccountDto(userId, "stale", "refresh-token", "calendar")
        every { googleCalendarClient.createEventsBatch("stale", "calendar", any()) } throws RuntimeException("unauthorized")
        every { accessTokenRefresher.refresh("refresh-token") } returns "new-token"
        every { googleCalendarClient.createEventsBatch("new-token", "calendar", any()) } returns Unit
        every { googleAccountClient.updateAccessToken(userId, "new-token") } just Runs

        processor.processQueue()

        verify(exactly = 1) { googleCalendarClient.createEventsBatch("stale", "calendar", any()) }
        verify(exactly = 1) { accessTokenRefresher.refresh("refresh-token") }
        verify(exactly = 1) { googleCalendarClient.createEventsBatch("new-token", "calendar", any()) }
        verify(exactly = 1) { googleAccountClient.updateAccessToken(userId, "new-token") }
    }

    @Test
    fun `processQueue should schedule retry when sync fails`() {
        val userId = UUID.randomUUID()
        val event = sampleEvent()
        queue.enqueue(LessonSyncTask(userId = userId, event = event))

        every { googleAccountClient.getAccount(userId) } returns GoogleAccountDto(userId, "stale", "refresh-token", "calendar")
        every { googleCalendarClient.createEventsBatch("stale", "calendar", any()) } throws RuntimeException("unauthorized")
        every { accessTokenRefresher.refresh("refresh-token") } returns null

        processor.processQueue()

        Thread.sleep(20)
        val retryTasks = queue.drain(10)
        assertEquals(1, retryTasks.size)
        assertEquals(1, retryTasks.first().attempt)
    }

    private fun sampleEvent(): LessonCreatedEvent {
        return LessonCreatedEvent(
            lessonId = UUID.randomUUID(),
            contractId = UUID.randomUUID(),
            scheduleId = UUID.randomUUID(),
            startAt = Instant.now(),
            duration = Duration.ofMinutes(60),
            status = "SCHEDULED"
        )
    }
}

package ru.teachify.common.client

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
import org.springframework.core.ParameterizedTypeReference
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient
import ru.teachify.common.contract.dto.ContractDto
import java.util.*

@Component
class ContractServiceClient(
    private val restClient: RestClient,
    @param:Value("\${clients.contract-service.url}") private val baseUrl: String
) {

    fun getByPerformer(profileId: UUID): List<ContractDto> =
        fetchContracts("$baseUrl/api/contracts/performers/{id}", profileId)

    fun getByClient(profileId: UUID): List<ContractDto> =
        fetchContracts("$baseUrl/api/contracts/clients/{id}", profileId)

    fun getContract(contractId: UUID): ContractDto {
        return restClient.get()
            .uri("$baseUrl/api/contracts/{id}", contractId)
            .retrieve()
            .body(ContractDto::class.java)
            ?: throw IllegalStateException("Contract $contractId not found")
    }

    private fun fetchContracts(url: String, profileId: UUID): List<ContractDto> {
        return restClient.get()
            .uri(url, profileId)
            .retrieve()
            .body(object : ParameterizedTypeReference<List<ContractDto>>() {})
            ?: emptyList()
    }
}

package ru.teachify.common.client

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
import org.springframework.core.ParameterizedTypeReference
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.web.client.HttpClientErrorException
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@Component
class LessonServiceClient(
    private val restClient: RestClient,
    @param:Value("\${clients.lesson-service.url}") private val baseUrl: String
) {

    fun listByContract(contractId: UUID, from: Instant, to: Instant): List<LessonDto> {
        return restClient.get()
            .uri("$baseUrl/api/lessons/by-contract/{contractId}?from={from}&to={to}", contractId, from, to)
            .retrieve()
            .body(object : ParameterizedTypeReference<List<LessonDto>>() {})
            ?: emptyList()
    }

    fun getGoogleEventMapping(lessonId: UUID): GoogleEventMappingDto? {
        return try {
            restClient.get()
                .uri("$baseUrl/api/internal/lessons/{lessonId}/google-event", lessonId)
                .retrieve()
                .body(GoogleEventMappingDto::class.java)
        } catch (ex: HttpClientErrorException.NotFound) {
            null
        }
    }

    fun storeGoogleEventMapping(lessonId: UUID, googleEventId: String): GoogleEventMappingDto {
        return restClient.post()
            .uri("$baseUrl/api/internal/lessons/{lessonId}/google-event", lessonId)
            .body(StoreGoogleEventMappingRequestDto(googleEventId))
            .retrieve()
            .body(GoogleEventMappingDto::class.java)
            ?: throw IllegalStateException("Failed to store Google event mapping")
    }

    fun deleteGoogleEventMapping(lessonId: UUID) {
        try {
            restClient.delete()
                .uri("$baseUrl/api/internal/lessons/{lessonId}/google-event", lessonId)
                .retrieve()
                .toBodilessEntity()
        } catch (ex: HttpClientErrorException) {
            if (ex.statusCode != HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND) {
                throw ex
            }
        }
    }

    fun cleanupGoogleEvents(userId: UUID) {
        restClient.delete()
            .uri("$baseUrl/api/internal/lessons/google-events/cleanup?userId={userId}", userId)
            .retrieve()
            .toBodilessEntity()
    }
}

data class LessonDto(
    val id: UUID,
    val contractId: UUID,
    val scheduleId: UUID?,
    val startAt: Instant,
    val durationMinutes: Long,
    val status: String,
    val createdAt: Instant,
    val colorHex: String?
)

data class GoogleEventMappingDto(
    val lessonId: UUID,
    val googleEventId: String,
    val createdAt: Instant,
    val updatedAt: Instant
)

data class StoreGoogleEventMappingRequestDto(
    val googleEventId: String
)

package ru.teachify.common.config

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper
import org.springframework.amqp.core.Binding
import org.springframework.amqp.core.BindingBuilder
import org.springframework.amqp.core.Queue
import org.springframework.amqp.core.TopicExchange
import org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.connection.ConnectionFactory
import org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.core.RabbitTemplate
import org.springframework.amqp.support.converter.Jackson2JsonMessageConverter
import org.springframework.amqp.support.converter.MessageConverter
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration

@Configuration
class RabbitConfig(
    @param:Value("\${app.rabbitmq.exchange}") val lessonPendingExchange: String,
    @param:Value("\${app.rabbitmq.queue.lesson_pending}") val lessonPendingQueue: String,
    @param:Value("\${app.rabbitmq.routing_key.lesson_pending}") val lessonPendingRoutingKey: String,
) {

    @Bean
    fun notificationsExchange(): TopicExchange =
        TopicExchange(lessonPendingExchange)

    @Bean
    fun lessonPendingQueue(): Queue =
        Queue(lessonPendingQueue)

    @Bean
    fun lessonPendingBinding(): Binding =
        BindingBuilder.bind(lessonPendingQueue())
            .to(notificationsExchange())
            .with(lessonPendingRoutingKey)

    @Bean
    fun jsonMessageConverter(objectMapper: ObjectMapper): MessageConverter =
        Jackson2JsonMessageConverter(objectMapper)

    @Bean
    fun rabbitTemplate(
        connectionFactory: ConnectionFactory,
        messageConverter: MessageConverter
    ): RabbitTemplate =
        RabbitTemplate(connectionFactory).apply {
            this.messageConverter = messageConverter
        }
}

package ru.teachify.common.domain.model.base

abstract class AggregateRoot {
    @Transient
    private val domainEvents: MutableList<Any> = mutableListOf()

    protected fun registerEvent(event: Any) {
        domainEvents.add(event)
    }

    fun pullEvents(): List<Any> {
        val events = domainEvents.toList()
        domainEvents.clear()
        return events
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\common\bin\main\ru\teachify\common\security\AuthPropagationInterceptor.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.common.security

import org.springframework.context.annotation.Lazy
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders
import org.springframework.http.HttpRequest
import org.springframework.http.client.ClientHttpRequestExecution
import org.springframework.http.client.ClientHttpRequestInterceptor
import org.springframework.http.client.ClientHttpResponse
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component

@Component
class AuthPropagationInterceptor(
    @param:Lazy private val serviceAccountTokenProvider: ServiceAccountTokenProvider
) : ClientHttpRequestInterceptor {

    override fun intercept(
        request: HttpRequest,
        body: ByteArray,
        execution: ClientHttpRequestExecution
    ): ClientHttpResponse {
        val alreadySet = request.headers.containsKey(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION)
        if (!alreadySet) {
            val token = serviceAccountTokenProvider.getToken()
            request.headers.set(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer $token")
        }
        return execution.execute(request, body)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\common\bin\main\ru\teachify\common\security\ServiceAccountTokenProvider.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.common.security

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Qualifier
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.web.client.HttpClientErrorException
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference

@Component
class ServiceAccountTokenProvider(
    @param:Qualifier("serviceAccountRestClient") private val restClient: RestClient,
    private val jwtSettings: ru.teachify.security.JwtSettings,
    @param:Value("\${service-account.email}") private val serviceAccountEmail: String,
    @param:Value("\${service-account.password}") private val serviceAccountPassword: String,
    @param:Value("\${clients.auth-service.url}") private val authServiceUrl: String
) {
    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    private data class CachedToken(
        val token: String,
        val expiresAt: Instant
    ) {
        fun isExpired(): Boolean =
            Instant.now().isAfter(expiresAt.minusSeconds(300))
    }

    private val cachedToken = AtomicReference<CachedToken?>(null)

    fun getToken(): String {
        cachedToken.get()
            ?.takeIf { !it.isExpired() }
            ?.let { return it.token }

        return synchronized(this) {
            cachedToken.get()
                ?.takeIf { !it.isExpired() }
                ?.let { return it.token }

            log.info { "Obtaining new service account token for $serviceAccountEmail" }
            val newToken = obtainToken()
            val tokenTtlSeconds = jwtSettings.accessTokenTtlMinutes * 60
            val expiresAt = Instant.now().plusSeconds(tokenTtlSeconds)
            cachedToken.set(CachedToken(newToken, expiresAt))
            log.info { "Service account token cached, expires at $expiresAt" }
            newToken
        }
    }

    private fun obtainToken(): String {
        val loginRequest = LoginRequest(
            email = serviceAccountEmail,
            password = serviceAccountPassword
        )

        return try {
            val response = restClient.post()
                .uri("$authServiceUrl/api/auth/login")
                .body(loginRequest)
                .retrieve()
                .body(TokenResponse::class.java)
                ?: throw IllegalStateException("Empty response from auth service")

            log.debug { "Successfully obtained service account token" }
            response.token
        } catch (ex: HttpClientErrorException) {
            log.error(ex) {
                "Failed to obtain service account token. HTTP ${ex.statusCode}: ${ex.message}. "
            }
            throw IllegalStateException("Failed to obtain service account token: ${ex.message}", ex)
        } catch (ex: Exception) {
            log.error(ex) { "Failed to obtain service account token: ${ex.message}" }
            throw IllegalStateException("Failed to obtain service account token: ${ex.message}", ex)
        }
    }

    private data class LoginRequest(
        val email: String,
        val password: String
    )

    private data class TokenResponse(
        val token: String
    )
}

<<<FILE path="app\common\bin\main\ru\teachify\security\JwtAuthenticationFilter.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.security

import io.jsonwebtoken.Claims
import io.jsonwebtoken.Jws
import io.jsonwebtoken.Jwts
import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys
import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse
import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.util.*

@Component
class JwtAuthenticationFilter(
    private val jwtSettings: JwtSettings,
    private val userRoleResolver: UserRoleResolver
) : OncePerRequestFilter() {

    override fun doFilterInternal(
        request: HttpServletRequest,
        response: HttpServletResponse,
        filterChain: FilterChain
    ) {
        val authHeader = request.getHeader("Authorization")
        if (!authHeader.isNullOrBlank() && authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
            val token = authHeader.removePrefix("Bearer ").trim()
            val principal = parseToken(token)
            if (principal != null) {
                val authentication = UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(principal, token, principal.authorities)
                SecurityContextHolder.getContext().authentication = authentication
            }
        }
        filterChain.doFilter(request, response)
    }

    private fun parseToken(token: String): UserPrincipal? {
        return try {
            val key = Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(jwtSettings.secret.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
            val jws: Jws<Claims> = Jwts.parser()
                .verifyWith(key)
                .build()
                .parseSignedClaims(token)

            val subject = jws.payload.subject
            val userId = UUID.fromString(subject)

            val roles: Set<String> = userRoleResolver.resolveRolesForUser(userId)
            UserPrincipal(userId = userId, roles = roles)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\common\bin\main\ru\teachify\security\UserPrincipal.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.security

import org.springframework.security.core.GrantedAuthority
import org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails
import java.util.UUID

data class UserPrincipal(
    val userId: UUID,
    val roles: Set<String> = emptySet()
) : UserDetails {

    override fun getAuthorities(): MutableCollection<out GrantedAuthority> =
        roles.map { role -> SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_" + role.removePrefix("ROLE_")) }.toMutableList()

    override fun getPassword(): String? = null

    override fun getUsername(): String = userId.toString()

    override fun isAccountNonExpired(): Boolean = true

    override fun isAccountNonLocked(): Boolean = true

    override fun isCredentialsNonExpired(): Boolean = true

    override fun isEnabled(): Boolean = true
}

<<<FILE path="app\common\bin\main\ru\teachify\security\UserProviderImpl.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.security

import org.springframework.security.authentication.AnonymousAuthenticationToken
import org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationCredentialsNotFoundException
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import java.util.*

@Component
class UserProviderImpl() : UserProvider {
    override fun getCurrentUserId(): UUID {
        val auth = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().authentication
            ?: throw AuthenticationCredentialsNotFoundException("No authentication")
        if (auth is AnonymousAuthenticationToken) {
            throw AuthenticationCredentialsNotFoundException("Anonymous user")
        }
        val principal = auth.principal as UserPrincipal
        return principal.userId
    }
}

package ru.teachify.common.client

import org.springframework.core.ParameterizedTypeReference
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient
import ru.teachify.common.contract.dto.ContractDto

    private val restClient: RestClient,
    @param:Value("\${clients.contract-service.url}") private val baseUrl: String
) {

    fun getByPerformer(profileId: UUID): List<ContractDto> =
        fetchContracts("$baseUrl/api/contracts/performers/{id}", profileId)

    fun getByClient(profileId: UUID): List<ContractDto> =
        fetchContracts("$baseUrl/api/contracts/clients/{id}", profileId)

    fun getContract(contractId: UUID): ContractDto {
        return restClient.get()
            .uri("$baseUrl/api/contracts/{id}", contractId)
            .retrieve()
            .body(ContractDto::class.java)
            ?: throw IllegalStateException("Contract $contractId not found")
    }

    private fun fetchContracts(url: String, profileId: UUID): List<ContractDto> {
        return restClient.get()
            .uri(url, profileId)
            .retrieve()
            .body(object : ParameterizedTypeReference<List<ContractDto>>() {})
            ?: emptyList()
    }
}

package ru.teachify.common.client

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
import org.springframework.core.ParameterizedTypeReference
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.web.client.HttpClientErrorException
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@Component
class LessonServiceClient(
    private val restClient: RestClient,
    @param:Value("\${clients.lesson-service.url}") private val baseUrl: String
) {

    fun listByContract(contractId: UUID, from: Instant, to: Instant): List<LessonDto> {
        return restClient.get()
            .uri("$baseUrl/api/lessons/by-contract/{contractId}?from={from}&to={to}", contractId, from, to)
            .retrieve()
            .body(object : ParameterizedTypeReference<List<LessonDto>>() {})
            ?: emptyList()
    }

    fun getGoogleEventMapping(lessonId: UUID): GoogleEventMappingDto? {
        return try {
            restClient.get()
                .uri("$baseUrl/api/internal/lessons/{lessonId}/google-event", lessonId)
                .retrieve()
                .body(GoogleEventMappingDto::class.java)
        } catch (ex: HttpClientErrorException.NotFound) {
            null
        }
    }

    fun storeGoogleEventMapping(lessonId: UUID, googleEventId: String): GoogleEventMappingDto {
        return restClient.post()
            .uri("$baseUrl/api/internal/lessons/{lessonId}/google-event", lessonId)
            .body(StoreGoogleEventMappingRequestDto(googleEventId))
            .retrieve()
            .body(GoogleEventMappingDto::class.java)
            ?: throw IllegalStateException("Failed to store Google event mapping")
    }

    fun deleteGoogleEventMapping(lessonId: UUID) {
        try {
            restClient.delete()
                .uri("$baseUrl/api/internal/lessons/{lessonId}/google-event", lessonId)
                .retrieve()
                .toBodilessEntity()
        } catch (ex: HttpClientErrorException) {
            if (ex.statusCode != HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND) {
                throw ex
            }
        }
    }

    fun cleanupGoogleEvents(userId: UUID) {
        restClient.delete()
            .uri("$baseUrl/api/internal/lessons/google-events/cleanup?userId={userId}", userId)
            .retrieve()
            .toBodilessEntity()
    }
}

data class LessonDto(
    val id: UUID,
    val contractId: UUID,
    val scheduleId: UUID?,
    val startAt: Instant,
    val durationMinutes: Long,
    val status: String,
    val createdAt: Instant,
    val colorHex: String?
)

data class GoogleEventMappingDto(
    val lessonId: UUID,
    val googleEventId: String,
    val createdAt: Instant,
    val updatedAt: Instant
)

data class StoreGoogleEventMappingRequestDto(
    val googleEventId: String
)

package ru.teachify.common.config

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper
import org.springframework.amqp.core.Binding
import org.springframework.amqp.core.BindingBuilder
import org.springframework.amqp.core.Queue
import org.springframework.amqp.core.TopicExchange
import org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.connection.ConnectionFactory
import org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.core.RabbitTemplate
import org.springframework.amqp.support.converter.Jackson2JsonMessageConverter
import org.springframework.amqp.support.converter.MessageConverter
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration

@Configuration
class RabbitConfig(
    @param:Value("\${app.rabbitmq.exchange}") val lessonPendingExchange: String,
    @param:Value("\${app.rabbitmq.queue.lesson_pending}") val lessonPendingQueue: String,
    @param:Value("\${app.rabbitmq.routing_key.lesson_pending}") val lessonPendingRoutingKey: String,
) {

    @Bean
    fun notificationsExchange(): TopicExchange =
        TopicExchange(lessonPendingExchange)

    @Bean
    fun lessonPendingQueue(): Queue =
        Queue(lessonPendingQueue)

    @Bean
    fun lessonPendingBinding(): Binding =
        BindingBuilder.bind(lessonPendingQueue())
            .to(notificationsExchange())
            .with(lessonPendingRoutingKey)

    @Bean
    fun jsonMessageConverter(objectMapper: ObjectMapper): MessageConverter =
        Jackson2JsonMessageConverter(objectMapper)

    @Bean
    fun rabbitTemplate(
        connectionFactory: ConnectionFactory,
        messageConverter: MessageConverter
    ): RabbitTemplate =
        RabbitTemplate(connectionFactory).apply {
            this.messageConverter = messageConverter
        }
}

package ru.teachify.common.domain.model.base

abstract class AggregateRoot {
    @Transient
    private val domainEvents: MutableList<Any> = mutableListOf()

    protected fun registerEvent(event: Any) {
        domainEvents.add(event)
    }

    fun pullEvents(): List<Any> {
        val events = domainEvents.toList()
        domainEvents.clear()
        return events
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\common\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\common\security\AuthPropagationInterceptor.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.common.security

import org.springframework.context.annotation.Lazy
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders
import org.springframework.http.HttpRequest
import org.springframework.http.client.ClientHttpRequestExecution
import org.springframework.http.client.ClientHttpRequestInterceptor
import org.springframework.http.client.ClientHttpResponse
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component

@Component
class AuthPropagationInterceptor(
    @param:Lazy private val serviceAccountTokenProvider: ServiceAccountTokenProvider
) : ClientHttpRequestInterceptor {

    override fun intercept(
        request: HttpRequest,
        body: ByteArray,
        execution: ClientHttpRequestExecution
    ): ClientHttpResponse {
        val alreadySet = request.headers.containsKey(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION)
        if (!alreadySet) {
            val token = serviceAccountTokenProvider.getToken()
            request.headers.set(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer $token")
        }
        return execution.execute(request, body)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\common\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\common\security\ServiceAccountTokenProvider.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.common.security

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Qualifier
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.web.client.HttpClientErrorException
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference

@Component
class ServiceAccountTokenProvider(
    @param:Qualifier("serviceAccountRestClient") private val restClient: RestClient,
    private val jwtSettings: ru.teachify.security.JwtSettings,
    @param:Value("\${service-account.email}") private val serviceAccountEmail: String,
    @param:Value("\${service-account.password}") private val serviceAccountPassword: String,
    @param:Value("\${clients.auth-service.url}") private val authServiceUrl: String
) {
    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    private data class CachedToken(
        val token: String,
        val expiresAt: Instant
    ) {
        fun isExpired(): Boolean =
            Instant.now().isAfter(expiresAt.minusSeconds(300))
    }

    private val cachedToken = AtomicReference<CachedToken?>(null)

    fun getToken(): String {
        cachedToken.get()
            ?.takeIf { !it.isExpired() }
            ?.let { return it.token }

        return synchronized(this) {
            cachedToken.get()
                ?.takeIf { !it.isExpired() }
                ?.let { return it.token }

            log.info { "Obtaining new service account token for $serviceAccountEmail" }
            val newToken = obtainToken()
            val tokenTtlSeconds = jwtSettings.accessTokenTtlMinutes * 60
            val expiresAt = Instant.now().plusSeconds(tokenTtlSeconds)
            cachedToken.set(CachedToken(newToken, expiresAt))
            log.info { "Service account token cached, expires at $expiresAt" }
            newToken
        }
    }

    private fun obtainToken(): String {
        val loginRequest = LoginRequest(
            email = serviceAccountEmail,
            password = serviceAccountPassword
        )

        return try {
            val response = restClient.post()
                .uri("$authServiceUrl/api/auth/login")
                .body(loginRequest)
                .retrieve()
                .body(TokenResponse::class.java)
                ?: throw IllegalStateException("Empty response from auth service")

            log.debug { "Successfully obtained service account token" }
            response.token
        } catch (ex: HttpClientErrorException) {
            log.error(ex) {
                "Failed to obtain service account token. HTTP ${ex.statusCode}: ${ex.message}. "
            }
            throw IllegalStateException("Failed to obtain service account token: ${ex.message}", ex)
        } catch (ex: Exception) {
            log.error(ex) { "Failed to obtain service account token: ${ex.message}" }
            throw IllegalStateException("Failed to obtain service account token: ${ex.message}", ex)
        }
    }

    private data class LoginRequest(
        val email: String,
        val password: String
    )

    private data class TokenResponse(
        val token: String
    )
}

<<<FILE path="app\common\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\security\JwtAuthenticationFilter.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.security

import io.jsonwebtoken.Claims
import io.jsonwebtoken.Jws
import io.jsonwebtoken.Jwts
import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys
import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse
import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.util.*

@Component
class JwtAuthenticationFilter(
    private val jwtSettings: JwtSettings,
    private val userRoleResolver: UserRoleResolver
) : OncePerRequestFilter() {

    override fun doFilterInternal(
        request: HttpServletRequest,
        response: HttpServletResponse,
        filterChain: FilterChain
    ) {
        val authHeader = request.getHeader("Authorization")
        if (!authHeader.isNullOrBlank() && authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
            val token = authHeader.removePrefix("Bearer ").trim()
            val principal = parseToken(token)
            if (principal != null) {
                val authentication = UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(principal, token, principal.authorities)
                SecurityContextHolder.getContext().authentication = authentication
            }
        }
        filterChain.doFilter(request, response)
    }

    private fun parseToken(token: String): UserPrincipal? {
        return try {
            val key = Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(jwtSettings.secret.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
            val jws: Jws<Claims> = Jwts.parser()
                .verifyWith(key)
                .build()
                .parseSignedClaims(token)

            val subject = jws.payload.subject
            val userId = UUID.fromString(subject)

            val roles: Set<String> = userRoleResolver.resolveRolesForUser(userId)
            UserPrincipal(userId = userId, roles = roles)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\common\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\security\UserPrincipal.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.security

import org.springframework.security.core.GrantedAuthority
import org.springframework.security.core.authority.SimpleGrantedAuthority
import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails
import java.util.UUID

data class UserPrincipal(
    val userId: UUID,
    val roles: Set<String> = emptySet()
) : UserDetails {

    override fun getAuthorities(): MutableCollection<out GrantedAuthority> =
        roles.map { role -> SimpleGrantedAuthority("ROLE_" + role.removePrefix("ROLE_")) }.toMutableList()

    override fun getPassword(): String? = null

    override fun getUsername(): String = userId.toString()

    override fun isAccountNonExpired(): Boolean = true

    override fun isAccountNonLocked(): Boolean = true

    override fun isCredentialsNonExpired(): Boolean = true

    override fun isEnabled(): Boolean = true
}

<<<FILE path="app\common\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\security\UserProviderImpl.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.security

import org.springframework.security.authentication.AnonymousAuthenticationToken
import org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationCredentialsNotFoundException
import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import java.util.*

@Component
class UserProviderImpl() : UserProvider {
    override fun getCurrentUserId(): UUID {
        val auth = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().authentication
            ?: throw AuthenticationCredentialsNotFoundException("No authentication")
        if (auth is AnonymousAuthenticationToken) {
            throw AuthenticationCredentialsNotFoundException("Anonymous user")
        }
        val principal = auth.principal as UserPrincipal
        return principal.userId
    }
}

package ru.teachify.contract.adapter.persistence.adapter

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.persistence.mapper.ContractMapper
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.persistence.repository.ContractJpaRepository
import ru.teachify.contract.domain.model.Contract
import ru.teachify.contract.domain.repository.ContractRepository
import java.util.*

@Component
class ContractRepositoryAdapter(
    private val jpaRepository: ContractJpaRepository
) : ContractRepository {

    override fun findById(id: UUID): Contract? {
        return jpaRepository.findById(id)
            .map(ContractMapper::toDomain)
            .orElse(null)
    }

    override fun save(contract: Contract): Contract {
        val entity = ContractMapper.toEntity(contract)
        return ContractMapper.toDomain(jpaRepository.save(entity))
    }

    override fun findAllByPerformerProfileId(performerProfileId: UUID): List<Contract> {
        return jpaRepository.findAllByPerformerProfileId(performerProfileId).map(ContractMapper::toDomain)
    }

    override fun findAllByClientProfileId(clientProfileId: UUID): List<Contract> {
        return jpaRepository.findAllByClientProfileId(clientProfileId).map(ContractMapper::toDomain)
    }
}

package ru.teachify.contract.adapter.persistence.adapter

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import ru.teachify.common.domain.error.NotFoundException
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.persistence.mapper.ScheduleMapper
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.persistence.repository.ScheduleJpaRepository
import ru.teachify.contract.domain.model.Schedule

class ScheduleRepositoryAdapter(
    private val repo: ScheduleJpaRepository
) : ScheduleRepository {
    override fun findById(id: UUID): Schedule =
        repo.findById(id).map(ScheduleMapper::toDomain)
            .orElseThrow { NotFoundException("Schedule", "id=$id") }

    override fun findAllByContractId(contractId: UUID): List<Schedule> =
        repo.findAllByContractId(contractId).map(ScheduleMapper::toDomain)

    override fun save(item: Schedule): Schedule =
        ScheduleMapper.toDomain(repo.save(ScheduleMapper.toEntity(item)))

    override fun deleteById(id: UUID) {
        repo.deleteById(id)
    }
}

        id = entity.id,
