import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation
import jakarta.validation.Valid
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
import ru.teachify.common.contract.dto.ContractDto
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.web.dto.request.CreateContractRequest
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.web.dto.request.UpdateContractRequest
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.web.dto.request.toCommand
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.web.dto.toDto
import ru.teachify.contract.application.dto.CreateContractCommand
import ru.teachify.contract.application.usecase.CreateContractUseCase
import ru.teachify.contract.application.usecase.GetContractUseCase
import ru.teachify.contract.application.usecase.ListContractsUseCase
import ru.teachify.contract.application.usecase.UpdateContractUseCase
import java.util.*

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/contracts")
class ContractController(
    private val createContractUseCase: CreateContractUseCase,
    private val getContractUseCase: GetContractUseCase,
    private val updateContractUseCase: UpdateContractUseCase,
    private val listContractsUseCase: ListContractsUseCase,
) {

    @PostMapping
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    fun create(@Valid @RequestBody request: CreateContractRequest): ContractDto {
        val createContractCommand = request.toCommand()
        val contract = createContractUseCase.execute(createContractCommand)
        return contract.toDto()
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµС‚ РІСЃРµ РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚С‹ РёСЃРїРѕР»РЅРёС‚РµР»СЏ")
    @GetMapping("/performers/{id}")
    fun getByPerformer(@PathVariable id: UUID): List<ContractDto> {
        return listContractsUseCase.byPerformer(id).map { it.toDto() }
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµС‚ РІСЃРµ РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚С‹ РєР»РёРµРЅС‚Р°")
    @GetMapping("/clients/{id}")
    fun getByClient(@PathVariable id: UUID): List<ContractDto> {
        return listContractsUseCase.byClient(id).map { it.toDto() }
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    fun getContract(@PathVariable id: UUID): ContractDto {
        return getContractUseCase.getById(id).toDto()
    }

    @PatchMapping
    fun updateContract(
        @Valid @RequestBody request: UpdateContractRequest
    ): ContractDto {
        return updateContractUseCase.update(request.toCommand()).toDto()
    }

    private fun CreateContractRequest.toCommand() = CreateContractCommand(
        performerProfileId = performerProfileId,
        clientProfileId = clientProfileId,
        courseId = courseId,
        price = price
    )
}

package ru.teachify.contract.adapter.web

import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation
import jakarta.validation.Valid
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.validation.annotation.Validated
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.web.dto.ScheduleResponse
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.web.dto.request.CreateScheduleRequest
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.web.dto.request.UpdateScheduleRequest
import ru.teachify.contract.application.dto.CreateScheduleCommand
import ru.teachify.contract.application.dto.UpdateScheduleCommand
import ru.teachify.contract.application.usecase.CreateScheduleUseCase
import ru.teachify.contract.application.usecase.DeleteScheduleUseCase
import ru.teachify.contract.application.usecase.ListScheduleUseCase
import ru.teachify.contract.application.usecase.UpdateScheduleUseCase
import ru.teachify.contract.domain.model.Schedule
import java.time.Duration
import java.util.*

@Validated
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/schedules")
class ScheduleController(
    private val createUseCase: CreateScheduleUseCase,
    private val listUseCase: ListScheduleUseCase,
    private val deleteUseCase: DeleteScheduleUseCase,
    private val updateUseCase: UpdateScheduleUseCase,
) {

    @PostMapping
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    fun create(
        @RequestBody @Valid body: CreateScheduleRequest
    ): ScheduleResponse {
        val command = CreateScheduleCommand(
            body.contractId,
            body.dayOfWeek,
            body.startTime,
            Duration.ofMinutes(body.durationMinutes)
        )
        val created: Schedule = createUseCase.execute(command)
        return created.toResponse()
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµС‚ РІСЃРµ СЂР°СЃРїРёСЃР°РЅРёСЏ РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚Р°")
    @GetMapping("/contracts/{id}")
    fun list(@PathVariable id: UUID): List<ScheduleResponse> =
        listUseCase.getByContractId(id).map { it.toResponse() }

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    fun delete(@PathVariable id: UUID) {
        deleteUseCase.execute(id)
    }

    @PatchMapping("/{id}")
    fun update(
        @PathVariable id: UUID,
        @RequestBody @Valid body: UpdateScheduleRequest
    ): ScheduleResponse {
        val command = UpdateScheduleCommand(
            body.dayOfWeek,
            body.startTime,
            body.durationMinutes?.let { Duration.ofMinutes(it) }
        )
        val updated = updateUseCase.execute(id, command)
        return updated.toResponse()
    }

    private fun Schedule.toResponse() = ScheduleResponse(
        id = id,
        dayOfWeek = dayOfWeek,
        startTime = startTime,
        durationMinutes = duration.toMinutes()
    )
}

    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    fun get(@PathVariable id: UUID): StudyProjectResponse {
        return getUseCase.execute(id).toResponse()
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµС‚ РІСЃРµ РїСЂРѕРµРєС‚С‹ РїРѕ РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚Сѓ")
    @GetMapping("/contracts/{contractId}")
    fun listByContract(@PathVariable contractId: UUID): List<StudyProjectResponse> {
        return listUseCase.getByContractId(contractId).map { it.toResponse() }
    }

    @PatchMapping("/{id}")
    fun update(
        @PathVariable id: UUID,
        @RequestBody @Valid body: UpdateStudyProjectRequest
    ): StudyProjectResponse {
        val command = UpdateStudyProjectCommand(
            name = body.name,
            description = body.description,
            startedAt = body.startedAt,
            status = body.status
        )
        return updateUseCase.execute(id, command).toResponse()
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    fun delete(@PathVariable id: UUID) {
        deleteUseCase.execute(id)
    }

    private fun StudyProject.toResponse() = StudyProjectResponse(
        id = id,
        contractId = contractId,
        name = name,
        description = description,
        startedAt = startedAt,
        status = status,
    )
}

package ru.teachify.contract.application.interactor

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.common.client.LessonServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.domain.error.NotFoundException
import ru.teachify.contract.application.dto.CreateContractCommand
import ru.teachify.contract.application.dto.UpdateContractCommand
import ru.teachify.contract.application.usecase.*
import ru.teachify.contract.domain.model.Contract
import ru.teachify.contract.domain.repository.ContractRepository
import ru.teachify.users.application.usecase.GetProfileUseCase
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.ProfileType
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit
import java.util.*

@Service
class CreateContractInteractor(
    private val contractRepository: ContractRepository,
    private val getCourse: GetCourseUseCase,
    private val findProfileUseCase: GetProfileUseCase
) : CreateContractUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: CreateContractCommand): Contract {
        getCourse.execute(command.courseId)
        val performerProfile = findProfileUseCase.execute(command.performerProfileId).profileType
        if (performerProfile != ProfileType.TUTOR) {
            throw IllegalArgumentException("Performer profile must be TUTOR")
        }

        val clientProfile = findProfileUseCase.execute(command.clientProfileId).profileType
        if (clientProfile != ProfileType.STUDENT) {
            throw IllegalArgumentException("Client profile must be a STUDENT")
        }

        val contract = Contract.create(
            performerProfileId = command.performerProfileId,
            clientProfileId = command.clientProfileId,
            courseId = command.courseId,
            price = command.price
        )
        return contractRepository.save(contract)
    }
}

@Service
class GetContractInteractor(
    private val contractRepository: ContractRepository
) : GetContractUseCase {
    override fun getById(id: UUID): Contract {
        return contractRepository.findById(id) ?: throw NotFoundException("Contract", "id")
    }
}

@Service
class UpdateContractInteractor(
    private val getContractUseCase: GetContractUseCase,
    private val contractRepository: ContractRepository,
    private val listScheduleUseCase: ListScheduleUseCase,
    private val lessonClient: LessonServiceClient,
) : UpdateContractUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun update(command: UpdateContractCommand): Contract {
        val contract = getContractUseCase.getById(command.contractId)
        if (!command.isActive && contract.isActive) {
            val scheduleds = listScheduleUseCase.getByContractId(contract.id)
            if (scheduleds.isNotEmpty()) {
                throw IllegalArgumentException("РќРµ СѓРґР°Р»РµРЅРѕ СЂР°СЃРїРёСЃР°РЅРёРµ")
            }
            val from = Instant.now()
            val to = from.plus(100, ChronoUnit.DAYS)

            val lessons = lessonClient.listByContract(contract.id, from, to)
            if (lessons.isNotEmpty()) {
                throw IllegalArgumentException("Р•СЃС‚СЊ Р·Р°РїР»Р°РЅРёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРЅС‹Рµ СѓСЂРѕРєРё РїРѕ РґР°РЅРЅРѕРјСѓ РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚Сѓ")
            }
        }
        contract.updateIsActive(command.isActive)
        contractRepository.save(contract)
        return contractRepository.save(contract)
    }

}

@Service
class ListContractsInteractor(
    private val contractRepository: ContractRepository
) : ListContractsUseCase {
    override fun byPerformer(performerProfileId: UUID): List<Contract> {
        return contractRepository.findAllByPerformerProfileId(performerProfileId)
    }

    override fun byClient(clientProfileId: UUID): List<Contract> {
        return contractRepository.findAllByClientProfileId(clientProfileId)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\contract-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\contract\application\interactor\ScheduleInteractors.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.contract.application.interactor

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.common.domain.event.DomainEventPublisher
import ru.teachify.contract.application.dto.CreateScheduleCommand
import ru.teachify.contract.application.dto.UpdateScheduleCommand
import ru.teachify.contract.application.usecase.*
import ru.teachify.contract.domain.model.Schedule
import ru.teachify.contract.domain.repository.ScheduleRepository
import java.util.*

@Service

class CreateScheduleInteractor(
    private val repository: ScheduleRepository,
    private val eventPublisher: DomainEventPublisher,
    private val getContractUseCase: GetContractUseCase,
) : CreateScheduleUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: CreateScheduleCommand): Schedule {
        val contract = getContractUseCase.getById(command.contractId)
        if (!contract.isActive)
            throw RuntimeException("РћР±СѓС‡РµРЅРёРµ РЅРµР°РєС‚РёРІРЅРѕ")
        val item = Schedule.create(
            command.contractId,
            command.dayOfWeek,
            command.startTime,
            command.duration
        )
        val savedItem = repository.save(item)
        eventPublisher.publish(item.pullEvents())
        return savedItem
    }
}

@Service
class ListScheduleInteractor(
    private val repository: ScheduleRepository,
) : ListScheduleUseCase {
    override fun getByContractId(contractId: UUID): List<Schedule> =
        repository.findAllByContractId(contractId)
}

@Service
class DeleteScheduleInteractor(
    private val repository: ScheduleRepository,
    private val eventPublisher: DomainEventPublisher,
) : DeleteScheduleUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(id: UUID) {
        val item = repository.findById(id)
        item.delete()
        repository.deleteById(id)
        eventPublisher.publish(item.pullEvents())
    }
}

@Service
class UpdateScheduleInteractor(
    private val repository: ScheduleRepository,
    private val eventPublisher: DomainEventPublisher,
) : UpdateScheduleUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(id: UUID, command: UpdateScheduleCommand): Schedule {
        val item = repository.findById(id)
        item.update(command.dayOfWeek, command.startTime, duration = command.duration)
        val savedItem = repository.save(item)
        eventPublisher.publish(item.pullEvents())
        return savedItem
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\contract-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\contract\domain\model\Contract.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.contract.domain.model

import java.math.BigDecimal
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

class Contract private constructor(
    val id: UUID,
    val performerProfileId: UUID,
    val clientProfileId: UUID,
    val courseId: UUID,
    val price: BigDecimal,
    var isActive: Boolean,
    val createdAt: Instant,
    var updatedAt: Instant,
) {

    fun updateIsActive(isActive: Boolean) {
        this.isActive = isActive
        this.updatedAt = Instant.now()
    }

    companion object {
        fun create(performerProfileId: UUID, clientProfileId: UUID, courseId: UUID, price: BigDecimal): Contract {
            require(performerProfileId != clientProfileId) { "Performer and client cannot be the same" }
            require(price > BigDecimal.ZERO) { "Price must be greater than 0" }
            val id = UUID.randomUUID()
            val now = Instant.now()
            return Contract(id, performerProfileId, clientProfileId, courseId, price, true, now, now)
        }

        fun fromPersistence(id: UUID, performerProfileId: UUID, clientProfileId: UUID, courseId: UUID, price: BigDecimal, isActive: Boolean, createdAt: Instant, updatedAt: Instant): Contract {
            return Contract(id, performerProfileId, clientProfileId, courseId, price, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt)
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\contract-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\contract\domain\model\Schedule.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.contract.domain.model

import ru.teachify.common.contract.dto.ScheduleDto
import ru.teachify.common.contract.event.ScheduleCreatedEvent
import ru.teachify.common.contract.event.ScheduleDeletedEvent
import ru.teachify.common.contract.event.ScheduleUpdatedEvent
import ru.teachify.common.domain.model.base.AggregateRoot
import java.time.DayOfWeek
import java.time.Duration
import java.time.OffsetTime
import java.util.*

class Schedule private constructor(
    val id: UUID,
    val contractId: UUID,
    var dayOfWeek: DayOfWeek,
    var startTime: OffsetTime,
    var duration: Duration,
) : AggregateRoot() {

    fun delete() {
        registerEvent(
            ScheduleDeletedEvent(
                scheduleId = this.id,
            )
        )
    }

    fun update(dayOfWeek: DayOfWeek?, startTime: OffsetTime?, duration: Duration? = null) {
        if (dayOfWeek == null && startTime == null) {
            return
        }

        dayOfWeek?.let { this.dayOfWeek = it }
        startTime?.let { this.startTime = it }
        duration?.let { this.duration = it }

        val dto = ScheduleDto(
            id = this.id,
            contractId = this.contractId,
            dayOfWeek = this.dayOfWeek,
            startTime = this.startTime,
            duration = this.duration
        )

        registerEvent(ScheduleUpdatedEvent(dto))
    }

    companion object {
        fun create(
            contractId: UUID,
            dayOfWeek: DayOfWeek,
            startTime: OffsetTime,
            duration: Duration
        ): Schedule {
            val id = UUID.randomUUID()
            val schedule = Schedule(id, contractId, dayOfWeek, startTime, duration)

            val dto = ScheduleDto(
                id = schedule.id,
                contractId = schedule.contractId,
                dayOfWeek = schedule.dayOfWeek,
                startTime = schedule.startTime,
                duration = schedule.duration
            )

            schedule.registerEvent(ScheduleCreatedEvent(dto))
            return schedule
        }

        fun fromPersistence(
            id: UUID,
            contractId: UUID,
            dayOfWeek: DayOfWeek,
            startTime: OffsetTime,
            duration: Duration
        ): Schedule {
            return Schedule(id, contractId, dayOfWeek, startTime, duration)
        }
    }
}

package ru.teachify.contract.domain.model

import java.time.LocalDate
import java.util.*

enum class StudyProjectStatus {
    CREATED,
    IN_PROGRESS,
}

class StudyProject private constructor(
    val id: UUID,
    val contractId: UUID,
    var name: String,
    var description: String?,
    var startedAt: LocalDate,
    var status: StudyProjectStatus,
) {

    fun update(
        name: String?,
        description: String?,
        startedAt: LocalDate?,
        status: StudyProjectStatus?
    ) {
        name?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { this.name = it }
        description?.let { this.description = it }
        startedAt?.let { this.startedAt = it }
        status?.let { this.status = it }
    }

    companion object {
        fun create(
            contractId: UUID,
            name: String,
            description: String?,
            startedAt: LocalDate,
            status: StudyProjectStatus = StudyProjectStatus.CREATED
        ): StudyProject {
            require(name.isNotBlank()) { "Study project name must not be blank" }
            return StudyProject(
                id = UUID.randomUUID(),
                contractId = contractId,
                name = name,
                description = description,
                startedAt = startedAt,
                status = status
            )
        }

        fun fromPersistence(
            id: UUID,
            contractId: UUID,
            name: String,
            description: String?,
            startedAt: LocalDate,
            status: StudyProjectStatus
        ): StudyProject {
            return StudyProject(
                id = id,
                contractId = contractId,
                name = name,
                description = description,
                startedAt = startedAt,
                status = status
            )
        }
    }
}

package ru.teachify.contract.adapter.persistence.adapter

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.persistence.mapper.ContractMapper
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.persistence.repository.ContractJpaRepository
import ru.teachify.contract.domain.model.Contract
import ru.teachify.contract.domain.repository.ContractRepository
import java.util.*

@Component
class ContractRepositoryAdapter(
    private val jpaRepository: ContractJpaRepository
) : ContractRepository {

    override fun findById(id: UUID): Contract? {
        return jpaRepository.findById(id)
            .map(ContractMapper::toDomain)
            .orElse(null)
    }

    override fun save(contract: Contract): Contract {
        val entity = ContractMapper.toEntity(contract)
        return ContractMapper.toDomain(jpaRepository.save(entity))
    }

    override fun findAllByPerformerProfileId(performerProfileId: UUID): List<Contract> {
        return jpaRepository.findAllByPerformerProfileId(performerProfileId).map(ContractMapper::toDomain)
    }

    override fun findAllByClientProfileId(clientProfileId: UUID): List<Contract> {
        return jpaRepository.findAllByClientProfileId(clientProfileId).map(ContractMapper::toDomain)
    }
}

@Component

    private val repo: ScheduleJpaRepository
) : ScheduleRepository {

        repo.findById(id).map(ScheduleMapper::toDomain)
            .orElseThrow { NotFoundException("Schedule", "id=$id") }

        repo.findAllByContractId(contractId).map(ScheduleMapper::toDomain)

    override fun save(item: Schedule): Schedule =

    override fun deleteById(id: UUID) {

    }

package ru.teachify.contract.adapter.persistence.mapper

import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.persistence.entity.ScheduleEntity
import ru.teachify.contract.domain.model.Schedule
import java.time.DayOfWeek
import java.time.Duration

object ScheduleMapper {
    fun toEntity(item: Schedule): ScheduleEntity = ScheduleEntity(
        id = item.id,
        contractId = item.contractId,
        dayOfWeek = item.dayOfWeek.value,
        startTime = item.startTime,
        durationMinutes = item.duration.toMinutes(),
    )

    fun toDomain(entity: ScheduleEntity): Schedule = Schedule.fromPersistence(
        id = entity.id,
        contractId = entity.contractId,
        dayOfWeek = DayOfWeek.of(entity.dayOfWeek),
        startTime = entity.startTime,
        duration = Duration.ofMinutes(entity.durationMinutes),
    )
}

package ru.teachify.contract.adapter.web

import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation
import jakarta.validation.Valid
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
import ru.teachify.common.contract.dto.ContractDto
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.web.dto.request.CreateContractRequest
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.web.dto.request.UpdateContractRequest
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.web.dto.request.toCommand
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.web.dto.toDto
import ru.teachify.contract.application.dto.CreateContractCommand
import ru.teachify.contract.application.usecase.CreateContractUseCase
import ru.teachify.contract.application.usecase.GetContractUseCase
import ru.teachify.contract.application.usecase.ListContractsUseCase
import ru.teachify.contract.application.usecase.UpdateContractUseCase
import java.util.*

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/contracts")
class ContractController(
    private val createContractUseCase: CreateContractUseCase,
    private val getContractUseCase: GetContractUseCase,
    private val updateContractUseCase: UpdateContractUseCase,
    private val listContractsUseCase: ListContractsUseCase,
) {

    @PostMapping
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    fun create(@Valid @RequestBody request: CreateContractRequest): ContractDto {
        val createContractCommand = request.toCommand()
        val contract = createContractUseCase.execute(createContractCommand)
        return contract.toDto()
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµС‚ РІСЃРµ РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚С‹ РёСЃРїРѕР»РЅРёС‚РµР»СЏ")
    @GetMapping("/performers/{id}")
    fun getByPerformer(@PathVariable id: UUID): List<ContractDto> {
        return listContractsUseCase.byPerformer(id).map { it.toDto() }
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµС‚ РІСЃРµ РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚С‹ РєР»РёРµРЅС‚Р°")
    @GetMapping("/clients/{id}")
    fun getByClient(@PathVariable id: UUID): List<ContractDto> {
        return listContractsUseCase.byClient(id).map { it.toDto() }
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    fun getContract(@PathVariable id: UUID): ContractDto {
        return getContractUseCase.getById(id).toDto()
    }

    @PatchMapping
    fun updateContract(
        @Valid @RequestBody request: UpdateContractRequest
    ): ContractDto {
        return updateContractUseCase.update(request.toCommand()).toDto()
    }

    private fun CreateContractRequest.toCommand() = CreateContractCommand(
        performerProfileId = performerProfileId,
        clientProfileId = clientProfileId,
        courseId = courseId,
        price = price
    )
}

package ru.teachify.contract.adapter.web

import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation
import jakarta.validation.Valid
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.validation.annotation.Validated
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.web.dto.ScheduleResponse
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.web.dto.request.CreateScheduleRequest
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.web.dto.request.UpdateScheduleRequest
import ru.teachify.contract.application.dto.CreateScheduleCommand
import ru.teachify.contract.application.dto.UpdateScheduleCommand
import ru.teachify.contract.application.usecase.CreateScheduleUseCase
import ru.teachify.contract.application.usecase.DeleteScheduleUseCase
import ru.teachify.contract.application.usecase.ListScheduleUseCase
import ru.teachify.contract.application.usecase.UpdateScheduleUseCase
import ru.teachify.contract.domain.model.Schedule
import java.time.Duration
import java.util.*

@Validated
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/schedules")
class ScheduleController(
    private val createUseCase: CreateScheduleUseCase,
    private val listUseCase: ListScheduleUseCase,
    private val deleteUseCase: DeleteScheduleUseCase,
    private val updateUseCase: UpdateScheduleUseCase,
) {

    @PostMapping
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    fun create(
        @RequestBody @Valid body: CreateScheduleRequest
    ): ScheduleResponse {
        val command = CreateScheduleCommand(
            body.contractId,
            body.dayOfWeek,
            body.startTime,
            Duration.ofMinutes(body.durationMinutes)
        )
        val created: Schedule = createUseCase.execute(command)
        return created.toResponse()
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµС‚ РІСЃРµ СЂР°СЃРїРёСЃР°РЅРёСЏ РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚Р°")
    @GetMapping("/contracts/{id}")
    fun list(@PathVariable id: UUID): List<ScheduleResponse> =
        listUseCase.getByContractId(id).map { it.toResponse() }

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    fun delete(@PathVariable id: UUID) {
        deleteUseCase.execute(id)
    }

    @PatchMapping("/{id}")
    fun update(
        @PathVariable id: UUID,
        @RequestBody @Valid body: UpdateScheduleRequest
    ): ScheduleResponse {
        val command = UpdateScheduleCommand(
            body.dayOfWeek,
            body.startTime,
            body.durationMinutes?.let { Duration.ofMinutes(it) }
        )
        val updated = updateUseCase.execute(id, command)
        return updated.toResponse()
    }

    private fun Schedule.toResponse() = ScheduleResponse(
        id = id,
        dayOfWeek = dayOfWeek,
        startTime = startTime,
        durationMinutes = duration.toMinutes()
    )
}

package ru.teachify.contract.application.interactor

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.common.client.LessonServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.domain.error.NotFoundException
import ru.teachify.contract.application.dto.CreateContractCommand
import ru.teachify.contract.application.dto.UpdateContractCommand
import ru.teachify.contract.application.usecase.*
import ru.teachify.contract.domain.model.Contract
import ru.teachify.contract.domain.repository.ContractRepository
import ru.teachify.users.application.usecase.GetProfileUseCase
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.ProfileType
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit
import java.util.*

@Service
class CreateContractInteractor(
    private val contractRepository: ContractRepository,
    private val getCourse: GetCourseUseCase,
    private val findProfileUseCase: GetProfileUseCase
) : CreateContractUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: CreateContractCommand): Contract {
        getCourse.execute(command.courseId)
        val performerProfile = findProfileUseCase.execute(command.performerProfileId).profileType
        if (performerProfile != ProfileType.TUTOR) {
            throw IllegalArgumentException("Performer profile must be TUTOR")
        }

        val clientProfile = findProfileUseCase.execute(command.clientProfileId).profileType
        if (clientProfile != ProfileType.STUDENT) {
            throw IllegalArgumentException("Client profile must be a STUDENT")
        }

        val contract = Contract.create(
            performerProfileId = command.performerProfileId,
            clientProfileId = command.clientProfileId,
            courseId = command.courseId,
            price = command.price
        )
        return contractRepository.save(contract)
    }
}

@Service
class GetContractInteractor(
    private val contractRepository: ContractRepository
) : GetContractUseCase {
    override fun getById(id: UUID): Contract {
        return contractRepository.findById(id) ?: throw NotFoundException("Contract", "id")
    }
}

@Service
class UpdateContractInteractor(
    private val getContractUseCase: GetContractUseCase,
    private val contractRepository: ContractRepository,
    private val listScheduleUseCase: ListScheduleUseCase,
    private val lessonClient: LessonServiceClient,
) : UpdateContractUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun update(command: UpdateContractCommand): Contract {
        val contract = getContractUseCase.getById(command.contractId)
        if (!command.isActive && contract.isActive) {
            val scheduleds = listScheduleUseCase.getByContractId(contract.id)
            if (scheduleds.isNotEmpty()) {
                throw IllegalArgumentException("РќРµ СѓРґР°Р»РµРЅРѕ СЂР°СЃРїРёСЃР°РЅРёРµ")
            }
            val from = Instant.now()
            val to = from.plus(100, ChronoUnit.DAYS)

            val lessons = lessonClient.listByContract(contract.id, from, to)
            if (lessons.isNotEmpty()) {
                throw IllegalArgumentException("Р•СЃС‚СЊ Р·Р°РїР»Р°РЅРёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРЅС‹Рµ СѓСЂРѕРєРё РїРѕ РґР°РЅРЅРѕРјСѓ РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚Сѓ")
            }
        }
        contract.updateIsActive(command.isActive)
        contractRepository.save(contract)
        return contractRepository.save(contract)
    }

}

@Service
class ListContractsInteractor(
    private val contractRepository: ContractRepository
) : ListContractsUseCase {
    override fun byPerformer(performerProfileId: UUID): List<Contract> {
        return contractRepository.findAllByPerformerProfileId(performerProfileId)
    }

    override fun byClient(clientProfileId: UUID): List<Contract> {
        return contractRepository.findAllByClientProfileId(clientProfileId)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\contract-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\contract\application\interactor\ScheduleInteractors.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.contract.application.interactor

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.common.domain.event.DomainEventPublisher
import ru.teachify.contract.application.dto.CreateScheduleCommand
import ru.teachify.contract.application.dto.UpdateScheduleCommand
import ru.teachify.contract.application.usecase.*
import ru.teachify.contract.domain.model.Schedule
import ru.teachify.contract.domain.repository.ScheduleRepository
import java.util.*

@Service

class CreateScheduleInteractor(
    private val repository: ScheduleRepository,
    private val eventPublisher: DomainEventPublisher,
    private val getContractUseCase: GetContractUseCase,
) : CreateScheduleUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: CreateScheduleCommand): Schedule {
        val contract = getContractUseCase.getById(command.contractId)
        if (!contract.isActive)
            throw RuntimeException("РћР±СѓС‡РµРЅРёРµ РЅРµР°РєС‚РёРІРЅРѕ")
        val item = Schedule.create(
            command.contractId,
            command.dayOfWeek,
            command.startTime,
            command.duration
        )
        val savedItem = repository.save(item)
        eventPublisher.publish(item.pullEvents())
        return savedItem
    }
}

@Service
class ListScheduleInteractor(
    private val repository: ScheduleRepository,
) : ListScheduleUseCase {
    override fun getByContractId(contractId: UUID): List<Schedule> =
        repository.findAllByContractId(contractId)
}

@Service
class DeleteScheduleInteractor(
    private val repository: ScheduleRepository,
    private val eventPublisher: DomainEventPublisher,
) : DeleteScheduleUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(id: UUID) {
        val item = repository.findById(id)
        item.delete()
        repository.deleteById(id)
        eventPublisher.publish(item.pullEvents())
    }
}

@Service
class UpdateScheduleInteractor(
    private val repository: ScheduleRepository,
    private val eventPublisher: DomainEventPublisher,
) : UpdateScheduleUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(id: UUID, command: UpdateScheduleCommand): Schedule {
        val item = repository.findById(id)
        item.update(command.dayOfWeek, command.startTime, duration = command.duration)
        val savedItem = repository.save(item)
        eventPublisher.publish(item.pullEvents())
        return savedItem
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\contract-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\contract\domain\model\Contract.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.contract.domain.model

import java.math.BigDecimal
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

class Contract private constructor(
    val id: UUID,
    val performerProfileId: UUID,
    val clientProfileId: UUID,
    val courseId: UUID,
    val price: BigDecimal,
    var isActive: Boolean,
    val createdAt: Instant,
    var updatedAt: Instant,
) {

    fun updateIsActive(isActive: Boolean) {
        this.isActive = isActive
        this.updatedAt = Instant.now()
    }

    companion object {
        fun create(performerProfileId: UUID, clientProfileId: UUID, courseId: UUID, price: BigDecimal): Contract {
            require(performerProfileId != clientProfileId) { "Performer and client cannot be the same" }
            require(price > BigDecimal.ZERO) { "Price must be greater than 0" }
            val id = UUID.randomUUID()
            val now = Instant.now()
            return Contract(id, performerProfileId, clientProfileId, courseId, price, true, now, now)
        }

        fun fromPersistence(id: UUID, performerProfileId: UUID, clientProfileId: UUID, courseId: UUID, price: BigDecimal, isActive: Boolean, createdAt: Instant, updatedAt: Instant): Contract {
            return Contract(id, performerProfileId, clientProfileId, courseId, price, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt)
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\contract-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\contract\domain\model\Schedule.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.contract.domain.model

import ru.teachify.common.contract.dto.ScheduleDto
import ru.teachify.common.contract.event.ScheduleCreatedEvent
import ru.teachify.common.contract.event.ScheduleDeletedEvent
import ru.teachify.common.contract.event.ScheduleUpdatedEvent
import ru.teachify.common.domain.model.base.AggregateRoot
import java.time.DayOfWeek
import java.time.Duration
import java.time.OffsetTime
import java.util.*

class Schedule private constructor(
    val id: UUID,
    val contractId: UUID,
    var dayOfWeek: DayOfWeek,
    var startTime: OffsetTime,
    var duration: Duration,
) : AggregateRoot() {

    fun delete() {
        registerEvent(
            ScheduleDeletedEvent(
                scheduleId = this.id,
            )
        )
    }

    fun update(dayOfWeek: DayOfWeek?, startTime: OffsetTime?, duration: Duration? = null) {
        if (dayOfWeek == null && startTime == null) {
            return
        }

        dayOfWeek?.let { this.dayOfWeek = it }
        startTime?.let { this.startTime = it }
        duration?.let { this.duration = it }

        val dto = ScheduleDto(
            id = this.id,
            contractId = this.contractId,
            dayOfWeek = this.dayOfWeek,
            startTime = this.startTime,
            duration = this.duration
        )

        registerEvent(ScheduleUpdatedEvent(dto))
    }

    companion object {
        fun create(
            contractId: UUID,
            dayOfWeek: DayOfWeek,
            startTime: OffsetTime,
            duration: Duration
        ): Schedule {
            val id = UUID.randomUUID()
            val schedule = Schedule(id, contractId, dayOfWeek, startTime, duration)

            val dto = ScheduleDto(
                id = schedule.id,
                contractId = schedule.contractId,
                dayOfWeek = schedule.dayOfWeek,
                startTime = schedule.startTime,
                duration = schedule.duration
            )

            schedule.registerEvent(ScheduleCreatedEvent(dto))
            return schedule
        }

        fun fromPersistence(
            id: UUID,
            contractId: UUID,
            dayOfWeek: DayOfWeek,
            startTime: OffsetTime,
            duration: Duration
        ): Schedule {
            return Schedule(id, contractId, dayOfWeek, startTime, duration)
        }
    }
}

package ru.teachify.contract.domain.model

import java.time.LocalDate
import java.util.*

enum class StudyProjectStatus {
    CREATED,
    IN_PROGRESS,
}

class StudyProject private constructor(
    val id: UUID,
    val contractId: UUID,
    var name: String,
    var description: String?,
    var startedAt: LocalDate,
    var status: StudyProjectStatus,
) {

    fun update(
        name: String?,
        description: String?,
        startedAt: LocalDate?,
        status: StudyProjectStatus?
    ) {
        name?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { this.name = it }
        description?.let { this.description = it }
        startedAt?.let { this.startedAt = it }
        status?.let { this.status = it }
    }

    companion object {
        fun create(
            contractId: UUID,
            name: String,
            description: String?,
            startedAt: LocalDate,
            status: StudyProjectStatus = StudyProjectStatus.CREATED
        ): StudyProject {
            require(name.isNotBlank()) { "Study project name must not be blank" }
            return StudyProject(
                id = UUID.randomUUID(),
                contractId = contractId,
                name = name,
                description = description,
                startedAt = startedAt,
                status = status
            )
        }

        fun fromPersistence(
            id: UUID,
            contractId: UUID,
            name: String,
            description: String?,
            startedAt: LocalDate,
            status: StudyProjectStatus
        ): StudyProject {
            return StudyProject(
                id = id,
                contractId = contractId,
                name = name,
                description = description,
                startedAt = startedAt,
                status = status
            )
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\gradlew" type="gradlew">>>

#!/bin/sh

#
# Copyright В© 2015-2021 the original authors.
#
# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You may obtain a copy of the License at
#
#      https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
#
# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#

##############################################################################
#
#   Gradle start up script for POSIX generated by Gradle.
#
#   Important for running:
#
#   (1) You need a POSIX-compliant shell to run this script. If your /bin/sh is
#       noncompliant, but you have some other compliant shell such as ksh or
#       bash, then to run this script, type that shell name before the whole
#       command line, like:
#
#           ksh Gradle
#
#       Busybox and similar reduced shells will NOT work, because this script
#       requires all of these POSIX shell features:
#         * functions;
#         * expansions В«$varВ», В«${var}В», В«${var:-default}В», В«${var+SET}В»,
#           В«${var#prefix}В», В«${var%suffix}В», and В«$( cmd )В»;
#         * compound commands having a testable exit status, especially В«caseВ»;
#         * various built-in commands including В«commandВ», В«setВ», and В«ulimitВ».
#
#   Important for patching:
#
#   (2) This script targets any POSIX shell, so it avoids extensions provided
#       by Bash, Ksh, etc; in particular arrays are avoided.
#
#       The "traditional" practice of packing multiple parameters into a
#       space-separated string is a well documented source of bugs and security
#       problems, so this is (mostly) avoided, by progressively accumulating
#       options in "$@", and eventually passing that to Java.
#
#       Where the inherited environment variables (DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS,
#       and GRADLE_OPTS) rely on word-splitting, this is performed explicitly;
#       see the in-line comments for details.
#
#       There are tweaks for specific operating systems such as AIX, CygWin,
#       Darwin, MinGW, and NonStop.
#
#   (3) This script is generated from the Groovy template
#       https://github.com/gradle/gradle/blob/HEAD/platforms/jvm/plugins-application/src/main/resources/org/gradle/api/internal/plugins/unixStartScript.txt
#       within the Gradle project.
#
#       You can find Gradle at https://github.com/gradle/gradle/.
#
##############################################################################

# Attempt to set APP_HOME

# Resolve links: $0 may be a link
app_path=$0

# Need this for daisy-chained symlinks.
while
    APP_HOME=${app_path%"${app_path##*/}"}  # leaves a trailing /; empty if no leading path
    [ -h "$app_path" ]
do
    ls=$( ls -ld "$app_path" )
    link=${ls#*' -> '}
    case $link in             #(
      /*)   app_path=$link ;; #(
      *)    app_path=$APP_HOME$link ;;
    esac
done

# This is normally unused
# shellcheck disable=SC2034
APP_BASE_NAME=${0##*/}
# Discard cd standard output in case $CDPATH is set (https://github.com/gradle/gradle/issues/25036)
APP_HOME=$( cd -P "${APP_HOME:-./}" > /dev/null && printf '%s\n' "$PWD" ) || exit

# Use the maximum available, or set MAX_FD != -1 to use that value.
MAX_FD=maximum

warn () {
    echo "$*"
} >&2

die () {
    echo
    echo "$*"
    echo
    exit 1
} >&2

# OS specific support (must be 'true' or 'false').
cygwin=false
msys=false
darwin=false
nonstop=false
case "$( uname )" in                #(
  CYGWIN* )         cygwin=true  ;; #(
  Darwin* )         darwin=true  ;; #(
  MSYS* | MINGW* )  msys=true    ;; #(
  NONSTOP* )        nonstop=true ;;
esac

CLASSPATH="\\\"\\\""


# Determine the Java command to use to start the JVM.
if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
    if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ] ; then
        # IBM's JDK on AIX uses strange locations for the executables
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java
    else
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/bin/java
    fi
    if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: $JAVA_HOME

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
else
    JAVACMD=java
    if ! command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1
    then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH.

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
fi

# Increase the maximum file descriptors if we can.
if ! "$cygwin" && ! "$darwin" && ! "$nonstop" ; then
    case $MAX_FD in #(
      max*)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -H is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        MAX_FD=$( ulimit -H -n ) ||
            warn "Could not query maximum file descriptor limit"
    esac
    case $MAX_FD in  #(
      '' | soft) :;; #(
      *)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -n is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        ulimit -n "$MAX_FD" ||
            warn "Could not set maximum file descriptor limit to $MAX_FD"
    esac
fi

# Collect all arguments for the java command, stacking in reverse order:
#   * args from the command line
#   * the main class name
#   * -classpath
#   * -D...appname settings
#   * --module-path (only if needed)
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and GRADLE_OPTS environment variables.

# For Cygwin or MSYS, switch paths to Windows format before running java
if "$cygwin" || "$msys" ; then
    APP_HOME=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$APP_HOME" )
    CLASSPATH=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$CLASSPATH" )

    JAVACMD=$( cygpath --unix "$JAVACMD" )

    # Now convert the arguments - kludge to limit ourselves to /bin/sh
    for arg do
        if
            case $arg in                                #(
              -*)   false ;;                            # don't mess with options #(
              /?*)  t=${arg#/} t=/${t%%/*}              # looks like a POSIX filepath
                    [ -e "$t" ] ;;                      #(
              *)    false ;;
            esac
        then
            arg=$( cygpath --path --ignore --mixed "$arg" )
        fi
        # Roll the args list around exactly as many times as the number of
        # args, so each arg winds up back in the position where it started, but
        # possibly modified.
        #
        # NB: a `for` loop captures its iteration list before it begins, so
        # changing the positional parameters here affects neither the number of
        # iterations, nor the values presented in `arg`.
        shift                   # remove old arg
        set -- "$@" "$arg"      # push replacement arg
    done
fi


# Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS='"-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"'

# Collect all arguments for the java command:
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and optsEnvironmentVar are not allowed to contain shell fragments,
#     and any embedded shellness will be escaped.
#   * For example: A user cannot expect ${Hostname} to be expanded, as it is an environment variable and will be
#     treated as '${Hostname}' itself on the command line.

set -- \
        "-Dorg.gradle.appname=$APP_BASE_NAME" \
        -classpath "$CLASSPATH" \
        -jar "$APP_HOME/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar" \
        "$@"

# Stop when "xargs" is not available.
if ! command -v xargs >/dev/null 2>&1
then
    die "xargs is not available"
fi

# Use "xargs" to parse quoted args.
#
# With -n1 it outputs one arg per line, with the quotes and backslashes removed.
#
# In Bash we could simply go:
#
#   readarray ARGS < <( xargs -n1 <<<"$var" ) &&
#   set -- "${ARGS[@]}" "$@"
#
# but POSIX shell has neither arrays nor command substitution, so instead we
# post-process each arg (as a line of input to sed) to backslash-escape any
# character that might be a shell metacharacter, then use eval to reverse
# that process (while maintaining the separation between arguments), and wrap
# the whole thing up as a single "set" statement.
#
# This will of course break if any of these variables contains a newline or
# an unmatched quote.
#

eval "set -- $(
        printf '%s\n' "$DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS $JAVA_OPTS $GRADLE_OPTS" |
        xargs -n1 |
        sed ' s~[^-[:alnum:]+,./:=@_]~\\&~g; ' |
        tr '\n' ' '
    )" '"$@"'

exec "$JAVACMD" "$@"

@rem
@rem Copyright 2015 the original author or authors.

@rem Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");

@rem
@rem Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
@rem distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
@rem WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
@rem See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
@rem limitations under the License.
@rem
@rem SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
@rem

@if "%DEBUG%"=="" @echo off
@rem ##########################################################################
@rem
@rem  Gradle startup script for Windows
@rem
@rem ##########################################################################

@rem Set local scope for the variables with windows NT shell
if "%OS%"=="Windows_NT" setlocal

set DIRNAME=%~dp0
if "%DIRNAME%"=="" set DIRNAME=.
@rem This is normally unused
set APP_BASE_NAME=%~n0
set APP_HOME=%DIRNAME%

@rem Resolve any "." and ".." in APP_HOME to make it shorter.
for %%i in ("%APP_HOME%") do set APP_HOME=%%~fi

@rem Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
set DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS="-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"

@rem Find java.exe
if defined JAVA_HOME goto findJavaFromJavaHome

set JAVA_EXE=java.exe
%JAVA_EXE% -version >NUL 2>&1
if %ERRORLEVEL% equ 0 goto execute

echo. 1>&2
echo ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH. 1>&2
echo. 1>&2
echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the 1>&2
echo location of your Java installation. 1>&2

goto fail

:findJavaFromJavaHome
set JAVA_HOME=%JAVA_HOME:"=%
set JAVA_EXE=%JAVA_HOME%/bin/java.exe

if exist "%JAVA_EXE%" goto execute

echo. 1>&2
echo ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: %JAVA_HOME% 1>&2
echo. 1>&2
echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the 1>&2
echo location of your Java installation. 1>&2

goto fail

:execute
@rem Setup the command line

set CLASSPATH=


@rem Execute Gradle
"%JAVA_EXE%" %DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS% %JAVA_OPTS% %GRADLE_OPTS% "-Dorg.gradle.appname=%APP_BASE_NAME%" -classpath "%CLASSPATH%" -jar "%APP_HOME%\gradle\wrapper\gradle-wrapper.jar" %*

:end
@rem End local scope for the variables with windows NT shell
if %ERRORLEVEL% equ 0 goto mainEnd

:fail
rem Set variable GRADLE_EXIT_CONSOLE if you need the _script_ return code instead of
rem the _cmd.exe /c_ return code!
set EXIT_CODE=%ERRORLEVEL%
if %EXIT_CODE% equ 0 set EXIT_CODE=1
if not ""=="%GRADLE_EXIT_CONSOLE%" exit %EXIT_CODE%
exit /b %EXIT_CODE%

:mainEnd
if "%OS%"=="Windows_NT" endlocal

:omega

package ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.adapter

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.mapper.LessonMapper
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.repository.LessonJpaRepository
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.Lesson
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.LessonStatus
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.repository.LessonRepository
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@Component
class LessonRepositoryAdapter(
    private val repo: LessonJpaRepository
) : LessonRepository {
    override fun findById(id: UUID): Lesson? =
        repo.findById(id).map(LessonMapper::toDomain).orElse(null)

    override fun save(item: Lesson): Lesson =
        LessonMapper.toDomain(repo.save(LessonMapper.toEntity(item)))

    override fun deleteById(id: UUID) {
        repo.deleteById(id)
    }

    override fun saveAll(items: List<Lesson>) {
        if (items.isEmpty()) return
        val entities = items.map(LessonMapper::toEntity)
        repo.saveAll(entities)
    }

    override fun deleteAllByScheduleId(scheduleId: UUID) {
        repo.deleteAllByScheduleId(scheduleId)
    }

    override fun findAllByScheduleId(scheduleId: UUID): List<Lesson> =
        repo.findAllByScheduleId(scheduleId).map(LessonMapper::toDomain)

    override fun findAllByContractIdAndStartBetween(
        contractId: UUID,
        from: Instant,
        to: Instant
    ): List<Lesson> =
        repo.findAllByContractIdAndStartsAtBetween(contractId, from, to)
            .map(LessonMapper::toDomain)

    override fun findAllByStatusAndStartsAtBefore(status: LessonStatus, before: Instant): List<Lesson> =
        repo.findAllByStatusAndStartsAtBefore(status, before).map(LessonMapper::toDomain)

    override fun findAllByContractId(contractId: UUID): List<Lesson> =
        repo.findAllByContractId(contractId).map(LessonMapper::toDomain)
}

package ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.mapper

import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.entity.AvailabilitySlotEntity
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.AvailabilitySlot
import java.time.Duration

object AvailabilitySlotMapper {
    fun toEntity(slot: AvailabilitySlot): AvailabilitySlotEntity =
        AvailabilitySlotEntity(
            id = slot.id,
            tutorId = slot.tutorId,
            startsAt = slot.startAt,
            durationMinutes = slot.duration.toMinutes(),
            status = slot.status,
            shareToken = slot.shareToken,
            createdAt = slot.createdAt,
            bookedAt = slot.bookedAt,
            bookedPhone = slot.contact?.phone,
            bookedTelegram = slot.contact?.telegram,
        )

    fun toDomain(entity: AvailabilitySlotEntity): AvailabilitySlot =
        AvailabilitySlot.fromPersistence(
            id = entity.id,
            tutorId = entity.tutorId,
            startAt = entity.startsAt,
            duration = Duration.ofMinutes(entity.durationMinutes),
            status = entity.status,
            shareToken = entity.shareToken,
            createdAt = entity.createdAt,
            bookedAt = entity.bookedAt,
            contact = entity.bookedPhone?.let {
                AvailabilitySlot.BookingContact(
                    phone = it,
                    telegram = entity.bookedTelegram,
                )
            },
        )
}

package ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.repository

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.mapper.GoogleEventMapper
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.GoogleEvent
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.repository.GoogleEventRepository
import java.util.*

@Component
class GoogleEventRepositoryAdapter(
    private val jpaRepository: GoogleEventJpaRepository
) : GoogleEventRepository {

    override fun findByLessonId(lessonId: UUID): GoogleEvent? {
        return jpaRepository.findByLessonId(lessonId)?.let {
            GoogleEventMapper.toDomain(it)
        }
    }

    override fun save(event: GoogleEvent): GoogleEvent {
        val entity = GoogleEventMapper.toEntity(event)
        val saved = jpaRepository.save(entity)
        return GoogleEventMapper.toDomain(saved)
    }

    override fun deleteByLessonId(lessonId: UUID) {
        jpaRepository.deleteByLessonId(lessonId)
    }

    override fun existsByLessonId(lessonId: UUID): Boolean {
        return jpaRepository.existsByLessonId(lessonId)
    }

    override fun findAllByLessonIds(lessonIds: List<UUID>): List<GoogleEvent> {
        if (lessonIds.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        return jpaRepository.findAllByLessonIdIn(lessonIds).map {
            GoogleEventMapper.toDomain(it)
        }
    }
}

package ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.repository

import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.entity.HomeworkEntity
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@Repository
interface HomeworkJpaRepository : JpaRepository<HomeworkEntity, UUID> {
    fun findByLessonId(lessonId: UUID): HomeworkEntity?

    @Query(
        """
        select h from HomeworkEntity h
        join LessonEntity l on l.id = h.lessonId
        where l.contractId = :contractId
          and l.startsAt between :from and :to
        order by l.startsAt desc
        """
    )
    fun findByContractIdAndInterval(
        @Param("contractId") contractId: UUID,
        @Param("from") from: Instant,
        @Param("to") to: Instant
    ): List<HomeworkEntity>
}

package ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.repository

import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository

import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.entity.LessonEntity

          and l.startsAt between :from and :to
        order by l.startsAt desc
        """
    )

    fun findAllByStatusAndStartsAtBefore(status: LessonStatus, before: Instant): List<LessonEntity>
    fun findAllByContractId(contractId: UUID): List<LessonEntity>

package ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web

import jakarta.validation.Valid
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.AvailabilitySlotResponse
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.request.CreateAvailabilitySlotRequest
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.request.toCreateAvailabilitySlotCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.toResponse
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.CancelAvailabilitySlotCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.CancelAvailabilitySlotUseCase
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.CreateAvailabilitySlotUseCase
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.GetAvailabilitySlotUseCase
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.ListAvailabilitySlotsUseCase
import java.util.*

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/availability-slots")
class AvailabilitySlotController(
    private val createAvailabilitySlotUseCase: CreateAvailabilitySlotUseCase,
    private val listAvailabilitySlotsUseCase: ListAvailabilitySlotsUseCase,
    private val getAvailabilitySlotUseCase: GetAvailabilitySlotUseCase,
    private val cancelAvailabilitySlotUseCase: CancelAvailabilitySlotUseCase,
) {

    @PostMapping
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TUTOR')")
    fun create(@RequestBody @Valid body: CreateAvailabilitySlotRequest): AvailabilitySlotResponse {
        val created = createAvailabilitySlotUseCase.execute(body.toCreateAvailabilitySlotCommand())
        return created.toResponse()
    }

    @GetMapping
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TUTOR')")
    fun list(): List<AvailabilitySlotResponse> {
        return listAvailabilitySlotsUseCase.execute().map { it.toResponse() }
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TUTOR')")
    fun get(@PathVariable id: UUID): AvailabilitySlotResponse {
        return getAvailabilitySlotUseCase.execute(id).toResponse()
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TUTOR')")
    fun cancel(@PathVariable id: UUID) {
        cancelAvailabilitySlotUseCase.execute(CancelAvailabilitySlotCommand(slotId = id))
    }
}

package ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto

import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.AvailabilitySlot
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.AvailabilitySlotStatus
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

data class AvailabilitySlotResponse(
    val id: UUID,
    val tutorId: UUID,
    val startAt: Instant,
    val durationMinutes: Long,
    val status: AvailabilitySlotStatus,
    val shareToken: String,
    val bookedAt: Instant?,
    val contact: AvailabilitySlotBookingContactDto?,
)

data class AvailabilitySlotBookingContactDto(
    val phone: String,
    val telegram: String?,
)

data class PublicAvailabilitySlotResponse(
    val startAt: Instant,
    val durationMinutes: Long,
    val status: AvailabilitySlotStatus,
    val isBookable: Boolean,
)

fun AvailabilitySlot.toResponse(): AvailabilitySlotResponse =
    AvailabilitySlotResponse(
        id = id,
        tutorId = tutorId,
        startAt = startAt,
        durationMinutes = duration.toMinutes(),
        status = status,
        shareToken = shareToken,
        bookedAt = bookedAt,
        contact = contact?.let {
            AvailabilitySlotBookingContactDto(
                phone = it.phone,
                telegram = it.telegram,
            )
        },
    )

fun AvailabilitySlot.toPublicResponse(): PublicAvailabilitySlotResponse =
    PublicAvailabilitySlotResponse(
        startAt = startAt,
        durationMinutes = duration.toMinutes(),
        status = status,
        isBookable = status == AvailabilitySlotStatus.AVAILABLE,
    )

package ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web

import jakarta.validation.Valid
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.HomeworkResponse
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.request.*
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.toResponse
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.AddHomeworkCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.*
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/homeworks")
class HomeworkController(
    private val getHomeworkUseCase: GetHomeworkUseCase,
    private val addHomeworkUseCase: AddHomeworkUseCase,
    private val updateHomeworkUseCase: UpdateHomeworkUseCase,
    private val markHomeworkCompletionUseCase: MarkHomeworkCompletionUseCase,
    private val reviewHomeworkUseCase: ReviewHomeworkUseCase,
) {

    @GetMapping("/by-lesson/{lessonId}")
    fun getHomework(
        @PathVariable lessonId: UUID
    ): HomeworkResponse? {
        return getHomeworkUseCase.byLessonId(lessonId)?.toResponse()
    }

    @GetMapping("/by-contract/{contractId}")
    fun getHomeworkByContract(
        @PathVariable contractId: UUID,
        @RequestParam from: Instant,
        @RequestParam to: Instant,
    ): List<HomeworkResponse> {
        return getHomeworkUseCase.byContractId(contractId, from, to).map { it.toResponse() }
    }

    @PostMapping
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TUTOR')")
    fun addHomework(
        @RequestBody @Valid body: AddHomeworkRequest
    ): HomeworkResponse {
        val command = AddHomeworkCommand(
            lessonId = body.lessonId,
            content = body.content
        )
        val created = addHomeworkUseCase.execute(command)
        return created.toResponse()
    }

    @PatchMapping
    fun updateHomework(@RequestBody request: UpdateHomeworkRequest): HomeworkResponse {
        val updated = updateHomeworkUseCase.execute(request.toCommand())
        return updated.toResponse()
    }

    @PatchMapping("/student-status")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('STUDENT')")
    fun markHomeworkCompletion(@RequestBody @Valid request: MarkHomeworkCompletionRequest): HomeworkResponse {
        val updated = markHomeworkCompletionUseCase.execute(request.toCommand())
        return updated.toResponse()
    }

    @PatchMapping("/tutor-review")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TUTOR')")
    fun reviewHomework(@RequestBody @Valid request: ReviewHomeworkRequest): HomeworkResponse {
        val updated = reviewHomeworkUseCase.execute(request.toCommand())
        return updated.toResponse()
    }
}

package ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web

import jakarta.validation.Valid
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.LessonResponse
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.request.ChangeLessonColorRequest
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.request.CreateLessonRequest
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.request.UpdateLessonRequest
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.request.toCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.toResponse
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.ChangeLessonColorCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.UpdateLessonCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.*
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.Lesson
import java.time.Duration
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/lessons")
class LessonController(
    private val createUseCase: CreateLessonUseCase,
    private val updateUseCase: UpdateLessonUseCase,
    private val deleteUseCase: DeleteLessonUseCase,
    private val getLessonUseCase: GetLessonUseCase,
    private val changeColorUseCase: ChangeLessonColorUseCase,
    private val getHomeworkUseCase: GetHomeworkUseCase,
) {

    @PostMapping
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TUTOR')")
    fun create(@RequestBody @Valid body: CreateLessonRequest): LessonResponse {
        val command = body.toCommand()
        val created: Lesson = createUseCase.execute(command)
        return created.toResponse()
    }

    @PatchMapping("/{id}")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TUTOR')")
    fun update(
        @PathVariable id: UUID,
        @RequestBody @Valid body: UpdateLessonRequest
    ): LessonResponse {
        val command = UpdateLessonCommand(
            startAt = body.startAt,
            duration = body.durationMinutes?.let { Duration.ofMinutes(it) },
            status = body.status,
        )
        val updated = updateUseCase.execute(id, command)
        return updated.toResponse()
    }

    @PatchMapping("/{id}/color")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TUTOR')")
    fun changeColor(
        @PathVariable id: UUID,
        @RequestBody body: ChangeLessonColorRequest
    ): LessonResponse {
        val updated = changeColorUseCase.execute(id, ChangeLessonColorCommand(colorHex = body.colorHex))
        return updated.toResponse()
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TUTOR')")
    fun delete(@PathVariable id: UUID) {
        deleteUseCase.execute(id)
    }

    @GetMapping("/by-contract/{contractId}")
    fun list(
        @PathVariable contractId: UUID,
        @RequestParam("from") from: Instant,
        @RequestParam("to") to: Instant,
    ): List<LessonResponse> {
        val lessons = getLessonUseCase.allByContractId(contractId, from, to)
        return lessons.map {
            it.toResponse(
                getHomeworkUseCase.byLessonId(it.id)?.toResponse()
            )
        }
    }

    @GetMapping("/{lessonId}")
    fun getLesson(
        @PathVariable lessonId: UUID
    ): LessonResponse = getLessonUseCase.byId(lessonId)
        .toResponse(getHomeworkUseCase.byLessonId(lessonId)?.toResponse())
}

package ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web

import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.GoogleEventMappingResponse
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.request.StoreGoogleEventMappingRequest
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.CleanupGoogleEventsUseCase
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.DeleteGoogleEventMappingUseCase
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.GetGoogleEventMappingUseCase
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.StoreGoogleEventMappingUseCase
import java.util.*

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/internal/lessons")
class LessonInternalController(
    private val getMapping: GetGoogleEventMappingUseCase,
    private val storeMapping: StoreGoogleEventMappingUseCase,
    private val deleteMapping: DeleteGoogleEventMappingUseCase,
    private val cleanupMapping: CleanupGoogleEventsUseCase
) {

    @GetMapping("/{lessonId}/google-event")
    fun getGoogleEventMapping(@PathVariable lessonId: UUID): GoogleEventMappingResponse? {
        val mapping = getMapping.execute(lessonId) ?: return null
        return GoogleEventMappingResponse(
            lessonId = mapping.lessonId,
            googleEventId = mapping.googleEventId,
            createdAt = mapping.createdAt,
            updatedAt = mapping.updatedAt
        )
    }

    @PostMapping("/{lessonId}/google-event")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    fun storeGoogleEventMapping(
        @PathVariable lessonId: UUID,
        @RequestBody request: StoreGoogleEventMappingRequest
    ): GoogleEventMappingResponse {
        val mapping = storeMapping.execute(lessonId, request.googleEventId)
        return GoogleEventMappingResponse(
            lessonId = mapping.lessonId,
            googleEventId = mapping.googleEventId,
            createdAt = mapping.createdAt,
            updatedAt = mapping.updatedAt
        )
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{lessonId}/google-event")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    fun deleteGoogleEventMapping(@PathVariable lessonId: UUID) {
        deleteMapping.execute(lessonId)
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/google-events/cleanup")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    fun cleanupGoogleEvents(@RequestParam userId: UUID) {
        cleanupMapping.execute(userId)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\lesson-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\lesson\application\interactor\AvailabilitySlotInteractors.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.lesson.application.interactor

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.common.domain.error.NotFoundException
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.BookAvailabilitySlotCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.CancelAvailabilitySlotCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.CreateAvailabilitySlotCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.*
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.AvailabilitySlot
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.AvailabilitySlotStatus
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.repository.AvailabilitySlotRepository
import ru.teachify.security.UserProvider
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*
import kotlin.random.Random

private val logger = KotlinLogging.logger {}

@Service
class CreateAvailabilitySlotInteractor(
    private val repository: AvailabilitySlotRepository,
    private val userProvider: UserProvider,
) : CreateAvailabilitySlotUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: CreateAvailabilitySlotCommand): AvailabilitySlot {
        val tutorId = userProvider.getCurrentUserId()
        val slot = AvailabilitySlot.create(
            tutorId = tutorId,
            startAt = command.startAt,
            duration = command.duration,
            shareToken = generateShareToken(),
        )
        val saved = repository.save(slot)
        logger.info { "Availability slot created: id=${saved.id}, tutorId=${saved.tutorId}, startAt=${saved.startAt}" }
        return saved
    }

    private fun generateShareToken(): String {
        val alphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"
        return buildString(12) {
            repeat(12) {
                append(alphabet[Random.nextInt(alphabet.length)])
            }
        }
    }
}

@Service
class ListAvailabilitySlotsInteractor(
    private val repository: AvailabilitySlotRepository,
    private val userProvider: UserProvider,
) : ListAvailabilitySlotsUseCase {

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    override fun execute(): List<AvailabilitySlot> {
        val tutorId = userProvider.getCurrentUserId()
        return repository.findAllByTutorId(tutorId)
    }
}

@Service
class GetAvailabilitySlotInteractor(
    private val repository: AvailabilitySlotRepository,
    private val userProvider: UserProvider,
) : GetAvailabilitySlotUseCase {

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    override fun execute(id: UUID): AvailabilitySlot {
        val tutorId = userProvider.getCurrentUserId()
        val slot = repository.findById(id) ?: throw NotFoundException("AvailabilitySlot", "id=$id")
        if (slot.tutorId != tutorId) {
            throw NotFoundException("AvailabilitySlot", "id=$id")
        }
        return slot
    }
}

@Service
class CancelAvailabilitySlotInteractor(
    private val repository: AvailabilitySlotRepository,
    private val getAvailabilitySlotUseCase: GetAvailabilitySlotUseCase,
) : CancelAvailabilitySlotUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: CancelAvailabilitySlotCommand) {
        val slot = getAvailabilitySlotUseCase.execute(command.slotId)
        slot.cancel()
        repository.save(slot)
        logger.info { "Availability slot canceled: id=${slot.id}" }
    }
}

@Service
class GetAvailabilitySlotByTokenInteractor(
    private val repository: AvailabilitySlotRepository,
) : GetAvailabilitySlotByTokenUseCase {

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    override fun execute(token: String): AvailabilitySlot {
        val slot = repository.findByShareToken(token)
            ?: throw NotFoundException("AvailabilitySlot", "token=$token")
        if (slot.status == AvailabilitySlotStatus.CANCELED) {
            throw NotFoundException("AvailabilitySlot", "token=$token")
        }
        return slot
    }
}

@Service
class BookAvailabilitySlotInteractor(
    private val repository: AvailabilitySlotRepository,
    private val getAvailabilitySlotByTokenUseCase: GetAvailabilitySlotByTokenUseCase,
) : BookAvailabilitySlotUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: BookAvailabilitySlotCommand): AvailabilitySlot {
        val slot = getAvailabilitySlotByTokenUseCase.execute(command.shareToken)
        slot.book(
            AvailabilitySlot.BookingContact(
                phone = command.phone,
                telegram = command.telegram,
            ),
            now = Instant.now(),
        )
        val saved = repository.save(slot)
        logger.info { "Availability slot booked: id=${saved.id}, token=${saved.shareToken}" }
        return saved
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\lesson-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\lesson\application\interactor\CleanupGoogleEventsInteractor.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.lesson.application.interactor

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.common.client.ContractServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.client.UserServiceClient
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.CleanupGoogleEventsUseCase
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.repository.GoogleEventRepository
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.repository.LessonRepository
import java.util.*

@Service
class CleanupGoogleEventsInteractor(
    private val googleEventRepository: GoogleEventRepository,
    private val lessonRepository: LessonRepository,
    private val contractServiceClient: ContractServiceClient,
    private val userServiceClient: UserServiceClient
) : CleanupGoogleEventsUseCase {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(userId: UUID) {
        log.info { "Cleaning up Google event mappings for user=$userId" }

        try {
            val user = userServiceClient.getUser(userId)
            val profile = user.activeProfile ?: run {
                log.debug { "No active profile for user=$userId, skipping cleanup" }
                return
            }

            val contracts = contractServiceClient.getByPerformer(profile.id)
            if (contracts.isEmpty()) {
                log.debug { "No active teaching contracts for user=$userId, nothing to clean up" }
                return
            }

            var deletedCount = 0
            contracts.forEach { contract ->
                val lessons = lessonRepository.findAllByContractId(contract.id)
                lessons.forEach { lesson ->
                    if (googleEventRepository.existsByLessonId(lesson.id)) {
                        googleEventRepository.deleteByLessonId(lesson.id)
                        deletedCount++
                    }
                }
            }

            if (deletedCount > 0) {
                log.info { "Cleaned up $deletedCount Google event mappings for user=$userId" }
            } else {
                log.debug { "No Google event mappings found to clean up for user=$userId" }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            log.error(e) { "Failed to cleanup Google event mappings for user=$userId" }
            throw e
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\lesson-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\lesson\application\interactor\GoogleEventInteractors.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.lesson.application.interactor

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.DeleteGoogleEventMappingUseCase
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.GetGoogleEventMappingUseCase
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.StoreGoogleEventMappingUseCase
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.GoogleEvent

import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@Service
class GetGoogleEventMappingInteractor(
    private val repository: GoogleEventRepository
) : GetGoogleEventMappingUseCase {

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    override fun execute(lessonId: UUID): GoogleEvent? {
        return repository.findByLessonId(lessonId)
    }
}

@Service
class StoreGoogleEventMappingInteractor(
    private val repository: GoogleEventRepository
) : StoreGoogleEventMappingUseCase {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(lessonId: UUID, googleEventId: String): GoogleEvent {
        val existing = repository.findByLessonId(lessonId)

        val event = if (existing != null) {
            log.debug { "Updating Google event mapping for lesson=$lessonId" }
            existing.copy(
                googleEventId = googleEventId,
                updatedAt = Instant.now()
            )
        } else {
            log.debug { "Creating Google event mapping for lesson=$lessonId" }
            val now = Instant.now()
            GoogleEvent(
                lessonId = lessonId,
                googleEventId = googleEventId,
                createdAt = now,
                updatedAt = now
            )
        }

        return repository.save(event)
    }
}

@Service
class DeleteGoogleEventMappingInteractor(
    private val repository: GoogleEventRepository
) : DeleteGoogleEventMappingUseCase {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(lessonId: UUID) {
        log.debug { "Deleting Google event mapping for lesson=$lessonId" }
        repository.deleteByLessonId(lessonId)
    }
}

package ru.teachify.lesson.application.interactor

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.common.domain.error.NotFoundException
import ru.teachify.common.domain.event.DomainEventPublisher
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.AddHomeworkCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.MarkHomeworkCompletionCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.ReviewHomeworkCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.UpdateHomeworkCommand
