import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.Homework
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.repository.HomeworkRepository
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@Service
class AddHomeworkInteractor(
    private val homeworkRepository: HomeworkRepository,
    private val eventPublisher: DomainEventPublisher,
    private val getLesson: GetLessonUseCase
) : AddHomeworkUseCase {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: AddHomeworkCommand): Homework {
        val lesson = getLesson.byId(command.lessonId)

        if (homeworkRepository.findByLessonId(command.lessonId) != null) {
            throw IllegalArgumentException("Homework for lesson ${command.lessonId} already exists")
        }
        val homework = Homework.create(lesson, command.content)
        val saved = homeworkRepository.save(homework)

        log.info { "Homework added: lessonId=${saved.lessonId}" }
        eventPublisher.publish(homework.pullEvents())
        return saved
    }
}

@Service
class GetHomeworkInteractor(
    private val homeworkRepository: HomeworkRepository,
) : GetHomeworkUseCase {

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    override fun byLessonId(lessonId: UUID): Homework? =
        homeworkRepository.findByLessonId(lessonId)

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    override fun byContractId(contractId: UUID, from: Instant, to: Instant): List<Homework> =
        homeworkRepository.findByContractId(contractId, from, to)
}

@Service
class UpdateHomeworkInteractor(
    private val homeworkRepository: HomeworkRepository,
    private val getHomeworkUseCase: GetHomeworkUseCase
) : UpdateHomeworkUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: UpdateHomeworkCommand): Homework {
        val homework = getHomeworkUseCase.byLessonId(command.lessonId)
            ?: throw NotFoundException("Homework", "lessonId=${command.lessonId}")
        command.content?.let { homework.updateContent(it) }
        homeworkRepository.save(homework)
        return homework
    }
}

@Service
class MarkHomeworkCompletionInteractor(
    private val homeworkRepository: HomeworkRepository,
    private val getHomeworkUseCase: GetHomeworkUseCase
) : MarkHomeworkCompletionUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: MarkHomeworkCompletionCommand): Homework {
        val homework = getHomeworkUseCase.byLessonId(command.lessonId)
            ?: throw NotFoundException("Homework", "lessonId=${command.lessonId}")
        homework.markStudentCompletion(command.completed)
        homeworkRepository.save(homework)
        return homework
    }
}

@Service
class ReviewHomeworkInteractor(
    private val homeworkRepository: HomeworkRepository,
    private val getHomeworkUseCase: GetHomeworkUseCase
) : ReviewHomeworkUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: ReviewHomeworkCommand): Homework {
        val homework = getHomeworkUseCase.byLessonId(command.lessonId)
            ?: throw NotFoundException("Homework", "lessonId=${command.lessonId}")
        homework.markTutorReview(command.completed)
        homeworkRepository.save(homework)
        return homework
    }

    private val contractClient: ContractServiceClient
) : CreateLessonUseCase {

    val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: CreateLessonCommand): Lesson {
        val contract = contractClient.getContract(command.contractId)
        if (!contract.isActive)
            throw RuntimeException("РћР±СѓС‡РµРЅРёРµ РЅРµР°РєС‚РёРІРЅРѕ")
        val item = Lesson.create(
            contractId = command.contractId,

            startAt = command.startAt,
            durationMinutes = command.duration,
        )
        val saved = repository.save(item)
        log.info { "Lesson created: id=${saved.id}, contractId=${saved.contractId}, startAt=${saved.startAt}, durationMinutes=${saved.duration.toMinutes()}" }
        eventPublisher.publish(item.pullEvents())
        return saved
    }

            durationMinutes = command.duration,
            status = command.status,
        )
        val saved = repository.save(existing)
        log.info { "Lesson updated: id=${saved.id}, contractId=${saved.contractId}, startAt=${saved.startAt}, durationMinutes=${saved.duration.toMinutes()}" }

        eventPublisher.publish(existing.pullEvents())
        return saved

        eventPublisher.publish(existing.pullEvents())
        return saved

        existing.delete()

        eventPublisher.publish(existing.pullEvents())
    }

<<<FILE path="app\lesson-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\lesson\application\listener\ScheduleCreatedListener.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.lesson.application.listener

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.context.event.EventListener
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.common.contract.dto.ScheduleDto
import ru.teachify.common.contract.event.ScheduleCreatedEvent
import ru.teachify.common.contract.event.ScheduleDeletedEvent
import ru.teachify.common.contract.event.ScheduleUpdatedEvent
import ru.teachify.common.domain.event.DomainEventPublisher
import ru.teachify.common.lesson.event.LessonDeletedItem
import ru.teachify.common.lesson.event.ScheduleLessonsDeletedEvent
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.Lesson
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.repository.GoogleEventRepository
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.repository.LessonRepository
import java.time.DayOfWeek
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.OffsetTime
import java.time.ZoneOffset
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit
import java.util.*

@Component
class ScheduleCreatedListener(
    private val repository: LessonRepository,
    private val googleEventRepository: GoogleEventRepository,
    private val eventPublisher: DomainEventPublisher,
) {

    private val logger = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @EventListener
    @Transactional
    fun onScheduleCreated(event: ScheduleCreatedEvent) {
        val lessons = generateLessons(event.scheduleDto)

        repository.saveAll(lessons)
        val events = lessons.flatMap { it.pullEvents() }
        if (events.isNotEmpty()) {
            eventPublisher.publish(events)
        }

        logger.info { "Created ${lessons.size} lessons for schedule ${event.scheduleDto.id}" }
    }

    @EventListener
    @Transactional
    fun onScheduleUpdated(event: ScheduleUpdatedEvent) {
        handleDeleteScheduleLessons(event.scheduleDto.id)
        
        val lessons = generateLessons(event.scheduleDto)

        repository.saveAll(lessons)
        val events = lessons.flatMap { it.pullEvents() }
        if (events.isNotEmpty()) eventPublisher.publish(events)
        logger.info { "Updated lessons for schedule ${event.scheduleDto.id}, created ${lessons.size} new lessons" }
    }

    @EventListener
    @Transactional
    fun onScheduleDeleted(event: ScheduleDeletedEvent) {
        handleDeleteScheduleLessons(event.scheduleId)
        logger.info { "Deleted lessons for schedule ${event.scheduleId}" }
    }

    private fun handleDeleteScheduleLessons(scheduleId: UUID) {
        val lessons = repository.findAllByScheduleId(scheduleId)
        if (lessons.isEmpty()) return

        val lessonIds = lessons.map { it.id }
        val mappings = googleEventRepository.findAllByLessonIds(lessonIds)
        val mappingsMap = mappings.associateBy { it.lessonId }

        val deletedItems = lessons.map { lesson ->
            LessonDeletedItem(
                lessonId = lesson.id,
                googleEventId = mappingsMap[lesson.id]?.googleEventId
            )
        }

        val contractId = lessons.first().contractId

        repository.deleteAllByScheduleId(scheduleId)

        if (deletedItems.isNotEmpty()) {
            eventPublisher.publish(
                ScheduleLessonsDeletedEvent(
                    scheduleId = scheduleId,
                    contractId = contractId,
                    items = deletedItems
                )
            )
        }
    }

    private fun generateLessons(scheduleDto: ScheduleDto): List<Lesson> {
        val now = Instant.now()
        val until = now.plus(90, ChronoUnit.DAYS)

        return generateSequence(nextOccurrenceFrom(now, scheduleDto.dayOfWeek, scheduleDto.startTime)) { prev ->
            val next = prev.plus(7, ChronoUnit.DAYS)
            if (next.isAfter(until)) null else next
        }.map { startAt ->
            Lesson.create(
                contractId = scheduleDto.contractId,
                scheduleId = scheduleDto.id,
                startAt = startAt,
                durationMinutes = scheduleDto.duration,
            )
        }.toList()
    }

    private fun nextOccurrenceFrom(from: Instant, dayOfWeek: DayOfWeek, startTime: OffsetTime): Instant {
        // Р’РѕР·СЊРјС‘Рј РЅР°С‡Р°Р»Рѕ С‚РµРєСѓС‰РµРіРѕ РґРЅСЏ РІ UTC Рё РЅР°Р№РґС‘Рј Р±Р»РёР¶Р°Р№С€РёР№ РЅСѓР¶РЅС‹Р№ РґРµРЅСЊ РЅРµРґРµР»Рё Рё РІСЂРµРјСЏ
        val date = from.atZone(ZoneOffset.UTC).toLocalDate()
        val targetDow = dayOfWeek
        val currentDow = date.dayOfWeek
        var daysToAdd = (targetDow.value - currentDow.value + 7) % 7
        if (daysToAdd == 0) {
            // РµСЃР»Рё СЃРµРіРѕРґРЅСЏ РЅСѓР¶РЅС‹Р№ РґРµРЅСЊ, РїСЂРѕРІРµСЂРёРј РІСЂРµРјСЏ вЂ” РµСЃР»Рё СѓР¶Рµ РїСЂРѕС€Р»Рѕ, Р±РµСЂС‘Рј С‡РµСЂРµР· РЅРµРґРµР»СЋ
            val startToday = date.atTime(startTime).toInstant()
            if (!startToday.isAfter(from)) {
                daysToAdd = 7
            }
        }
        val startDate = date.plusDays(daysToAdd.toLong())
        return startDate.atTime(startTime).toInstant()
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\lesson-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\lesson\application\scheduler\PendingCompletionScheduler.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.lesson.application.scheduler

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.common.domain.event.DomainEventPublisher
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.LessonStatus
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.repository.LessonRepository
import java.time.Instant

@Component
class PendingCompletionScheduler(
    private val lessonRepository: LessonRepository,
    private val eventPublisher: DomainEventPublisher,
) {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Scheduled(fixedDelayString = "PT1M")
    @Transactional
    fun markPending() {
        val now = Instant.now()
        val candidates = lessonRepository.findAllByStatusAndStartsAtBefore(LessonStatus.SCHEDULED, now)
        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return

        val events = mutableListOf<Any>()

        candidates.forEach {
            it.markPendingCompletion(now)
            events.addAll(it.pullEvents())
        }

        lessonRepository.saveAll(candidates)
        eventPublisher.publish(events)
        log.info { "PendingCompletionScheduler: updated ${candidates.size} lessons to ${LessonStatus.PENDING_COMPLETION}" }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\lesson-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\lesson\domain\model\AvailabilitySlot.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model

import ru.teachify.common.domain.model.base.AggregateRoot
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.error.AvailabilitySlotContactInvalidException
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.error.AvailabilitySlotExpiredException
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.error.AvailabilitySlotNotBookableException
import java.time.Duration
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

class AvailabilitySlot private constructor(
    val id: UUID,
    val tutorId: UUID,
    var startAt: Instant,
    var duration: Duration,
    private var statusInternal: AvailabilitySlotStatus,
    val shareToken: String,
    val createdAt: Instant,
    var bookedAt: Instant?,
    private var contactInternal: BookingContact?,
) : AggregateRoot() {

    val status: AvailabilitySlotStatus
        get() = statusInternal

    val contact: BookingContact?
        get() = contactInternal

    val endsAt: Instant
        get() = startAt.plus(duration)

    fun book(contact: BookingContact, now: Instant = Instant.now()) {
        if (contact.phone.isBlank()) {
            throw AvailabilitySlotContactInvalidException()
        }
        if (statusInternal != AvailabilitySlotStatus.AVAILABLE) {
            throw AvailabilitySlotNotBookableException(id)
        }
        if (now.isAfter(endsAt)) {
            throw AvailabilitySlotExpiredException(id)
        }
        contactInternal = contact
        bookedAt = now
        statusInternal = AvailabilitySlotStatus.BOOKED
    }

    fun cancel() {
        if (statusInternal == AvailabilitySlotStatus.CANCELED) return
        statusInternal = AvailabilitySlotStatus.CANCELED
    }

    companion object {
        fun create(
            tutorId: UUID,
            startAt: Instant,
            duration: Duration,
            shareToken: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", ""),
            status: AvailabilitySlotStatus = AvailabilitySlotStatus.AVAILABLE,
        ): AvailabilitySlot {
            require(duration.toMinutes() > 0) { "Duration must be positive" }
            require(shareToken.isNotBlank()) { "Share token must not be blank" }
            val id = UUID.randomUUID()
            val now = Instant.now()
            return AvailabilitySlot(
                id = id,
                tutorId = tutorId,
                startAt = startAt,
                duration = duration,
                statusInternal = status,
                shareToken = shareToken,
                createdAt = now,
                bookedAt = null,
                contactInternal = null,
            )
        }

        fun fromPersistence(
            id: UUID,
            tutorId: UUID,
            startAt: Instant,
            duration: Duration,
            status: AvailabilitySlotStatus,
            shareToken: String,
            createdAt: Instant,
            bookedAt: Instant?,
            contact: BookingContact?,
        ): AvailabilitySlot {
            return AvailabilitySlot(
                id = id,
                tutorId = tutorId,
                startAt = startAt,
                duration = duration,
                statusInternal = status,
                shareToken = shareToken,
                createdAt = createdAt,
                bookedAt = bookedAt,
                contactInternal = contact,
            )
        }
    }

    data class BookingContact(
        val phone: String,
        val telegram: String?,
    )
}

enum class AvailabilitySlotStatus {
    AVAILABLE, BOOKED, CANCELED
}

package ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model

import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

data class GoogleEvent(

package ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model

import ru.teachify.common.domain.model.base.AggregateRoot
import ru.teachify.common.lesson.event.HomeworkAddedEvent
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

class Homework private constructor(
    val lessonId: UUID,
    private var contentInternal: String,
    val createdAt: Instant,
    private var studentCompletedInternal: Boolean,
    private var studentCompletedAtInternal: Instant?,
    private var tutorReviewResultInternal: Boolean?,
    private var tutorReviewedAtInternal: Instant?,
) : AggregateRoot() {

    val content: String
        get() = contentInternal

    val studentCompleted: Boolean
        get() = studentCompletedInternal

    val studentCompletedAt: Instant?
        get() = studentCompletedAtInternal

    val tutorReviewResult: Boolean?
        get() = tutorReviewResultInternal

    val tutorReviewedAt: Instant?
        get() = tutorReviewedAtInternal

    fun updateContent(newContent: String) {
        contentInternal = newContent.trim()
    }

    fun markStudentCompletion(completed: Boolean, at: Instant = Instant.now()) {
        if (studentCompletedInternal == completed && studentCompletedInternal) {
            studentCompletedAtInternal = at
            return
        }
        studentCompletedInternal = completed
        studentCompletedAtInternal = if (completed) at else null
        if (!completed) {
            tutorReviewResultInternal = null
            tutorReviewedAtInternal = null
        }
    }

    fun markTutorReview(completed: Boolean, at: Instant = Instant.now()) {
        tutorReviewResultInternal = completed
        tutorReviewedAtInternal = at
    }

    companion object {
        fun create(lesson: Lesson, content: String): Homework {
            require(content.isNotBlank()) { "РЎРѕРґРµСЂР¶РёРјРѕРµ РґРѕРјР°С€РЅРµРіРѕ Р·Р°РґР°РЅРёСЏ РЅРµ РјРѕР¶РµС‚ Р±С‹С‚СЊ РїСѓСЃС‚С‹Рј" }
            val now = Instant.now()

            val homework = Homework(
                lessonId = lesson.id,
                contentInternal = content.trim(),
                createdAt = now,
                studentCompletedInternal = false,
                studentCompletedAtInternal = null,
                tutorReviewResultInternal = null,
                tutorReviewedAtInternal = null,
            )
            homework.registerEvent(
                HomeworkAddedEvent(
                    lessonId = homework.lessonId,
                )
            )
            return homework
        }

        fun fromPersistence(
            lessonId: UUID,
            content: String,
            createdAt: Instant,
            studentCompleted: Boolean,
            studentCompletedAt: Instant?,
            tutorReviewResult: Boolean?,
            tutorReviewedAt: Instant?,
        ): Homework = Homework(
            lessonId,
            content,
            createdAt,
            studentCompleted,
            studentCompletedAt,
            tutorReviewResult,
            tutorReviewedAt,
        )
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\lesson-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\lesson\domain\model\Lesson.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model

import ru.teachify.common.domain.model.base.AggregateRoot
import ru.teachify.common.lesson.event.*
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.error.LessonConfirmationTooEarlyException
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.error.LessonModificationNotAllowedException
import java.time.Duration
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

class Lesson private constructor(
    val id: UUID,
    val contractId: UUID,
    val scheduleId: UUID?,
    var startAt: Instant,
    var duration: Duration,
    private var statusInternal: LessonStatus,
    var colorHex: String?,
    val createdAt: Instant,
) : AggregateRoot() {

    val endsAt: Instant
        get() = startAt.plus(duration)

    val status: LessonStatus
        get() = statusInternal

    fun markPendingCompletion(now: Instant = Instant.now()) {
        require(this.statusInternal == LessonStatus.SCHEDULED) { "РЈСЂРѕРє РґРѕР»Р¶РµРЅ Р±С‹С‚СЊ РІ СЃС‚Р°С‚СѓСЃРµ ${LessonStatus.SCHEDULED}" }
        require(now >= endsAt) { "РЈСЂРѕРє РґРѕР»Р¶РµРЅ Р·Р°РєРѕРЅС‡РёС‚СЊСЃСЏ" }
        this.statusInternal = LessonStatus.PENDING_COMPLETION
        registerEvent(
            LessonPendingCompletionEvent(
                lessonId = this.id,
                contractId = this.contractId,
                startAt = this.startAt,
                duration = this.duration,
            )
        )
    }

    fun changeColor(colorHex: String?) {
        this.colorHex = colorHex
    }

    fun update(
        startAt: Instant? = null,
        durationMinutes: Duration? = null,
        status: LessonStatus? = null,
    ) {
        if (this.statusInternal == LessonStatus.COMPLETED) {
            throw LessonModificationNotAllowedException("РќРµР»СЊР·СЏ РёР·РјРµРЅСЏС‚СЊ Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€С‘РЅРЅС‹Р№ СѓСЂРѕРє")
        }
        if (this.statusInternal == LessonStatus.CANCELED) {
            throw LessonModificationNotAllowedException("РќРµР»СЊР·СЏ РёР·РјРµРЅСЏС‚СЊ РѕС‚РјРµРЅС‘РЅРЅС‹Р№ СѓСЂРѕРє")
        }

        val oldStartAt = this.startAt
        val oldDuration = this.duration
        val oldStatus = this.statusInternal

        startAt?.let { this.startAt = it }
        durationMinutes?.let { this.duration = it }
        status?.let {
            if (it == LessonStatus.COMPLETED) {
                val endsAt = this.startAt.plus(this.duration)
                if (Instant.now().isBefore(endsAt)) {
                    throw LessonConfirmationTooEarlyException(this.id)
                }
                this.statusInternal = LessonStatus.COMPLETED
                registerEvent(
                    LessonCompletedEvent(
                        lessonId = this.id,
                        contractId = this.contractId,
                    )
                )
            } else {
                this.statusInternal = it
            }
        }

        if (oldStartAt != this.startAt || oldDuration != this.duration || oldStatus != this.statusInternal) {
            registerEvent(
                LessonUpdatedEvent(
                    lessonId = this.id,
                    contractId = this.contractId,
                    scheduleId = this.scheduleId,
                    startAt = this.startAt,
                    duration = this.duration,
                    status = this.statusInternal.name
                )
            )
        }
    }

    fun delete() {
        if (this.statusInternal == LessonStatus.COMPLETED) {
            throw LessonModificationNotAllowedException("РќРµР»СЊР·СЏ СѓРґР°Р»СЏС‚СЊ Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€С‘РЅРЅС‹Р№ СѓСЂРѕРє")
        }
        registerEvent(
            LessonDeletedEvent(
                lessonId = this.id,
                contractId = this.contractId
            )
        )
    }

    companion object {
        fun create(
            contractId: UUID,
            scheduleId: UUID?,
            startAt: Instant,
            status: LessonStatus = LessonStatus.SCHEDULED,
            durationMinutes: Duration,
        ): Lesson {
            val id = UUID.randomUUID()
            val now = Instant.now()
            if (status == LessonStatus.COMPLETED) {
                throw LessonConfirmationTooEarlyException(id)
            }
            val lesson = Lesson(id, contractId, scheduleId, startAt, durationMinutes, status, null, now)
            lesson.registerEvent(
                LessonCreatedEvent(
                    lessonId = lesson.id,
                    contractId = lesson.contractId,
                    scheduleId = lesson.scheduleId,
                    startAt = lesson.startAt,
                    duration = lesson.duration,
                    status = lesson.statusInternal.name,
                )
            )
            return lesson
        }

        fun fromPersistence(
            id: UUID,
            contractId: UUID,
            scheduleId: UUID?,
            startAt: Instant,
            durationMinutes: Duration,
            status: LessonStatus,
            colorHex: String?,
            createdAt: Instant,
        ): Lesson {
            return Lesson(id, contractId, scheduleId, startAt, durationMinutes, status, colorHex, createdAt)
        }
    }
}

enum class LessonStatus {
    SCHEDULED, COMPLETED, CANCELED, PENDING_COMPLETION
}

<<<FILE path="app\lesson-service\bin\test\ru\teachify\lesson\domain\HomeworkTest.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.lesson.domain

import org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test
import org.junit.jupiter.api.assertThrows
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.Homework
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.Lesson
import java.time.Duration
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

class HomeworkTest {

    @Test
    fun `student completion marks timestamp and status`() {
        val homework = sampleHomework()

        homework.markStudentCompletion(true)

        assertThat(homework.studentCompleted).isTrue()
        assertThat(homework.studentCompletedAt).isNotNull()
    }

    @Test
    fun `resetting student completion clears tutor review`() {
        val homework = sampleHomework()
        homework.markTutorReview(completed = true, grade = 4)

        homework.markStudentCompletion(false)

        assertThat(homework.studentCompleted).isFalse()
        assertThat(homework.studentCompletedAt).isNull()
        assertThat(homework.tutorReviewResult).isNull()
        assertThat(homework.tutorReviewedAt).isNull()
        assertThat(homework.tutorGrade).isNull()
    }

    @Test
    fun `tutor review requires grade when completed`() {
        val homework = sampleHomework()

        assertThrows<IllegalArgumentException> {
            homework.markTutorReview(completed = true, grade = null)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `tutor review stores grade`() {
        val homework = sampleHomework()

        homework.markTutorReview(completed = true, grade = 5)

        assertThat(homework.tutorReviewResult).isTrue()
        assertThat(homework.tutorGrade).isEqualTo(5)
        assertThat(homework.tutorReviewedAt).isNotNull()
    }

    private fun sampleHomework(): Homework {
        val lesson = Lesson.create(
            contractId = UUID.randomUUID(),
            scheduleId = null,
            startAt = Instant.now().plusSeconds(3600),
            durationMinutes = Duration.ofMinutes(45),
        )
        return Homework.create(lesson, "Solve tasks")
    }
}

package ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.adapter

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.mapper.LessonMapper
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.repository.LessonJpaRepository
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.Lesson
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.LessonStatus
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.repository.LessonRepository
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@Component
class LessonRepositoryAdapter(
    private val repo: LessonJpaRepository
) : LessonRepository {
    override fun findById(id: UUID): Lesson? =
        repo.findById(id).map(LessonMapper::toDomain).orElse(null)

    override fun save(item: Lesson): Lesson =
        LessonMapper.toDomain(repo.save(LessonMapper.toEntity(item)))

    override fun deleteById(id: UUID) {
        repo.deleteById(id)
    }

    override fun saveAll(items: List<Lesson>) {
        if (items.isEmpty()) return
        val entities = items.map(LessonMapper::toEntity)
        repo.saveAll(entities)
    }

    override fun deleteAllByScheduleId(scheduleId: UUID) {
        repo.deleteAllByScheduleId(scheduleId)
    }

    override fun findAllByScheduleId(scheduleId: UUID): List<Lesson> =
        repo.findAllByScheduleId(scheduleId).map(LessonMapper::toDomain)

    override fun findAllByContractIdAndStartBetween(
        contractId: UUID,
        from: Instant,
        to: Instant
    ): List<Lesson> =
        repo.findAllByContractIdAndStartsAtBetween(contractId, from, to)
            .map(LessonMapper::toDomain)

    override fun findAllByStatusAndStartsAtBefore(status: LessonStatus, before: Instant): List<Lesson> =
        repo.findAllByStatusAndStartsAtBefore(status, before).map(LessonMapper::toDomain)

    override fun findAllByContractId(contractId: UUID): List<Lesson> =
        repo.findAllByContractId(contractId).map(LessonMapper::toDomain)
}

import jakarta.persistence.Column
import jakarta.persistence.Entity
import jakarta.persistence.Id
import jakarta.persistence.Table
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@Entity
@Table(name = "homeworks", schema = "lessons")
class HomeworkEntity(
    @Id
    @Column(name = "lesson_id")
    var lessonId: UUID,

    @Column(name = "content", nullable = false, columnDefinition = "TEXT")
    var content: String,

    @Column(name = "created_at", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    var createdAt: Instant,

    @Column(name = "student_completed", nullable = false)
    var studentCompleted: Boolean,

    @Column(name = "student_completed_at")
    var studentCompletedAt: Instant?,

    @Column(name = "tutor_review_result")
    var tutorReviewResult: Boolean?,

    @Column(name = "tutor_reviewed_at")
    var tutorReviewedAt: Instant?,
)

package ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.entity

import jakarta.persistence.*
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.LessonStatus
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@Entity
@Table(name = "lesson", schema = "lessons")
class LessonEntity(

    @Id
    @Column(name = "id", nullable = false)
    var id: UUID,

    @Column(name = "contract_id", nullable = false)
    var contractId: UUID,

    @Column(name = "schedule_id")
    var scheduleId: UUID?,

    @Column(name = "starts_at", nullable = false)
    var startsAt: Instant,

    @Column(name = "duration_minutes", nullable = false)
    var durationMinutes: Long,

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(name = "status", nullable = false)
    var status: LessonStatus,

    @Column(name = "color_hex")
    var colorHex: String?,

    @Column(name = "created_at", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    var createdAt: Instant
)

package ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.mapper

import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.entity.AvailabilitySlotEntity
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.AvailabilitySlot
import java.time.Duration

object AvailabilitySlotMapper {
    fun toEntity(slot: AvailabilitySlot): AvailabilitySlotEntity =
        AvailabilitySlotEntity(
            id = slot.id,
            tutorId = slot.tutorId,
            startsAt = slot.startAt,
            durationMinutes = slot.duration.toMinutes(),
            status = slot.status,
            shareToken = slot.shareToken,
            createdAt = slot.createdAt,
            bookedAt = slot.bookedAt,
            bookedPhone = slot.contact?.phone,
            bookedTelegram = slot.contact?.telegram,
        )

    fun toDomain(entity: AvailabilitySlotEntity): AvailabilitySlot =
        AvailabilitySlot.fromPersistence(
            id = entity.id,
            tutorId = entity.tutorId,
            startAt = entity.startsAt,
            duration = Duration.ofMinutes(entity.durationMinutes),
            status = entity.status,
            shareToken = entity.shareToken,
            createdAt = entity.createdAt,
            bookedAt = entity.bookedAt,
            contact = entity.bookedPhone?.let {
                AvailabilitySlot.BookingContact(
                    phone = it,
                    telegram = entity.bookedTelegram,
                )
            },
        )
}

<<<FILE path="app\lesson-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\lesson\adapter\persistence\repository\adapter\GoogleEventRepositoryAdapter.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.repository

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.mapper.GoogleEventMapper
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.GoogleEvent
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.repository.GoogleEventRepository
import java.util.*

@Component
class GoogleEventRepositoryAdapter(
    private val jpaRepository: GoogleEventJpaRepository
) : GoogleEventRepository {

    override fun findByLessonId(lessonId: UUID): GoogleEvent? {
        return jpaRepository.findByLessonId(lessonId)?.let {
            GoogleEventMapper.toDomain(it)
        }
    }

    override fun save(event: GoogleEvent): GoogleEvent {
        val entity = GoogleEventMapper.toEntity(event)
        val saved = jpaRepository.save(entity)
        return GoogleEventMapper.toDomain(saved)
    }

    override fun deleteByLessonId(lessonId: UUID) {
        jpaRepository.deleteByLessonId(lessonId)
    }

    override fun existsByLessonId(lessonId: UUID): Boolean {
        return jpaRepository.existsByLessonId(lessonId)
    }

    override fun findAllByLessonIds(lessonIds: List<UUID>): List<GoogleEvent> {
        if (lessonIds.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        return jpaRepository.findAllByLessonIdIn(lessonIds).map {
            GoogleEventMapper.toDomain(it)
        }
    }
}

package ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.repository

import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.entity.HomeworkEntity
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@Repository
interface HomeworkJpaRepository : JpaRepository<HomeworkEntity, UUID> {
    fun findByLessonId(lessonId: UUID): HomeworkEntity?

    @Query(
        """
        select h from HomeworkEntity h
        join LessonEntity l on l.id = h.lessonId
        where l.contractId = :contractId
          and l.startsAt between :from and :to
        order by l.startsAt desc
        """
    )
    fun findByContractIdAndInterval(
        @Param("contractId") contractId: UUID,
        @Param("from") from: Instant,
        @Param("to") to: Instant
    ): List<HomeworkEntity>
}

package ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.repository

import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.persistence.entity.LessonEntity
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.LessonStatus
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@Repository
interface LessonJpaRepository : JpaRepository<LessonEntity, UUID> {
    fun deleteAllByScheduleId(scheduleId: UUID)
    fun findAllByScheduleId(scheduleId: UUID): List<LessonEntity>

    @Query(
        """
        select l from LessonEntity l
        where l.contractId = :contractId
          and l.startsAt between :from and :to
        order by l.startsAt desc
        """
    )
    fun findAllByContractIdAndStartsAtBetween(contractId: UUID, from: Instant, to: Instant): List<LessonEntity>
    fun findAllByStatusAndStartsAtBefore(status: LessonStatus, before: Instant): List<LessonEntity>
    fun findAllByContractId(contractId: UUID): List<LessonEntity>
}

package ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web

import jakarta.validation.Valid
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.AvailabilitySlotResponse
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.request.CreateAvailabilitySlotRequest
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.request.toCreateAvailabilitySlotCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.toResponse
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.CancelAvailabilitySlotCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.CancelAvailabilitySlotUseCase
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.CreateAvailabilitySlotUseCase
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.GetAvailabilitySlotUseCase
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.ListAvailabilitySlotsUseCase
import java.util.*

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/availability-slots")
class AvailabilitySlotController(
    private val createAvailabilitySlotUseCase: CreateAvailabilitySlotUseCase,
    private val listAvailabilitySlotsUseCase: ListAvailabilitySlotsUseCase,
    private val getAvailabilitySlotUseCase: GetAvailabilitySlotUseCase,
    private val cancelAvailabilitySlotUseCase: CancelAvailabilitySlotUseCase,
) {

    @PostMapping
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TUTOR')")
    fun create(@RequestBody @Valid body: CreateAvailabilitySlotRequest): AvailabilitySlotResponse {
        val created = createAvailabilitySlotUseCase.execute(body.toCreateAvailabilitySlotCommand())
        return created.toResponse()
    }

    @GetMapping
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TUTOR')")
    fun list(): List<AvailabilitySlotResponse> {
        return listAvailabilitySlotsUseCase.execute().map { it.toResponse() }
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TUTOR')")
    fun get(@PathVariable id: UUID): AvailabilitySlotResponse {
        return getAvailabilitySlotUseCase.execute(id).toResponse()
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TUTOR')")
    fun cancel(@PathVariable id: UUID) {
        cancelAvailabilitySlotUseCase.execute(CancelAvailabilitySlotCommand(slotId = id))
    }
}

package ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto

import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.AvailabilitySlot
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.AvailabilitySlotStatus
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

data class AvailabilitySlotResponse(
    val id: UUID,
    val tutorId: UUID,
    val startAt: Instant,
    val durationMinutes: Long,
    val status: AvailabilitySlotStatus,
    val shareToken: String,
    val bookedAt: Instant?,
    val contact: AvailabilitySlotBookingContactDto?,
)

data class AvailabilitySlotBookingContactDto(
    val phone: String,
    val telegram: String?,
)

data class PublicAvailabilitySlotResponse(
    val startAt: Instant,
    val durationMinutes: Long,
    val status: AvailabilitySlotStatus,
    val isBookable: Boolean,
)

fun AvailabilitySlot.toResponse(): AvailabilitySlotResponse =
    AvailabilitySlotResponse(
        id = id,
        tutorId = tutorId,
        startAt = startAt,
        durationMinutes = duration.toMinutes(),
        status = status,
        shareToken = shareToken,
        bookedAt = bookedAt,
        contact = contact?.let {
            AvailabilitySlotBookingContactDto(
                phone = it.phone,
                telegram = it.telegram,
            )
        },
    )

fun AvailabilitySlot.toPublicResponse(): PublicAvailabilitySlotResponse =
    PublicAvailabilitySlotResponse(
        startAt = startAt,
        durationMinutes = duration.toMinutes(),
        status = status,
        isBookable = status == AvailabilitySlotStatus.AVAILABLE,
    )

<<<FILE path="app\lesson-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\lesson\adapter\web\HomeworkController.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web

import jakarta.validation.Valid
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.HomeworkResponse
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.request.*
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.toResponse
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.AddHomeworkCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.*
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/homeworks")
class HomeworkController(
    private val getHomeworkUseCase: GetHomeworkUseCase,
    private val addHomeworkUseCase: AddHomeworkUseCase,
    private val updateHomeworkUseCase: UpdateHomeworkUseCase,
    private val markHomeworkCompletionUseCase: MarkHomeworkCompletionUseCase,
    private val reviewHomeworkUseCase: ReviewHomeworkUseCase,
) {

    @GetMapping("/by-lesson/{lessonId}")
    fun getHomework(
        @PathVariable lessonId: UUID
    ): HomeworkResponse? {
        return getHomeworkUseCase.byLessonId(lessonId)?.toResponse()
    }

    @GetMapping("/by-contract/{contractId}")
    fun getHomeworkByContract(
        @PathVariable contractId: UUID,
        @RequestParam from: Instant,
        @RequestParam to: Instant,
    ): List<HomeworkResponse> {
        return getHomeworkUseCase.byContractId(contractId, from, to).map { it.toResponse() }
    }

    @PostMapping
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TUTOR')")
    fun addHomework(
        @RequestBody @Valid body: AddHomeworkRequest
    ): HomeworkResponse {
        val command = AddHomeworkCommand(
            lessonId = body.lessonId,
            content = body.content
        )
        val created = addHomeworkUseCase.execute(command)
        return created.toResponse()
    }

    @PatchMapping
    fun updateHomework(@RequestBody request: UpdateHomeworkRequest): HomeworkResponse {
        val updated = updateHomeworkUseCase.execute(request.toCommand())
        return updated.toResponse()
    }

    @PatchMapping("/student-status")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('STUDENT')")
    fun markHomeworkCompletion(@RequestBody @Valid request: MarkHomeworkCompletionRequest): HomeworkResponse {
        val updated = markHomeworkCompletionUseCase.execute(request.toCommand())
        return updated.toResponse()
    }

    @PatchMapping("/tutor-review")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TUTOR')")
    fun reviewHomework(@RequestBody @Valid request: ReviewHomeworkRequest): HomeworkResponse {
        val updated = reviewHomeworkUseCase.execute(request.toCommand())
        return updated.toResponse()
    }
}

package ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web

import jakarta.validation.Valid
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.LessonResponse
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.request.ChangeLessonColorRequest
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.request.CreateLessonRequest
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.request.UpdateLessonRequest
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.request.toCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.toResponse
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.ChangeLessonColorCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.UpdateLessonCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.*
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.Lesson
import java.time.Duration
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/lessons")
class LessonController(
    private val createUseCase: CreateLessonUseCase,
    private val updateUseCase: UpdateLessonUseCase,
    private val deleteUseCase: DeleteLessonUseCase,
    private val getLessonUseCase: GetLessonUseCase,
    private val changeColorUseCase: ChangeLessonColorUseCase,
    private val getHomeworkUseCase: GetHomeworkUseCase,
) {

    @PostMapping
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TUTOR')")
    fun create(@RequestBody @Valid body: CreateLessonRequest): LessonResponse {
        val command = body.toCommand()
        val created: Lesson = createUseCase.execute(command)
        return created.toResponse()
    }

    @PatchMapping("/{id}")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TUTOR')")
    fun update(
        @PathVariable id: UUID,
        @RequestBody @Valid body: UpdateLessonRequest
    ): LessonResponse {
        val command = UpdateLessonCommand(
            startAt = body.startAt,
            duration = body.durationMinutes?.let { Duration.ofMinutes(it) },
            status = body.status,
        )
        val updated = updateUseCase.execute(id, command)
        return updated.toResponse()
    }

    @PatchMapping("/{id}/color")
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TUTOR')")
    fun changeColor(
        @PathVariable id: UUID,
        @RequestBody body: ChangeLessonColorRequest
    ): LessonResponse {
        val updated = changeColorUseCase.execute(id, ChangeLessonColorCommand(colorHex = body.colorHex))
        return updated.toResponse()
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{id}")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    @PreAuthorize("hasRole('TUTOR')")
    fun delete(@PathVariable id: UUID) {
        deleteUseCase.execute(id)
    }

    @GetMapping("/by-contract/{contractId}")
    fun list(
        @PathVariable contractId: UUID,
        @RequestParam("from") from: Instant,
        @RequestParam("to") to: Instant,
    ): List<LessonResponse> {
        val lessons = getLessonUseCase.allByContractId(contractId, from, to)
        return lessons.map {
            it.toResponse(
                getHomeworkUseCase.byLessonId(it.id)?.toResponse()
            )
        }
    }

    @GetMapping("/{lessonId}")
    fun getLesson(
        @PathVariable lessonId: UUID
    ): LessonResponse = getLessonUseCase.byId(lessonId)
        .toResponse(getHomeworkUseCase.byLessonId(lessonId)?.toResponse())
}

package ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web

import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.GoogleEventMappingResponse
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.request.StoreGoogleEventMappingRequest
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.CleanupGoogleEventsUseCase
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.DeleteGoogleEventMappingUseCase
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.GetGoogleEventMappingUseCase
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.StoreGoogleEventMappingUseCase
import java.util.*

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/internal/lessons")
class LessonInternalController(
    private val getMapping: GetGoogleEventMappingUseCase,
    private val storeMapping: StoreGoogleEventMappingUseCase,
    private val deleteMapping: DeleteGoogleEventMappingUseCase,
    private val cleanupMapping: CleanupGoogleEventsUseCase
) {

    @GetMapping("/{lessonId}/google-event")
    fun getGoogleEventMapping(@PathVariable lessonId: UUID): GoogleEventMappingResponse? {
        val mapping = getMapping.execute(lessonId) ?: return null
        return GoogleEventMappingResponse(
            lessonId = mapping.lessonId,
            googleEventId = mapping.googleEventId,
            createdAt = mapping.createdAt,
            updatedAt = mapping.updatedAt
        )
    }

    @PostMapping("/{lessonId}/google-event")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    fun storeGoogleEventMapping(
        @PathVariable lessonId: UUID,
        @RequestBody request: StoreGoogleEventMappingRequest
    ): GoogleEventMappingResponse {
        val mapping = storeMapping.execute(lessonId, request.googleEventId)
        return GoogleEventMappingResponse(
            lessonId = mapping.lessonId,
            googleEventId = mapping.googleEventId,
            createdAt = mapping.createdAt,
            updatedAt = mapping.updatedAt
        )
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/{lessonId}/google-event")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    fun deleteGoogleEventMapping(@PathVariable lessonId: UUID) {
        deleteMapping.execute(lessonId)
    }

    @DeleteMapping("/google-events/cleanup")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    fun cleanupGoogleEvents(@RequestParam userId: UUID) {
        cleanupMapping.execute(userId)
    }
}

package ru.teachify.lesson.application.interactor

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.common.domain.error.NotFoundException
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.BookAvailabilitySlotCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.CancelAvailabilitySlotCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.CreateAvailabilitySlotCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.*
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.AvailabilitySlot
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.AvailabilitySlotStatus
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.repository.AvailabilitySlotRepository
import ru.teachify.security.UserProvider
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*
import kotlin.random.Random

private val logger = KotlinLogging.logger {}

@Service
class CreateAvailabilitySlotInteractor(
    private val repository: AvailabilitySlotRepository,
    private val userProvider: UserProvider,
) : CreateAvailabilitySlotUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: CreateAvailabilitySlotCommand): AvailabilitySlot {
        val tutorId = userProvider.getCurrentUserId()
        val slot = AvailabilitySlot.create(
            tutorId = tutorId,
            startAt = command.startAt,
            duration = command.duration,
            shareToken = generateShareToken(),
        )
        val saved = repository.save(slot)
        logger.info { "Availability slot created: id=${saved.id}, tutorId=${saved.tutorId}, startAt=${saved.startAt}" }
        return saved
    }

    private fun generateShareToken(): String {
        val alphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"
        return buildString(12) {
            repeat(12) {
                append(alphabet[Random.nextInt(alphabet.length)])
            }
        }
    }
}

@Service
class ListAvailabilitySlotsInteractor(
    private val repository: AvailabilitySlotRepository,
    private val userProvider: UserProvider,
) : ListAvailabilitySlotsUseCase {

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    override fun execute(): List<AvailabilitySlot> {
        val tutorId = userProvider.getCurrentUserId()
        return repository.findAllByTutorId(tutorId)
    }
}

@Service
class GetAvailabilitySlotInteractor(
    private val repository: AvailabilitySlotRepository,
    private val userProvider: UserProvider,
) : GetAvailabilitySlotUseCase {

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    override fun execute(id: UUID): AvailabilitySlot {
        val tutorId = userProvider.getCurrentUserId()
        val slot = repository.findById(id) ?: throw NotFoundException("AvailabilitySlot", "id=$id")
        if (slot.tutorId != tutorId) {
            throw NotFoundException("AvailabilitySlot", "id=$id")
        }
        return slot
    }
}

@Service
class CancelAvailabilitySlotInteractor(
    private val repository: AvailabilitySlotRepository,
    private val getAvailabilitySlotUseCase: GetAvailabilitySlotUseCase,
) : CancelAvailabilitySlotUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: CancelAvailabilitySlotCommand) {
        val slot = getAvailabilitySlotUseCase.execute(command.slotId)
        slot.cancel()
        repository.save(slot)
        logger.info { "Availability slot canceled: id=${slot.id}" }
    }
}

@Service
class GetAvailabilitySlotByTokenInteractor(
    private val repository: AvailabilitySlotRepository,
) : GetAvailabilitySlotByTokenUseCase {

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    override fun execute(token: String): AvailabilitySlot {
        val slot = repository.findByShareToken(token)
            ?: throw NotFoundException("AvailabilitySlot", "token=$token")
        if (slot.status == AvailabilitySlotStatus.CANCELED) {
            throw NotFoundException("AvailabilitySlot", "token=$token")
        }
        return slot
    }
}

@Service
class BookAvailabilitySlotInteractor(
    private val repository: AvailabilitySlotRepository,
    private val getAvailabilitySlotByTokenUseCase: GetAvailabilitySlotByTokenUseCase,
) : BookAvailabilitySlotUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: BookAvailabilitySlotCommand): AvailabilitySlot {
        val slot = getAvailabilitySlotByTokenUseCase.execute(command.shareToken)
        slot.book(
            AvailabilitySlot.BookingContact(
                phone = command.phone,
                telegram = command.telegram,
            ),
            now = Instant.now(),
        )
        val saved = repository.save(slot)
        logger.info { "Availability slot booked: id=${saved.id}, token=${saved.shareToken}" }
        return saved
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\lesson-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\lesson\application\interactor\CleanupGoogleEventsInteractor.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.lesson.application.interactor

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.common.client.ContractServiceClient
import ru.teachify.common.client.UserServiceClient
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.CleanupGoogleEventsUseCase
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.repository.GoogleEventRepository
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.repository.LessonRepository
import java.util.*

@Service
class CleanupGoogleEventsInteractor(
    private val googleEventRepository: GoogleEventRepository,
    private val lessonRepository: LessonRepository,
    private val contractServiceClient: ContractServiceClient,
    private val userServiceClient: UserServiceClient
) : CleanupGoogleEventsUseCase {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(userId: UUID) {
        log.info { "Cleaning up Google event mappings for user=$userId" }

        try {
            val user = userServiceClient.getUser(userId)
            val profile = user.activeProfile ?: run {
                log.debug { "No active profile for user=$userId, skipping cleanup" }
                return
            }

            val contracts = contractServiceClient.getByPerformer(profile.id)
            if (contracts.isEmpty()) {
                log.debug { "No active teaching contracts for user=$userId, nothing to clean up" }
                return
            }

            var deletedCount = 0
            contracts.forEach { contract ->
                val lessons = lessonRepository.findAllByContractId(contract.id)
                lessons.forEach { lesson ->
                    if (googleEventRepository.existsByLessonId(lesson.id)) {
                        googleEventRepository.deleteByLessonId(lesson.id)
                        deletedCount++
                    }
                }
            }

            if (deletedCount > 0) {
                log.info { "Cleaned up $deletedCount Google event mappings for user=$userId" }
            } else {
                log.debug { "No Google event mappings found to clean up for user=$userId" }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            log.error(e) { "Failed to cleanup Google event mappings for user=$userId" }
            throw e
        }
    }
}

package ru.teachify.lesson.application.interactor

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.DeleteGoogleEventMappingUseCase
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.GetGoogleEventMappingUseCase
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.usecase.StoreGoogleEventMappingUseCase
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.GoogleEvent
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.repository.GoogleEventRepository
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@Service
class GetGoogleEventMappingInteractor(
    private val repository: GoogleEventRepository
) : GetGoogleEventMappingUseCase {

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    override fun execute(lessonId: UUID): GoogleEvent? {
        return repository.findByLessonId(lessonId)
    }
}

@Service
class StoreGoogleEventMappingInteractor(
    private val repository: GoogleEventRepository
) : StoreGoogleEventMappingUseCase {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(lessonId: UUID, googleEventId: String): GoogleEvent {
        val existing = repository.findByLessonId(lessonId)

        val event = if (existing != null) {
            log.debug { "Updating Google event mapping for lesson=$lessonId" }
            existing.copy(
                googleEventId = googleEventId,
                updatedAt = Instant.now()
            )
        } else {
            log.debug { "Creating Google event mapping for lesson=$lessonId" }
            val now = Instant.now()
            GoogleEvent(
                lessonId = lessonId,
                googleEventId = googleEventId,
                createdAt = now,
                updatedAt = now
            )
        }

        return repository.save(event)
    }
}

@Service
class DeleteGoogleEventMappingInteractor(
    private val repository: GoogleEventRepository
) : DeleteGoogleEventMappingUseCase {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(lessonId: UUID) {
        log.debug { "Deleting Google event mapping for lesson=$lessonId" }
        repository.deleteByLessonId(lessonId)
    }
}

package ru.teachify.lesson.application.interactor

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.common.domain.error.NotFoundException
import ru.teachify.common.domain.event.DomainEventPublisher
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.AddHomeworkCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.MarkHomeworkCompletionCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.ReviewHomeworkCommand
import ru.teachify.lesson.application.dto.UpdateHomeworkCommand

import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.Homework
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.repository.HomeworkRepository
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@Service
class AddHomeworkInteractor(
    private val homeworkRepository: HomeworkRepository,
    private val eventPublisher: DomainEventPublisher,
    private val getLesson: GetLessonUseCase
) : AddHomeworkUseCase {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: AddHomeworkCommand): Homework {
        val lesson = getLesson.byId(command.lessonId)

        if (homeworkRepository.findByLessonId(command.lessonId) != null) {
            throw IllegalArgumentException("Homework for lesson ${command.lessonId} already exists")
        }
        val homework = Homework.create(lesson, command.content)
        val saved = homeworkRepository.save(homework)

        log.info { "Homework added: lessonId=${saved.lessonId}" }
        eventPublisher.publish(homework.pullEvents())
        return saved
    }
}

@Service
class GetHomeworkInteractor(
    private val homeworkRepository: HomeworkRepository,
) : GetHomeworkUseCase {

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    override fun byLessonId(lessonId: UUID): Homework? =
        homeworkRepository.findByLessonId(lessonId)

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    override fun byContractId(contractId: UUID, from: Instant, to: Instant): List<Homework> =
        homeworkRepository.findByContractId(contractId, from, to)
}

@Service
class UpdateHomeworkInteractor(
    private val homeworkRepository: HomeworkRepository,
    private val getHomeworkUseCase: GetHomeworkUseCase
) : UpdateHomeworkUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: UpdateHomeworkCommand): Homework {
        val homework = getHomeworkUseCase.byLessonId(command.lessonId)
            ?: throw NotFoundException("Homework", "lessonId=${command.lessonId}")
        command.content?.let { homework.updateContent(it) }
        homeworkRepository.save(homework)
        return homework
    }
}

@Service
class MarkHomeworkCompletionInteractor(
    private val homeworkRepository: HomeworkRepository,
    private val getHomeworkUseCase: GetHomeworkUseCase
) : MarkHomeworkCompletionUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: MarkHomeworkCompletionCommand): Homework {
        val homework = getHomeworkUseCase.byLessonId(command.lessonId)
            ?: throw NotFoundException("Homework", "lessonId=${command.lessonId}")
        homework.markStudentCompletion(command.completed)
        homeworkRepository.save(homework)
        return homework
    }
}

@Service
class ReviewHomeworkInteractor(
    private val homeworkRepository: HomeworkRepository,
    private val getHomeworkUseCase: GetHomeworkUseCase
) : ReviewHomeworkUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: ReviewHomeworkCommand): Homework {
        val homework = getHomeworkUseCase.byLessonId(command.lessonId)
            ?: throw NotFoundException("Homework", "lessonId=${command.lessonId}")
        homework.markTutorReview(command.completed)
        homeworkRepository.save(homework)
        return homework
    }
}

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service

    private val contractClient: ContractServiceClient

    override fun execute(command: CreateLessonCommand): Lesson {
        val contract = contractClient.getContract(command.contractId)

        val item = Lesson.create(
            contractId = command.contractId,

@Service
class GetLessonInteractor(
    private val repository: LessonRepository
) : GetLessonUseCase {

    override fun byId(id: UUID): Lesson {
        val lesson = repository.findById(id)
            ?: throw NotFoundException("Lesson", "id=$id")

        return lesson
    }

    override fun allByContractId(
        contractId: UUID,
        from: Instant,
        to: Instant
    ): List<Lesson> {
        return repository.findAllByContractIdAndStartBetween(contractId, from, to)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\lesson-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\lesson\application\listener\ScheduleCreatedListener.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.lesson.application.listener

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.context.event.EventListener
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.common.contract.dto.ScheduleDto
import ru.teachify.common.contract.event.ScheduleCreatedEvent
import ru.teachify.common.contract.event.ScheduleDeletedEvent
import ru.teachify.common.contract.event.ScheduleUpdatedEvent
import ru.teachify.common.domain.event.DomainEventPublisher
import ru.teachify.common.lesson.event.LessonDeletedItem
import ru.teachify.common.lesson.event.ScheduleLessonsDeletedEvent
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.Lesson
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.repository.GoogleEventRepository
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.repository.LessonRepository
import java.time.DayOfWeek
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.OffsetTime
import java.time.ZoneOffset
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit
import java.util.*

@Component
class ScheduleCreatedListener(
    private val repository: LessonRepository,
    private val googleEventRepository: GoogleEventRepository,
    private val eventPublisher: DomainEventPublisher,
) {

    private val logger = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @EventListener
    @Transactional
    fun onScheduleCreated(event: ScheduleCreatedEvent) {
        val lessons = generateLessons(event.scheduleDto)

        repository.saveAll(lessons)
        val events = lessons.flatMap { it.pullEvents() }
        if (events.isNotEmpty()) {
            eventPublisher.publish(events)
        }

        logger.info { "Created ${lessons.size} lessons for schedule ${event.scheduleDto.id}" }
    }

    @EventListener
    @Transactional
    fun onScheduleUpdated(event: ScheduleUpdatedEvent) {
        handleDeleteScheduleLessons(event.scheduleDto.id)
        
        val lessons = generateLessons(event.scheduleDto)

        repository.saveAll(lessons)
        val events = lessons.flatMap { it.pullEvents() }
        if (events.isNotEmpty()) eventPublisher.publish(events)
        logger.info { "Updated lessons for schedule ${event.scheduleDto.id}, created ${lessons.size} new lessons" }
    }

    @EventListener
    @Transactional
    fun onScheduleDeleted(event: ScheduleDeletedEvent) {
        handleDeleteScheduleLessons(event.scheduleId)
        logger.info { "Deleted lessons for schedule ${event.scheduleId}" }
    }

    private fun handleDeleteScheduleLessons(scheduleId: UUID) {
        val lessons = repository.findAllByScheduleId(scheduleId)
        if (lessons.isEmpty()) return

        val lessonIds = lessons.map { it.id }
        val mappings = googleEventRepository.findAllByLessonIds(lessonIds)
        val mappingsMap = mappings.associateBy { it.lessonId }

        val deletedItems = lessons.map { lesson ->
            LessonDeletedItem(
                lessonId = lesson.id,
                googleEventId = mappingsMap[lesson.id]?.googleEventId
            )
        }

        val contractId = lessons.first().contractId

        repository.deleteAllByScheduleId(scheduleId)

        if (deletedItems.isNotEmpty()) {
            eventPublisher.publish(
                ScheduleLessonsDeletedEvent(
                    scheduleId = scheduleId,
                    contractId = contractId,
                    items = deletedItems
                )
            )
        }
    }

    private fun generateLessons(scheduleDto: ScheduleDto): List<Lesson> {
        val now = Instant.now()
        val until = now.plus(90, ChronoUnit.DAYS)

        return generateSequence(nextOccurrenceFrom(now, scheduleDto.dayOfWeek, scheduleDto.startTime)) { prev ->
            val next = prev.plus(7, ChronoUnit.DAYS)
            if (next.isAfter(until)) null else next
        }.map { startAt ->
            Lesson.create(
                contractId = scheduleDto.contractId,
                scheduleId = scheduleDto.id,
                startAt = startAt,
                durationMinutes = scheduleDto.duration,
            )
        }.toList()
    }

    private fun nextOccurrenceFrom(from: Instant, dayOfWeek: DayOfWeek, startTime: OffsetTime): Instant {
        // Р’РѕР·СЊРјС‘Рј РЅР°С‡Р°Р»Рѕ С‚РµРєСѓС‰РµРіРѕ РґРЅСЏ РІ UTC Рё РЅР°Р№РґС‘Рј Р±Р»РёР¶Р°Р№С€РёР№ РЅСѓР¶РЅС‹Р№ РґРµРЅСЊ РЅРµРґРµР»Рё Рё РІСЂРµРјСЏ
        val date = from.atZone(ZoneOffset.UTC).toLocalDate()
        val targetDow = dayOfWeek
        val currentDow = date.dayOfWeek
        var daysToAdd = (targetDow.value - currentDow.value + 7) % 7
        if (daysToAdd == 0) {
            // РµСЃР»Рё СЃРµРіРѕРґРЅСЏ РЅСѓР¶РЅС‹Р№ РґРµРЅСЊ, РїСЂРѕРІРµСЂРёРј РІСЂРµРјСЏ вЂ” РµСЃР»Рё СѓР¶Рµ РїСЂРѕС€Р»Рѕ, Р±РµСЂС‘Рј С‡РµСЂРµР· РЅРµРґРµР»СЋ
            val startToday = date.atTime(startTime).toInstant()
            if (!startToday.isAfter(from)) {
                daysToAdd = 7
            }
        }
        val startDate = date.plusDays(daysToAdd.toLong())
        return startDate.atTime(startTime).toInstant()
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\lesson-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\lesson\application\scheduler\PendingCompletionScheduler.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.lesson.application.scheduler

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.common.domain.event.DomainEventPublisher
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.LessonStatus
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.repository.LessonRepository
import java.time.Instant

@Component
class PendingCompletionScheduler(
    private val lessonRepository: LessonRepository,
    private val eventPublisher: DomainEventPublisher,
) {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Scheduled(fixedDelayString = "PT1M")
    @Transactional
    fun markPending() {
        val now = Instant.now()
        val candidates = lessonRepository.findAllByStatusAndStartsAtBefore(LessonStatus.SCHEDULED, now)
        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return

        val events = mutableListOf<Any>()

        candidates.forEach {
            it.markPendingCompletion(now)
            events.addAll(it.pullEvents())
        }

        lessonRepository.saveAll(candidates)
        eventPublisher.publish(events)
        log.info { "PendingCompletionScheduler: updated ${candidates.size} lessons to ${LessonStatus.PENDING_COMPLETION}" }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\lesson-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\lesson\domain\model\AvailabilitySlot.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model

import ru.teachify.common.domain.model.base.AggregateRoot
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.error.AvailabilitySlotContactInvalidException
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.error.AvailabilitySlotExpiredException
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.error.AvailabilitySlotNotBookableException
import java.time.Duration
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

class AvailabilitySlot private constructor(
    val id: UUID,
    val tutorId: UUID,
    var startAt: Instant,
    var duration: Duration,
    private var statusInternal: AvailabilitySlotStatus,
    val shareToken: String,
    val createdAt: Instant,
    var bookedAt: Instant?,
    private var contactInternal: BookingContact?,
) : AggregateRoot() {

    val status: AvailabilitySlotStatus
        get() = statusInternal

    val contact: BookingContact?
        get() = contactInternal

    val endsAt: Instant
        get() = startAt.plus(duration)

    fun book(contact: BookingContact, now: Instant = Instant.now()) {
        if (contact.phone.isBlank()) {
            throw AvailabilitySlotContactInvalidException()
        }
        if (statusInternal != AvailabilitySlotStatus.AVAILABLE) {
            throw AvailabilitySlotNotBookableException(id)
        }
        if (now.isAfter(endsAt)) {
            throw AvailabilitySlotExpiredException(id)
        }
        contactInternal = contact
        bookedAt = now
        statusInternal = AvailabilitySlotStatus.BOOKED
    }

    fun cancel() {
        if (statusInternal == AvailabilitySlotStatus.CANCELED) return
        statusInternal = AvailabilitySlotStatus.CANCELED
    }

    companion object {
        fun create(
            tutorId: UUID,
            startAt: Instant,
            duration: Duration,
            shareToken: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", ""),
            status: AvailabilitySlotStatus = AvailabilitySlotStatus.AVAILABLE,
        ): AvailabilitySlot {
            require(duration.toMinutes() > 0) { "Duration must be positive" }
            require(shareToken.isNotBlank()) { "Share token must not be blank" }
            val id = UUID.randomUUID()
            val now = Instant.now()
            return AvailabilitySlot(
                id = id,
                tutorId = tutorId,
                startAt = startAt,
                duration = duration,
                statusInternal = status,
                shareToken = shareToken,
                createdAt = now,
                bookedAt = null,
                contactInternal = null,
            )
        }

        fun fromPersistence(
            id: UUID,
            tutorId: UUID,
            startAt: Instant,
            duration: Duration,
            status: AvailabilitySlotStatus,
            shareToken: String,
            createdAt: Instant,
            bookedAt: Instant?,
            contact: BookingContact?,
        ): AvailabilitySlot {
            return AvailabilitySlot(
                id = id,
                tutorId = tutorId,
                startAt = startAt,
                duration = duration,
                statusInternal = status,
                shareToken = shareToken,
                createdAt = createdAt,
                bookedAt = bookedAt,
                contactInternal = contact,
            )
        }
    }

    data class BookingContact(
        val phone: String,
        val telegram: String?,
    )
}

enum class AvailabilitySlotStatus {
    AVAILABLE, BOOKED, CANCELED
}

package ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model

import ru.teachify.common.domain.model.base.AggregateRoot
import ru.teachify.common.lesson.event.HomeworkAddedEvent
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

class Homework private constructor(
    val lessonId: UUID,
    private var contentInternal: String,
    val createdAt: Instant,
    private var studentCompletedInternal: Boolean,
    private var studentCompletedAtInternal: Instant?,
    private var tutorReviewResultInternal: Boolean?,
    private var tutorReviewedAtInternal: Instant?,
) : AggregateRoot() {

    val content: String
        get() = contentInternal

    val studentCompleted: Boolean
        get() = studentCompletedInternal

    val studentCompletedAt: Instant?
        get() = studentCompletedAtInternal

    val tutorReviewResult: Boolean?
        get() = tutorReviewResultInternal

    val tutorReviewedAt: Instant?
        get() = tutorReviewedAtInternal

    fun updateContent(newContent: String) {
        contentInternal = newContent.trim()
    }

    fun markStudentCompletion(completed: Boolean, at: Instant = Instant.now()) {
        if (studentCompletedInternal == completed && studentCompletedInternal) {
            studentCompletedAtInternal = at
            return
        }
        studentCompletedInternal = completed
        studentCompletedAtInternal = if (completed) at else null
        if (!completed) {
            tutorReviewResultInternal = null
            tutorReviewedAtInternal = null
        }
    }

    fun markTutorReview(completed: Boolean, at: Instant = Instant.now()) {
        tutorReviewResultInternal = completed
        tutorReviewedAtInternal = at
    }

    companion object {
        fun create(lesson: Lesson, content: String): Homework {

            val now = Instant.now()

            val homework = Homework(
                lessonId = lesson.id,
                contentInternal = content.trim(),
                createdAt = now,
                studentCompletedInternal = false,
                studentCompletedAtInternal = null,
                tutorReviewResultInternal = null,
                tutorReviewedAtInternal = null,
            )
            homework.registerEvent(
                HomeworkAddedEvent(
                    lessonId = homework.lessonId,
                )
            )
            return homework
        }

        fun fromPersistence(
            lessonId: UUID,
            content: String,
            createdAt: Instant,
            studentCompleted: Boolean,
            studentCompletedAt: Instant?,
            tutorReviewResult: Boolean?,
            tutorReviewedAt: Instant?,
        ): Homework = Homework(
            lessonId,
            content,
            createdAt,
            studentCompleted,
            studentCompletedAt,
            tutorReviewResult,
            tutorReviewedAt,

<<<FILE path="app\lesson-service\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\lesson\domain\model\Lesson.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model

import ru.teachify.common.domain.model.base.AggregateRoot
import ru.teachify.common.lesson.event.*
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.error.LessonConfirmationTooEarlyException
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.error.LessonModificationNotAllowedException
import java.time.Duration
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

class Lesson private constructor(
    val id: UUID,
    val contractId: UUID,
    val scheduleId: UUID?,
    var startAt: Instant,
    var duration: Duration,
    private var statusInternal: LessonStatus,
    var colorHex: String?,
    val createdAt: Instant,
) : AggregateRoot() {

    val endsAt: Instant
        get() = startAt.plus(duration)

    val status: LessonStatus
        get() = statusInternal

    fun markPendingCompletion(now: Instant = Instant.now()) {
        require(this.statusInternal == LessonStatus.SCHEDULED) { "РЈСЂРѕРє РґРѕР»Р¶РµРЅ Р±С‹С‚СЊ РІ СЃС‚Р°С‚СѓСЃРµ ${LessonStatus.SCHEDULED}" }
        require(now >= endsAt) { "РЈСЂРѕРє РґРѕР»Р¶РµРЅ Р·Р°РєРѕРЅС‡РёС‚СЊСЃСЏ" }
        this.statusInternal = LessonStatus.PENDING_COMPLETION
        registerEvent(
            LessonPendingCompletionEvent(
                lessonId = this.id,
                contractId = this.contractId,
                startAt = this.startAt,
                duration = this.duration,
            )
        )
    }

    fun changeColor(colorHex: String?) {
        this.colorHex = colorHex
    }

    fun update(
        startAt: Instant? = null,
        durationMinutes: Duration? = null,
        status: LessonStatus? = null,
    ) {
        if (this.statusInternal == LessonStatus.COMPLETED) {
            throw LessonModificationNotAllowedException("РќРµР»СЊР·СЏ РёР·РјРµРЅСЏС‚СЊ Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€С‘РЅРЅС‹Р№ СѓСЂРѕРє")
        }
        if (this.statusInternal == LessonStatus.CANCELED) {
            throw LessonModificationNotAllowedException("РќРµР»СЊР·СЏ РёР·РјРµРЅСЏС‚СЊ РѕС‚РјРµРЅС‘РЅРЅС‹Р№ СѓСЂРѕРє")
        }

        val oldStartAt = this.startAt
        val oldDuration = this.duration
        val oldStatus = this.statusInternal

        startAt?.let { this.startAt = it }
        durationMinutes?.let { this.duration = it }
        status?.let {
            if (it == LessonStatus.COMPLETED) {
                val endsAt = this.startAt.plus(this.duration)
                if (Instant.now().isBefore(endsAt)) {
                    throw LessonConfirmationTooEarlyException(this.id)
                }
                this.statusInternal = LessonStatus.COMPLETED
                registerEvent(
                    LessonCompletedEvent(
                        lessonId = this.id,
                        contractId = this.contractId,
                    )
                )
            } else {
                this.statusInternal = it
            }
        }

        if (oldStartAt != this.startAt || oldDuration != this.duration || oldStatus != this.statusInternal) {
            registerEvent(
                LessonUpdatedEvent(
                    lessonId = this.id,
                    contractId = this.contractId,
                    scheduleId = this.scheduleId,
                    startAt = this.startAt,
                    duration = this.duration,
                    status = this.statusInternal.name
                )
            )
        }
    }

    fun delete() {
        if (this.statusInternal == LessonStatus.COMPLETED) {
            throw LessonModificationNotAllowedException("РќРµР»СЊР·СЏ СѓРґР°Р»СЏС‚СЊ Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€С‘РЅРЅС‹Р№ СѓСЂРѕРє")
        }
        registerEvent(
            LessonDeletedEvent(
                lessonId = this.id,
                contractId = this.contractId
            )
        )
    }

    companion object {
        fun create(
            contractId: UUID,
            scheduleId: UUID?,
            startAt: Instant,
            status: LessonStatus = LessonStatus.SCHEDULED,
            durationMinutes: Duration,
        ): Lesson {
            val id = UUID.randomUUID()
            val now = Instant.now()
            if (status == LessonStatus.COMPLETED) {
                throw LessonConfirmationTooEarlyException(id)
            }
            val lesson = Lesson(id, contractId, scheduleId, startAt, durationMinutes, status, null, now)
            lesson.registerEvent(
                LessonCreatedEvent(
                    lessonId = lesson.id,
                    contractId = lesson.contractId,
                    scheduleId = lesson.scheduleId,
                    startAt = lesson.startAt,
                    duration = lesson.duration,
                    status = lesson.statusInternal.name,
                )
            )
            return lesson
        }

        fun fromPersistence(
            id: UUID,
            contractId: UUID,
            scheduleId: UUID?,
            startAt: Instant,
            durationMinutes: Duration,
            status: LessonStatus,
            colorHex: String?,
            createdAt: Instant,
        ): Lesson {
            return Lesson(id, contractId, scheduleId, startAt, durationMinutes, status, colorHex, createdAt)
        }
    }
}

enum class LessonStatus {
    SCHEDULED, COMPLETED, CANCELED, PENDING_COMPLETION
}

package ru.teachify.lesson.application.listener

import io.mockk.clearMocks

import io.mockk.verify
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test

import java.util.*

class PendingCompletionEventListenerIT {

    private lateinit var rabbitTemplate: RabbitTemplate
    private lateinit var listener: PendingCompletionEventListener

    @BeforeEach
    fun setUp() {
        rabbitTemplate = mockk(relaxed = true)
        listener = PendingCompletionEventListener(rabbitTemplate)
        clearMocks(rabbitTemplate)
    }

    @Test
    fun `listener publishes message`() {
        val event = LessonPendingCompletionEvent(
            lessonId = UUID.randomUUID(),
        )

        listener.onPending(event)

        verify(exactly = 1) {
            rabbitTemplate.convertAndSend(
                "teachify.notifications",
                "lesson.pending_confirmation",
                String()
            )
        }
    }
}
