package ru.teachify.lesson.application.scheduler

import io.mockk.clearMocks
import io.mockk.confirmVerified
import io.mockk.every
import io.mockk.impl.annotations.MockK
import io.mockk.verify
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test
import org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.core.RabbitTemplate
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest
import org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisher
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Import
import org.springframework.test.context.ActiveProfiles
import ru.teachify.common.application.event.SpringDomainEventPublisher
import ru.teachify.common.domain.event.DomainEventPublisher
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.Lesson
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.LessonStatus
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.repository.LessonRepository
import java.time.Duration
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@SpringBootTest
@ActiveProfiles("test")
@Import(SpringDomainEventPublisher::class)
class PendingCompletionSchedulerIT(
) {

    @MockK
    lateinit var lessonRepository: LessonRepository

    @MockK
    lateinit var rabbitTemplate: RabbitTemplate

    @MockK
    lateinit var applicationEventPublisher: ApplicationEventPublisher

    private lateinit var domainEventPublisher: DomainEventPublisher

    @BeforeEach
    fun setUp() {
        clearMocks(lessonRepository, rabbitTemplate, applicationEventPublisher)
        domainEventPublisher = SpringDomainEventPublisher(applicationEventPublisher)
    }

    @Test
    fun `scheduler marks lessons pending and publishes message`() {
        val now = Instant.now()
        val lesson = Lesson.fromPersistence(
            id = UUID.randomUUID(),
            contractId = UUID.randomUUID(),
            scheduleId = null,
            startAt = now.minus(Duration.ofMinutes(65)),
            durationMinutes = Duration.ofMinutes(60),
            status = LessonStatus.SCHEDULED,
            colorHex = null,
            createdAt = now.minus(Duration.ofDays(1))
        )

        every {
            lessonRepository.findAllByStatusAndStartsAtBefore(
                LessonStatus.SCHEDULED,
                any()
            )
        } returns listOf(lesson)
        every { lessonRepository.saveAll(any<List<Lesson>>()) } returns Unit

        val scheduler = PendingCompletionScheduler(lessonRepository, domainEventPublisher)

        scheduler.markPending()

        verify(exactly = 1) { lessonRepository.saveAll(match { it.size == 1 && it[0].status == LessonStatus.PENDING_COMPLETION }) }
        // РџСѓР±Р»РёРєР°С†РёСЏ РґРѕРјРµРЅРЅС‹С… СЃРѕР±С‹С‚РёР№ РґРµР»Р°РµС‚СЃСЏ С‡РµСЂРµР· ApplicationEventPublisher; РїСЂРѕРІРµСЂРёРј, С‡С‚Рѕ РѕРЅ РІС‹Р·С‹РІР°Р»СЃСЏ
        verify(atLeast = 1) { applicationEventPublisher.publishEvent(any()) }

        confirmVerified(lessonRepository)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\lesson-service\src\test\kotlin\ru\teachify\lesson\domain\HomeworkTest.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.lesson.domain

import org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test
import org.junit.jupiter.api.assertThrows
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.Homework
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.Lesson
import java.time.Duration
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

class HomeworkTest {

    @Test
    fun `student completion marks timestamp and status`() {
        val homework = sampleHomework()

        homework.markStudentCompletion(true)

        assertThat(homework.studentCompleted).isTrue()
        assertThat(homework.studentCompletedAt).isNotNull()
    }

    @Test
    fun `resetting student completion clears tutor review`() {
        val homework = sampleHomework()
        homework.markTutorReview(completed = true, grade = 4)

        homework.markStudentCompletion(false)

        assertThat(homework.studentCompleted).isFalse()
        assertThat(homework.studentCompletedAt).isNull()
        assertThat(homework.tutorReviewResult).isNull()
        assertThat(homework.tutorReviewedAt).isNull()
        assertThat(homework.tutorGrade).isNull()
    }

    @Test
    fun `tutor review requires grade when completed`() {
        val homework = sampleHomework()

        assertThrows<IllegalArgumentException> {
            homework.markTutorReview(completed = true, grade = null)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `tutor review stores grade`() {
        val homework = sampleHomework()

        homework.markTutorReview(completed = true, grade = 5)

        assertThat(homework.tutorReviewResult).isTrue()
        assertThat(homework.tutorGrade).isEqualTo(5)
        assertThat(homework.tutorReviewedAt).isNotNull()
    }

    private fun sampleHomework(): Homework {
        val lesson = Lesson.create(
            contractId = UUID.randomUUID(),
            scheduleId = null,
            startAt = Instant.now().plusSeconds(3600),
            durationMinutes = Duration.ofMinutes(45),
        )
        return Homework.create(lesson, "Solve tasks")
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\notification-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\notification\listener\PendingCompletionEventListener.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.notification.listener

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.core.RabbitTemplate
import org.springframework.context.event.EventListener
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import ru.teachify.billing.adapter.web.AccountController
import ru.teachify.common.config.RabbitConfig
import ru.teachify.common.lesson.event.LessonPendingCompletionEvent
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.web.ContractController
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.web.CourseController
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.web.controller.ProfileController
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.web.controller.provider.TelegramProviderController
import java.util.*

data class LessonPendingMessage(
    val lessonId: UUID,
    val telegramId: Long,
    val message: String,
)

@Component
class PendingCompletionEventListener(
    private val rabbitTemplate: RabbitTemplate,
    private val rabbitConfig: RabbitConfig,
    private val profileController: ProfileController,
    private val telegramProviderController: TelegramProviderController,
    private val contractController: ContractController,
    private val courseController: CourseController,
    private val accountController: AccountController
) {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @EventListener
    fun onPending(event: LessonPendingCompletionEvent) {
        val contract = contractController.getContract(event.contractId)
        val performer = profileController.getProfile(contract.performerProfileId)
        val client = profileController.getProfile(contract.clientProfileId)

        val telegramId = try {
            telegramProviderController.getByUserId(performer.userId)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            log.warn { "Performer with profileId=${performer.id} does not have a linked Telegram account. Skipping notification for lesson ${event.lessonId}" }
            null
        }

        if (telegramId == null) {
            return
        }

        val course = courseController.getCourse(contract.courseId)
        val balance = accountController.getAccountByContractId(contract.id).balance
        val payedLessons = balance / contract.price

        val messageText = """
            РЈСЂРѕРє РІ РѕР¶РёРґР°РЅРёРё РїРѕРґС‚РІРµСЂР¶РґРµРЅРёСЏ Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€РµРЅРёСЏ.
            
            РЈС‡РµРЅРёРє: ${client.displayName}
            РљСѓСЂСЃ: ${course.name}
            РћРїР»Р°С‡РµРЅРѕ СѓСЂРѕРєРѕРІ: $payedLessons
        """.trimIndent()

        val message = LessonPendingMessage(
            lessonId = event.lessonId,
            telegramId = telegramId,
            message = messageText
        )

        rabbitTemplate.convertAndSend(rabbitConfig.lessonPendingExchange, rabbitConfig.lessonPendingRoutingKey, message)
        log.info { "Published pending confirmation message for lesson ${event.lessonId}" }
    }
}

package ru.teachify.config

import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration
import org.springframework.core.task.AsyncTaskExecutor
import org.springframework.core.task.support.TaskExecutorAdapter
import java.util.concurrent.Executors

@Configuration
class AsyncConfig {

    @Bean
    fun taskExecutor(): AsyncTaskExecutor {
        val executor = Executors.newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor()
        return TaskExecutorAdapter(executor)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\config\FlywayConfig.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.config

import org.flywaydb.core.Flyway
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.flyway.FlywayMigrationInitializer
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration
import javax.sql.DataSource

@Configuration
class FlywayConfig(
    private val dataSource: DataSource
) {
    @Bean
    fun flywayUsers(): Flyway = Flyway.configure()
        .dataSource(dataSource)
        .schemas("users")
        .defaultSchema("users")
        .locations("classpath:db/migration/users")
        .load()

    @Bean
    fun flywayMigrationInitializerUsers(flywayUsers: Flyway) = FlywayMigrationInitializer(flywayUsers)

    @Bean
    fun flywayContracts(): Flyway = Flyway.configure()
        .dataSource(dataSource)
        .schemas("contracts")
        .defaultSchema("contracts")
        .locations("classpath:db/migration/contracts")
        .load()

    @Bean
    fun flywayMigrationInitializerContracts(flywayContracts: Flyway) = FlywayMigrationInitializer(flywayContracts)

    @Bean
    fun flywayLessons(): Flyway = Flyway.configure()
        .dataSource(dataSource)
        .schemas("lessons")
        .defaultSchema("lessons")
        .locations("classpath:db/migration/lesson")
        .load()

    @Bean
    fun flywayMigrationInitializerLessons(flywayLessons: Flyway) = FlywayMigrationInitializer(flywayLessons)

    @Bean
    fun flywayBilling(): Flyway = Flyway.configure()
        .dataSource(dataSource)
        .schemas("billing")
        .defaultSchema("billing")
        .locations("classpath:db/migration/billing")
        .load()
    
    @Bean
    fun flywayMigrationInitializerBilling(flywayBilling: Flyway) = FlywayMigrationInitializer(flywayBilling)
}

<<<FILE path="app\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\config\RestClientConfig.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.config

import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders
import org.springframework.http.MediaType
import org.springframework.http.client.JdkClientHttpRequestFactory
import org.springframework.web.client.RestClient
import ru.teachify.common.security.AuthPropagationInterceptor
import java.net.http.HttpClient

@Configuration
class RestClientConfig {

    @Bean
    fun restClient(
        builder: RestClient.Builder,
        authPropagationInterceptor: AuthPropagationInterceptor
    ): RestClient {
        val jdkFactory = JdkClientHttpRequestFactory(
            HttpClient.newBuilder()
                .version(HttpClient.Version.HTTP_2)
                .build()
        )

        return builder
            .requestFactory(jdkFactory)
            .requestInterceptor(authPropagationInterceptor)
            .defaultHeader(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_TYPE, MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
            .build()
    }

    @Bean("serviceAccountRestClient")
    fun serviceAccountRestClient(builder: RestClient.Builder): RestClient {
        val jdkFactory = JdkClientHttpRequestFactory(
            HttpClient.newBuilder()
                .version(HttpClient.Version.HTTP_2)
                .build()
        )

        return builder
            .requestFactory(jdkFactory)
            .defaultHeader(HttpHeaders.CONTENT_TYPE, MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
            .build()
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\config\SecurityConfig.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.config

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.method.configuration.EnableMethodSecurity
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.configuration.EnableWebSecurity
import org.springframework.security.config.http.SessionCreationPolicy
import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain
import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter
import ru.teachify.security.JwtAuthenticationFilter

@Configuration
@EnableWebSecurity
@EnableMethodSecurity(prePostEnabled = true)
class SecurityConfig {

    @Bean
    fun securityFilterChain(http: HttpSecurity, jwtAuthenticationFilter: JwtAuthenticationFilter): SecurityFilterChain {
        http
            .csrf { it.disable() }
            .sessionManagement { it.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS) }
            .authorizeHttpRequests {
                it
                    .requestMatchers(
                        "/api/auth/**",
                        "/actuator/**",
                        "/swagger-ui/**",
                        "/v3/api-docs/**",
                        "/swagger-ui.html",
                        "/api/invitations/accept",
                        "/api/public/availability-slots/**"
                    )
                    .permitAll()
                    .requestMatchers("/api/internal/**")
                    .hasRole("SERVICE")
                    .requestMatchers("/api/billing/accounts/adjust-balance")
                    .hasAnyRole("SERVICE", "TUTOR")
                    .anyRequest().authenticated()
            }
            .exceptionHandling {
                it.authenticationEntryPoint { _, response, _ ->
                    response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_UNAUTHORIZED)
                }
            }
            .addFilterBefore(jwtAuthenticationFilter, UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter::class.java)
        return http.build()
    }
}

@Component
class SecurityLoggingFilter : OncePerRequestFilter() {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger { }

    override fun doFilterInternal(
        request: HttpServletRequest,
        response: HttpServletResponse,
        filterChain: FilterChain
    ) {
        log.info { "вћЎпёЏ ${request.method} ${request.requestURI} Auth=${request.userPrincipal?.name}" }
        filterChain.doFilter(request, response)
        log.info { "в¬…пёЏ ${response.status} ${request.requestURI}" }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\handler\GlobalExceptionHandler.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.handler

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity
import org.springframework.web.bind.MethodArgumentNotValidException
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice
import org.springframework.web.method.annotation.MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException
import ru.teachify.common.domain.error.DomainException
import ru.teachify.common.domain.error.NotFoundException
import ru.teachify.common.dto.ErrorResponse
import ru.teachify.common.dto.FieldViolation
import ru.teachify.users.domain.error.CredentialsInvalidException

@RestControllerAdvice
class GlobalExceptionHandler {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @ExceptionHandler(NotFoundException::class)
    fun handleNotFound(ex: NotFoundException, request: HttpServletRequest): ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> {
        log.error(ex) { "Not Found: ${ex.message.toString()}" }
        return buildResponse(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, ex, request)
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(CredentialsInvalidException::class)
    fun handleCredentialsInvalid(ex: CredentialsInvalidException, request: HttpServletRequest): ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> {
        log.error(ex) { "Credentials Invalid: ${ex.message.toString()}" }
        return buildResponse(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, ex, request)
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(DomainException::class)
    fun handleDomain(ex: DomainException, request: HttpServletRequest): ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> {
        log.error(ex) { "Domain error: ${ex.message}" }
        return buildResponse(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, ex, request)
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException::class)
    fun handleMethodArgumentNotValid(
        ex: MethodArgumentNotValidException,
        request: HttpServletRequest
    ): ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> {
        val violations = ex.bindingResult.fieldErrors.map {
            FieldViolation(field = it.field, message = it.defaultMessage ?: "Invalid value")
        }
        val body = ErrorResponse(
            code = "VALIDATION_ERROR",
            message = "Validation failed",
            path = request.requestURI,
            fields = violations
        )
        log.error(ex) { "Validation error: ${ex.message}, violations: $violations" }
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST).body(body)
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException::class)
    fun handleTypeMismatch(
        ex: MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException,
        request: HttpServletRequest
    ): ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> {
        val body = ErrorResponse(
            code = "TYPE_MISMATCH",
            message = ex.message,
            path = request.requestURI
        )
        log.error(ex) { "Type mismatch error: ${ex.message}" }
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST).body(body)
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(Exception::class)
    fun handleOther(ex: Exception, request: HttpServletRequest): ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> {
        log.error(ex) { "Unhandled error: ${ex.message}" }
        return buildResponse(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, ex, request, code = "INTERNAL_ERROR")
    }

    private fun buildResponse(
        status: HttpStatus,
        ex: Exception,
        request: HttpServletRequest,
        code: String? = (ex as? DomainException)?.errorCode
    ): ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> {
        val body = ErrorResponse(
            code = code,
            message = ex.message,
            path = request.requestURI
        )
        return ResponseEntity.status(status).body(body)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\src\main\kotlin\ru\teachify\web\log\RequestLoggingFilter.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.web.log

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter

@Component
class RequestLoggingFilter : OncePerRequestFilter() {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    override fun doFilterInternal(
        request: HttpServletRequest,
        response: HttpServletResponse,
        filterChain: FilterChain
    ) {
        val method = request.method
        val uri = request.requestURI
        val query = request.queryString?.let { "?$it" } ?: ""
        val ip = request.getHeader("X-Forwarded-For")?.split(',')?.firstOrNull()?.trim()
            ?: request.remoteAddr

        log.debug { "HTTP $method $uri$query from IP=$ip" }

        filterChain.doFilter(request, response)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\src\test\kotlin\ru\teachify\security\JwtIntegrationTest.kt" type="kt">>>

 package ru.teachify.security

import io.jsonwebtoken.Jwts
import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys
import org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired
import org.springframework.boot.test.autoconfigure.web.servlet.AutoConfigureMockMvc
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.TestConfiguration
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Primary
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.http.MediaType
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.get
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@SpringBootTest
@AutoConfigureMockMvc
class JwtIntegrationTest @Autowired constructor(
    private val mockMvc: MockMvc,
    private val jwtSettings: JwtSettings
) {

    @TestConfiguration
    class MockRoleResolverConfig {
        @Bean
        @Primary
        fun userRoleResolver(): UserRoleResolver = object : UserRoleResolver {
            override fun resolveRolesForUser(userId: UUID): Set<String> {
                return if (userId.toString().endsWith("1")) setOf("TUTOR") else setOf("STUDENT")
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `tutor role can access tutor endpoint`() {
        val userId = UUID.fromString("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001")
        val token = generateToken(userId)

        val result = mockMvc.get("/api/test-secured/tutor") {
            header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer $token")
            accept = MediaType.TEXT_PLAIN
        }.andReturn()

        assertThat(result.response.status).isEqualTo(HttpStatus.OK.value())
        assertThat(result.response.contentAsString).isEqualTo("ok-tutor")
    }

    @Test
    fun `student role forbidden on tutor endpoint`() {
        val userId = UUID.fromString("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002")
        val token = generateToken(userId)

        val result = mockMvc.get("/api/test-secured/tutor") {
            header(HttpHeaders.AUTHORIZATION, "Bearer $token")
            accept = MediaType.TEXT_PLAIN
        }.andReturn()

        assertThat(result.response.status).isEqualTo(HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN.value())
    }

    private fun generateToken(userId: UUID): String {
        val now = Date.from(Instant.now())
        val exp = Date.from(Instant.now().plusSeconds(3600))
        val key = Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(jwtSettings.secret.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
        return Jwts.builder()
            .subject(userId.toString())
            .issuer(jwtSettings.issuer)
            .issuedAt(now)
            .expiration(exp)
            .signWith(key)
            .compact()
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\tutor-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\tutor\controller\TutorStatsService.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.tutor.controller

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import ru.teachify.common.contract.dto.ContractDto
import ru.teachify.contract.adapter.web.ContractController
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.LessonController
import ru.teachify.lesson.adapter.web.dto.LessonResponse
import ru.teachify.lesson.domain.model.LessonStatus
import ru.teachify.tutor.controller.dto.TutorStatsResponse
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.web.controller.ProfileController
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.web.controller.UserController
import java.math.BigDecimal
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.ZoneOffset
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit
import java.util.*

@Service
class TutorStatsService(
    private val userController: UserController,
    private val profileController: ProfileController,
    private val contractController: ContractController,
    private val lessonController: LessonController,
) {


    fun getStats(userId: UUID, from: Instant, to: Instant): TutorStatsResponse {
        require(!from.isAfter(to)) { "Parameter 'from' must be before or equal to 'to'" }

        val user = userController.getUser(userId)

        val tutorProfileId = profileController.getProfile(user.activeProfile!!.id).id

        val contracts: List<ContractDto> = contractController.getByPerformer(tutorProfileId)

        var plannedLessons = 0
        var completedLessons = 0
        var canceledLessons = 0

        var earned: BigDecimal = BigDecimal.ZERO
        var plannedIncome: BigDecimal = BigDecimal.ZERO

        var totalWorkMinutes: Long = 0

        contracts.forEach { contract ->
            val lessons: List<LessonResponse> = lessonController.list(contract.id, from, to)

            lessons.forEach { lesson ->
                when (lesson.status) {
                    LessonStatus.SCHEDULED -> {
                        plannedLessons += 1
                        plannedIncome = plannedIncome.add(contract.price)
                        totalWorkMinutes += lesson.durationMinutes
                    }

                    LessonStatus.COMPLETED -> {
                        completedLessons += 1
                        earned = earned.add(contract.price)
                        totalWorkMinutes += lesson.durationMinutes
                    }

                    LessonStatus.CANCELED -> {
                        canceledLessons += 1
                        // do not include in workload or income
                    }

                    LessonStatus.PENDING_COMPLETION -> {
                        // РЅРµ РїРѕРґС‚РІРµСЂР¶РґС‘РЅ, РЅРѕ Р·Р°РЅСЏС‚РЅРѕСЃС‚СЊ СѓС‡РёС‚С‹РІР°РµРј
                        totalWorkMinutes += lesson.durationMinutes
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // planned income = earned + income from planned lessons
        val plannedIncomeTotal = earned.add(plannedIncome)

        val days = calculateInclusiveDays(from, to)
        val averageDailyLoadHours: Double = if (days > 0) {
            (totalWorkMinutes.toDouble() / 60.0) / days.toDouble()
        } else 0.0

        return TutorStatsResponse(
            plannedLessonsCount = plannedLessons,
            completedLessonsCount = completedLessons,
            canceledLessonsCount = canceledLessons,
            earnedAmount = earned,
            plannedIncomeAmount = plannedIncomeTotal,
            averageDailyLoadHours = averageDailyLoadHours,
        )
    }

    private fun calculateInclusiveDays(from: Instant, to: Instant): Long {
        val start = from.atZone(ZoneOffset.UTC).toLocalDate()
        val end = to.atZone(ZoneOffset.UTC).toLocalDate()
        return ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(start, end) + 1
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\user-service\bin\main\db\migration\users\V1__init.sql" type="sql">>>

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS users;
SET search_path TO users;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounts
(
    id                 UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    email         VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE,
    password_hash VARCHAR(255),
    timezone           VARCHAR(100),
    is_active     BOOLEAN     NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    current_profile_id UUID,
    created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE profiles
(
    id           UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id      UUID         NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    display_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    profile_type VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    created_at   TIMESTAMPTZ  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

    UNIQUE (user_id, profile_type)
);

    ADD CONSTRAINT fk_users_current_profile
        FOREIGN KEY (current_profile_id) REFERENCES profiles (id)
            ON DELETE SET NULL;

    course_ids UUID[]

);

package ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.adapter

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.mapper.toDomain
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.mapper.toEntity
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.repository.GoogleAccountJpaRepository
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.GoogleAccount
import ru.teachify.users.domain.repository.GoogleAccountRepository
import java.util.*

@Component
class GoogleAccountRepositoryAdapter(
    private val jpaRepository: GoogleAccountJpaRepository
) : GoogleAccountRepository {

    override fun findByUserId(userId: UUID): GoogleAccount? {
        return jpaRepository.findByUserId(userId)?.toDomain()
    }

    override fun findByGoogleId(googleId: String): GoogleAccount? {
        return jpaRepository.findByGoogleId(googleId)?.toDomain()
    }

    override fun save(account: GoogleAccount): GoogleAccount {
        val entity = account.toEntity()
        val saved = jpaRepository.save(entity)
        return saved.toDomain()
    }

    override fun deleteByUserId(userId: UUID) {
        jpaRepository.deleteByUserId(userId)
    }
}

package ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.adapter

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.entity.ProfileEntity
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.entity.ServiceProfileEntity
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.entity.StudentProfileEntity
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.entity.TutorProfileEntity
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.mapper.TelegramAccountMapper
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.mapper.UserPersistenceMapper
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.mapper.toDomain
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.mapper.toEntity
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.repository.ProfileJpaRepository
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.repository.TelegramAccountJpaRepository
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.repository.UserJpaRepository
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.*
import ru.teachify.users.domain.repository.ProfileRepository
import ru.teachify.users.domain.repository.TelegramAccountRepository
import ru.teachify.users.domain.repository.UserRepository
import java.util.*

@Component
class UserRepositoryAdapter(
    private val repo: UserJpaRepository,
    private val userMapper: UserPersistenceMapper,
) : UserRepository {

    override fun existsByEmail(email: String): Boolean = repo.existsByEmail(email)

    override fun findByEmail(email: String): User? = repo.findByEmail(email)?.let(userMapper::toDomain)

    override fun findById(id: UUID): User? = repo.findById(id).map(userMapper::toDomain).orElse(null)

    override fun save(user: User): User = userMapper.toDomain(repo.save(userMapper.toEntity(user)))
}

@Component
class ProfileRepositoryAdapter(
    private val repo: ProfileJpaRepository,
) : ProfileRepository {

    override fun existsByUserIdAndType(userId: UUID, type: Class<out ProfileDetails>): Boolean {
        return when (type) {
            TutorProfileDetails::class.java ->
                repo.existsByUserIdAndType(userId, TutorProfileEntity::class.java)

            StudentProfileDetails::class.java ->
                repo.existsByUserIdAndType(userId, StudentProfileEntity::class.java)

            ServiceProfileDetails::class.java ->
                repo.existsByUserIdAndType(userId, ServiceProfileEntity::class.java)

            else ->
                throw IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported profile type: $type")
        }
    }

    override fun findByUserIdAndType(userId: UUID, type: Class<out ProfileDetails>): Profile? {
        return when (type) {
            TutorProfileDetails::class.java -> {
                val profile = repo.findByUserIdAndType(userId, TutorProfileEntity::class.java)
                    ?: return null
                profile.toDomain()
            }

            StudentProfileDetails::class.java -> {
                val profile = repo.findByUserIdAndType(userId, StudentProfileEntity::class.java)
                    ?: return null
                profile.toDomain()
            }

            ServiceProfileDetails::class.java -> {
                val profile = repo.findByUserIdAndType(userId, ServiceProfileEntity::class.java)
                    ?: return null
                profile.toDomain()
            }

            else -> throw IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported profile type: $type")
        }

    }

    override fun findAllByUserId(userId: UUID): List<Profile> =
        repo.findAllByUserId(userId).map(ProfileEntity::toDomain)

    override fun findById(id: UUID): Profile? = repo.findById(id).map(ProfileEntity::toDomain).orElse(null)

    override fun save(profile: Profile): Profile {
        val entity = profile.toEntity()
        val savedEntity = repo.save(entity)
        return savedEntity.toDomain()
    }
}

@Component
class TelegramAccountRepositoryAdapter(
    private val repo: TelegramAccountJpaRepository
) : TelegramAccountRepository {

    override fun findByUserId(userId: UUID): TelegramAccount? =
        repo.findById(userId).map(TelegramAccountMapper::toDomain).orElse(null)

    override fun findByTelegramId(telegramId: Long): TelegramAccount? =
        repo.findByTelegramId(telegramId).map(TelegramAccountMapper::toDomain).orElse(null)

    override fun save(account: TelegramAccount): TelegramAccount =
        TelegramAccountMapper.toDomain(repo.save(TelegramAccountMapper.toEntity(account)))
}

package ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.entity

import jakarta.persistence.*
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.ProfileType
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

@Entity
@Table(name = "profiles", schema = "users")
@Inheritance(strategy = InheritanceType.JOINED)
@DiscriminatorColumn(name = "profile_type", discriminatorType = DiscriminatorType.STRING)
abstract class ProfileEntity(

    @Id
    @Column(name = "id", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    var id: UUID,

    @Column(name = "user_id", nullable = false)
    var userId: UUID,

    @Column(name = "display_name", nullable = false)
    var displayName: String,

    @Column(name = "created_at", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    var createdAt: Instant,
) {

    abstract val profileType: ProfileType
}

@Entity
@Table(name = "accounts", schema = "users")

    @Id
    @Column(name = "id", nullable = false, updatable = false)

<<<FILE path="app\user-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\users\adapter\persistence\mapper\ProfileMapper.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.mapper

import ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.entity.ProfileEntity
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.entity.ServiceProfileEntity
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.entity.StudentProfileEntity
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.entity.TutorProfileEntity
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.Profile
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.ServiceProfileDetails
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.StudentProfileDetails
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.TutorProfileDetails

fun ProfileEntity.toDomain(): Profile {
    val details = when (this) {
        is TutorProfileEntity -> TutorProfileDetails(courseIds = courseIds, baseColorHex = baseColorHex)
        is StudentProfileEntity -> StudentProfileDetails()
        is ServiceProfileEntity -> ServiceProfileDetails()
        else -> throw IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported entity type: ${this::class.simpleName}")
    }

    return Profile.fromPersistence(
        id = id,
        userId = userId,
        details = details,
        createdAt = createdAt,
        displayName = displayName
    )
}

fun Profile.toEntity(): ProfileEntity {
    return when (details) {
        is TutorProfileDetails -> {
            TutorProfileEntity(
                id = id,
                userId = userId,
                displayName = displayName,
                courseIds = details.courseIds,
                baseColorHex = details.baseColorHex,
                createdAt = createdAt
            )
        }

        is StudentProfileDetails -> {
            StudentProfileEntity(
                id = id,
                userId = userId,
                displayName = displayName,
                createdAt = createdAt
            )
        }

        is ServiceProfileDetails -> {
            ServiceProfileEntity(
                id = id,
                userId = userId,
                displayName = displayName,
                createdAt = createdAt
            )
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\user-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\users\adapter\persistence\mapper\UserPersistenceMapper.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.mapper

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.entity.UserEntity
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.repository.ProfileJpaRepository
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.User

@Component
class UserPersistenceMapper(
    private val profileRepository: ProfileJpaRepository
) {
    fun toDomain(entity: UserEntity): User = User.fromPersistence(
        id = entity.id,
        email = entity.email,
        timezone = entity.timezone,
        passwordHash = entity.passwordHash,
        currentProfileId = entity.currentProfile?.id,
        createdAt = entity.createdAt,
        isActive = entity.isActive
    )

    fun toEntity(domain: User): UserEntity = UserEntity(
        id = domain.id,
        email = domain.email,
        passwordHash = domain.passwordHash,
        timezone = domain.timezone,
        currentProfile = domain.currentProfileId?.let { profileRepository.getReferenceById(it) },
        createdAt = domain.createdAt,
        isActive = domain.isActive
    )
}

package ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.repository

import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.persistence.entity.ProfileEntity
import java.util.*

interface ProfileJpaRepository : JpaRepository<ProfileEntity, UUID> {

    fun findAllByUserId(userId: UUID): List<ProfileEntity>

    @Query("SELECT p FROM ProfileEntity p WHERE p.userId = :userId AND TYPE(p) = :type")
    fun findByUserIdAndType(userId: UUID, type: Class<out ProfileEntity>): ProfileEntity?

    @Query("SELECT COUNT(p) > 0 FROM ProfileEntity p WHERE p.userId = :userId AND TYPE(p) = :type")
    fun existsByUserIdAndType(userId: UUID, type: Class<out ProfileEntity>): Boolean

}

package ru.teachify.users.adapter.web.controller.internal

import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException
import ru.teachify.common.client.GoogleCalendarUpdateRequest
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.web.dto.internal.GoogleAccessTokenUpdateRequest
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.web.dto.internal.GoogleAccountInternalDto
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.web.dto.internal.toInternalDto
import ru.teachify.users.domain.repository.GoogleAccountRepository
import java.util.UUID

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/internal/google-accounts")
class GoogleAccountInternalController(
    private val googleAccountRepository: GoogleAccountRepository
) {

    @GetMapping("/{userId}")
    fun getByUserId(@PathVariable userId: UUID): ResponseEntity<GoogleAccountInternalDto> {
        val account = googleAccountRepository.findByUserId(userId)
            ?: return ResponseEntity.notFound().build()
        return ResponseEntity.ok(account.toInternalDto())
    }

    @PutMapping("/{userId}/token")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    fun updateAccessToken(
        @PathVariable userId: UUID,
        @RequestBody request: GoogleAccessTokenUpdateRequest
    ) {
        val account = googleAccountRepository.findByUserId(userId)
            ?: throw ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Google account not found for user $userId")
        account.updateTokens(
            accessToken = request.accessToken,
            refreshToken = null,
            calendarId = null,
            googleId = null
        )
        googleAccountRepository.save(account)
    }

    @PutMapping("/{userId}/calendar")
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
    fun updateCalendar(
        @PathVariable userId: UUID,
        @RequestBody request: GoogleCalendarUpdateRequest
    ) {
        val account = googleAccountRepository.findByUserId(userId)
            ?: throw ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Google account not found for user $userId")
        account.updateCalendar(request.calendarId)
        googleAccountRepository.save(account)
    }
}

package ru.teachify.users.adapter.web.controller

import jakarta.validation.Valid
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*
import ru.teachify.security.UserProvider
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.web.dto.UserDto
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.web.dto.request.CreateUserRequest
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.web.dto.request.UpdateUserRequest
import ru.teachify.users.adapter.web.dto.toDto
import ru.teachify.users.application.usecase.*
import java.util.*

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/users")
class UserController(
    private val createUser: CreateUserUseCase,
    private val getUser: GetUserUseCase,
    private val userProvider: UserProvider,
    private val getProfileUseCase: GetProfileUseCase,
    private val updateUserUseCase: UpdateUserUseCase,
    private val getUserByInvitationCodeUseCase: GetUserByInvitationCodeUseCase,
) {

    @PostMapping
    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)
    fun createUser(@Valid @RequestBody body: CreateUserRequest): UserDto {
        return createUser.execute(body.email, body.password).toDto()
    }

    @GetMapping("/{userId}")
    fun getUser(@PathVariable userId: UUID): UserDto {
        val user = getUser.execute(userId)
        val activeProfile = user.currentProfileId?.let { getProfileUseCase.execute(it) }
        return user.toDto(activeProfile?.toDto())
    }

    @GetMapping("/me")
    fun getCurrentUser(): UserDto {
        val userId = userProvider.getCurrentUserId()
        return getUser(userId)
    }

    @PatchMapping("/{userId}")
    fun updateUser(@PathVariable userId: UUID, @Valid @RequestBody req: UpdateUserRequest): UserDto {
        val command = UpdateUserCommand(
            userId = userId,
            email = req.email,
            timezone = req.timezone,
        )
        updateUserUseCase.execute(command)
        return getUser(userId)
    }

    fun createEmptyUser(): UserDto {
        val user = createUser.execute(null, null)
        return user.toDto()
    }

    @GetMapping("/by-invite/{code}")
    fun getUserByInviteCode(@PathVariable code: String): UserDto {
        val user = getUserByInvitationCodeUseCase.execute(code)
        return getUser(user.id)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\user-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\users\adapter\web\dto\ProfileDetailsDtoDeserializer.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.users.adapter.web.dto

import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonParser
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.DeserializationContext
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonDeserializer
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.ProfileType

class ProfileDetailsDtoDeserializer : JsonDeserializer<ProfileDetailsDto>() {
    override fun deserialize(p: JsonParser, ctxt: DeserializationContext): ProfileDetailsDto {
        val node: JsonNode = p.codec.readTree(p)

        val typeText = node.get("profileType")?.asText()
            ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Missing 'profileType'")

        return when (ProfileType.valueOf(typeText)) {
            ProfileType.STUDENT -> StudentProfileDetailsDto()
            ProfileType.TUTOR -> {
                val courseIds = node.get("courseIds")?.mapNotNull { it.asText(null) }?.mapNotNull {
                    runCatching { java.util.UUID.fromString(it) }.getOrNull()
                }
                val baseColorHex = node.get("baseColorHex")?.asText(null)
                TutorProfileDetailsDto(courseIds = courseIds, baseColorHex = baseColorHex)
            }
            ProfileType.SERVICE -> ServiceProfileDetailsDto()
        }
    }
}

package ru.teachify.users.adapter.web.dto

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonDeserialize
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.Profile
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.ProfileDetails
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.ProfileType
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.ServiceProfileDetails
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.StudentProfileDetails
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.TutorProfileDetails
import java.util.*

/**
 * DTO for [ru.teachify.users.domain.model.Profile]
 */
data class ProfileDto(
    val id: UUID,
    val userId: UUID,
    val displayName: String,
    val details: ProfileDetailsDto
)

fun Profile.toDto() = ProfileDto(
    id = id,
    userId = userId,
    displayName = displayName,
    details = details.toDto()
)

@JsonDeserialize(using = ProfileDetailsDtoDeserializer::class)
sealed interface ProfileDetailsDto {
    val profileType: ProfileType
}

class StudentProfileDetailsDto : ProfileDetailsDto {
    override val profileType = ProfileType.STUDENT
}

data class TutorProfileDetailsDto(
    val courseIds: List<UUID>? = null,
    val baseColorHex: String? = null,
) : ProfileDetailsDto {
    override val profileType = ProfileType.TUTOR
}

class ServiceProfileDetailsDto : ProfileDetailsDto {
    override val profileType = ProfileType.SERVICE
}

fun ProfileDetailsDto.toDomain(): ProfileDetails {
    return when (this) {
        is StudentProfileDetailsDto -> StudentProfileDetails()
        is TutorProfileDetailsDto -> TutorProfileDetails(courseIds = courseIds, baseColorHex = baseColorHex)
        is ServiceProfileDetailsDto -> ServiceProfileDetails()
    }
}

fun ProfileDetails.toDto(): ProfileDetailsDto {
    return when (this) {
        is StudentProfileDetails -> StudentProfileDetailsDto()
        is TutorProfileDetails -> TutorProfileDetailsDto(courseIds = courseIds, baseColorHex = baseColorHex)
        is ServiceProfileDetails -> ServiceProfileDetailsDto()
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\user-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\users\application\config\ServiceAccountInitializer.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.users.application.config

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value
import org.springframework.boot.ApplicationArguments
import org.springframework.boot.ApplicationRunner
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.ServiceProfileDetails
import ru.teachify.users.domain.port.PasswordHasher
import ru.teachify.users.domain.port.PasswordVerifier
import ru.teachify.users.domain.repository.ProfileRepository
import ru.teachify.users.domain.repository.UserRepository

/**
 * РРЅРёС†РёР°Р»РёР·РёСЂСѓРµС‚ РїР°СЂРѕР»СЊ РґР»СЏ СЃРµСЂРІРёСЃРЅРѕРіРѕ РїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЏ РїСЂРё СЃС‚Р°СЂС‚Рµ РїСЂРёР»РѕР¶РµРЅРёСЏ.
 **/
@Component
class ServiceAccountInitializer(
    private val userRepository: UserRepository,
    private val profileRepository: ProfileRepository,
    private val passwordHasher: PasswordHasher,
    private val passwordVerifier: PasswordVerifier,
    @Value("\${service-account.email}") private val serviceAccountEmail: String,
    @Value("\${service-account.password}") private val serviceAccountPassword: String
) : ApplicationRunner {
    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Transactional
    override fun run(args: ApplicationArguments?) {
        val user = userRepository.findByEmail(serviceAccountEmail) ?: run {
            val errorMsg = "Service account with email '$serviceAccountEmail' not found in database. "
            log.error { errorMsg }
            throw IllegalStateException(errorMsg)
        }

        if (!profileRepository.existsByUserIdAndType(user.id, ServiceProfileDetails::class.java)) {
            val errorMsg = "User with email '$serviceAccountEmail' exists but does NOT have a SERVICE profile. " +
                    "Safety check failed. Password initialization skipped to protect real user account."
            log.error { errorMsg }
            throw SecurityException(errorMsg)
        }

        if (serviceAccountPassword.isBlank()) {
            val errorMsg = "Service account password not configured in 'service-account.password'. " +
                    "Set SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PASSWORD environment variable!"
            log.error { errorMsg }
            throw IllegalStateException(errorMsg)
        }

        if (user.passwordHash != null && passwordVerifier.matches(serviceAccountPassword, user.passwordHash)) {
            log.info { "Service account password is up to date." }
            return
        }

        user.changePassword(serviceAccountPassword, passwordHasher)
        userRepository.save(user)

        log.info { "Service account password updated/initialized for ${user.email} from config." }
    }
}

package ru.teachify.users.application.interactor

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.common.domain.error.NotFoundException
import ru.teachify.users.application.usecase.*
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.Invitation
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.InvitationStatus
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.Profile
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.User
import ru.teachify.users.domain.port.PasswordHasher
import ru.teachify.users.domain.repository.InvitationRepository
import ru.teachify.users.domain.repository.ProfileRepository
import ru.teachify.users.domain.repository.UserRepository
import java.util.*

@Service
class CreateInviteInteractor(
    private val userRepository: UserRepository,
    private val profileRepository: ProfileRepository,
    private val invitationRepository: InvitationRepository,
) : CreateInviteUseCase {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger { }

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: InviteCommand): Invitation {
        val user = User.createEmpty(isActive = false)
        userRepository.save(user)

        val profile = Profile.create(user.id, command.profileDetails, command.displayName)
        profileRepository.save(profile)

        user.selectActiveProfile(profile)
        userRepository.save(user)

        val invitation = Invitation.create(user.id)
        invitationRepository.save(invitation)

        log.info { "Invitation created for user=${user.id} profile=${profile.id}" }
        return invitation
    }
}

@Service
class AcceptInvitationInteractor(
    private val invitationRepository: InvitationRepository,
    private val userRepository: UserRepository,
    private val passwordHasher: PasswordHasher,
    private val getUser: GetUserUseCase,
) : AcceptInvitationUseCase {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger { }

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(code: String, email: String?, password: String?): User {
        val invitation = invitationRepository.findByCode(code) ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Invalid code")

        if (invitation.status != InvitationStatus.PENDING) {
            throw IllegalStateException("Invitation already processed")
        }

        val user = getUser.execute(invitation.userId)
        if (user.isActive) {
            throw IllegalStateException("User is already active")
        }
        val normalizedEmail = email?.trim()?.lowercase()

        normalizedEmail?.let {
            if (userRepository.existsByEmail(normalizedEmail)) {
                throw IllegalStateException("РўР°РєРѕР№ email СѓР¶Рµ Р·Р°СЂРµРіРёСЃС‚СЂРёСЂРѕРІР°РЅ")
            }
            user.updateEmail(normalizedEmail)
        }

        password?.let {
            user.changePassword(password, passwordHasher)
        }

        user.activate()
        userRepository.save(user)

        invitation.accept()
        invitationRepository.save(invitation)

        log.info { "Invitation accepted for user=${user.id} invitation=${invitation.id}" }
        return user
    }
}

@Service
class GetUserByInvitationCodeInteractor(
    private val invitationRepository: InvitationRepository,
    private val getUser: GetUserUseCase
) : GetUserByInvitationCodeUseCase {

    override fun execute(code: String): User {
        val invitation = invitationRepository.findByCode(code)
            ?: throw NotFoundException("Invitation", "code=$code")
        return getUser.execute(invitation.userId)
    }
}

@Service
class GetInvitationByUserIdInteractor(
    private val invitationRepository: InvitationRepository
) : GetInvitationByUserIdUseCase {

    override fun execute(userId: UUID): Invitation {
        val invitation = invitationRepository.findByUserId(userId)
            ?: throw NotFoundException("Invitation", "userId=$userId")
        return invitation
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\user-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\users\application\interactor\LinkGoogleAccountInteractor.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.users.application.interactor

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisher
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.users.application.usecase.FindGoogleAccountByGoogleIdUseCase
import ru.teachify.users.application.usecase.LinkGoogleAccountCommand
import ru.teachify.users.application.usecase.LinkGoogleAccountUseCase
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.GoogleAccount
import ru.teachify.users.domain.repository.GoogleAccountRepository
import ru.teachify.common.google.event.GoogleAccountLinkedEvent

@Service
class LinkGoogleAccountInteractor(
    private val googleAccountRepository: GoogleAccountRepository,
    private val eventPublisher: ApplicationEventPublisher
) : LinkGoogleAccountUseCase {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: LinkGoogleAccountCommand) {
        val existing = googleAccountRepository.findByUserId(command.userId)

        val savedAccount = if (existing != null) {
            val finalRefreshToken = command.refreshToken ?: existing.refreshToken
            existing.updateTokens(command.accessToken, finalRefreshToken, null, command.googleId)
            googleAccountRepository.save(existing).also {
                log.info { "Google account updated for user=${command.userId}" }
            }
        } else {
            val account = GoogleAccount.create(
                userId = command.userId,
                googleId = command.googleId,
                accessToken = command.accessToken,
                refreshToken = command.refreshToken,
                calendarId = null
            )
            googleAccountRepository.save(account).also {
                log.info { "Google account linked for user=${command.userId}" }
            }
        }

        eventPublisher.publishEvent(
            GoogleAccountLinkedEvent(
                userId = savedAccount.userId,
                googleId = savedAccount.googleId ?: command.googleId,
                accessToken = savedAccount.accessToken,
                refreshToken = savedAccount.refreshToken,
                calendarId = savedAccount.calendarId
            )
        )
    }
}

@Service
class FindGoogleAccountByGoogleIdInteractor(
    private val googleAccountRepository: GoogleAccountRepository
) : FindGoogleAccountByGoogleIdUseCase {

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    override fun execute(googleId: String): GoogleAccount? {
        return googleAccountRepository.findByGoogleId(googleId)
    }
}

package ru.teachify.users.application.interactor

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.common.domain.error.NotFoundException
import ru.teachify.users.application.usecase.*
import ru.teachify.users.domain.error.ProfileAlreadyExistsException
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.Profile
import ru.teachify.users.domain.repository.ProfileRepository
import ru.teachify.users.domain.repository.UserRepository
import java.util.*

@Service
class GetProfileInteractor(
    private val profileRepository: ProfileRepository,
) : GetProfileUseCase {
    override fun execute(profileId: UUID): Profile {
        return profileRepository.findById(profileId)
            ?: throw NotFoundException("Profile", "id=$profileId")
    }
}

@Service
class ListProfilesInteractor(
    private val profileRepository: ProfileRepository
) : ListProfilesUseCase {

    override fun execute(userId: UUID): List<Profile> {
        return profileRepository.findAllByUserId(userId)
    }
}

@Service
class SwitchActiveProfileInteractor(
    private val userRepository: UserRepository,
    private val getUser: GetUserUseCase,
    private val getProfile: GetProfileUseCase
) : SwitchActiveProfileUseCase {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger { }

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(userId: UUID, profileId: UUID) {
        val user = getUser.execute(userId)
        val profile = getProfile.execute(profileId)
        user.selectActiveProfile(profile)
        userRepository.save(user)
        log.info { "Switched current profile for user=$userId to profile=$profileId" }
    }
}

@Service
class CreateProfileInteractor(
    private val profileRepository: ProfileRepository,
    private val userRepository: UserRepository,
    private val getUserUseCase: GetUserUseCase,
) : CreateProfileUseCase {

    val log = KotlinLogging.logger { }

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: CreateProfileCommand): Profile {
        val userId = command.userId
        val user = getUserUseCase.execute(userId)
        if (profileRepository.existsByUserIdAndType(userId, command.details.javaClass)) {
            throw ProfileAlreadyExistsException(userId, command.details.javaClass)
        }
        val profile = Profile.create(
            userId,
            command.details,
            command.displayName
        )

        val savedProfile = profileRepository.save(profile)

        if (command.setActive) {
            user.selectActiveProfile(savedProfile)
            userRepository.save(user)
            log.info { "Current profile set for user=$userId to ${savedProfile.id}" }
        }

        log.info { "Profile created: $savedProfile" }
        return savedProfile
    }
}

@Service
class UpdateProfileInteractor(
    private val profileRepository: ProfileRepository,
    private val getProfileUseCase: GetProfileUseCase
) : UpdateProfileUseCase {

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: UpdateProfileCommand): Profile {
        val profile = getProfileUseCase.execute(command.profileId)
        val updatedProfile = profile.update(command.details, command.displayName)
        return profileRepository.save(updatedProfile)
    }
}

            ?: throw NotFoundException("TelegramAccount", "telegramId=$telegramId")

    private val telegramRepo: TelegramAccountRepository,

            telegramId = command.telegramId,

            firstName = command.firstName,
            lastName = command.lastName

        return saved
    }

package ru.teachify.users.application.interactor

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisher
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.common.google.event.GoogleAccountUnlinkedEvent
import ru.teachify.users.application.usecase.UnlinkGoogleAccountUseCase
import ru.teachify.users.domain.repository.GoogleAccountRepository
import java.util.*

@Service
class UnlinkGoogleAccountInteractor(
    private val googleAccountRepository: GoogleAccountRepository,
    private val eventPublisher: ApplicationEventPublisher
) : UnlinkGoogleAccountUseCase {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(userId: UUID) {
        val account = googleAccountRepository.findByUserId(userId)
        if (account != null) {
            if (account.calendarId != null) {
                eventPublisher.publishEvent(
                    GoogleAccountUnlinkedEvent(
                        userId = userId,
                        accessToken = account.accessToken,
                        calendarId = account.calendarId!!
                    )
                )
            }
        }
        googleAccountRepository.deleteByUserId(userId)
        log.info { "Google account unlinked for user=$userId" }
    }
}

package ru.teachify.users.application.interactor

import io.github.oshai.kotlinlogging.KotlinLogging
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
import ru.teachify.common.domain.error.NotFoundException
import ru.teachify.users.application.usecase.*
import ru.teachify.users.domain.error.CredentialsInvalidException
import ru.teachify.users.domain.error.UserAlreadyExistsException
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.User
import ru.teachify.users.domain.port.PasswordHasher
import ru.teachify.users.domain.port.PasswordVerifier
import ru.teachify.users.domain.repository.UserRepository
import java.util.*

@Service
class CreateUserInteractor(
    private val userRepository: UserRepository,
    private val passwordHasher: PasswordHasher
) : CreateUserUseCase {

    val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(email: String?, rawPassword: String?): User {
        if (!email.isNullOrBlank() && userRepository.existsByEmail(email)) {
            throw UserAlreadyExistsException(email)
        }

        val newUser = User.create(
            email = email,
            rawPassword = rawPassword,
            passwordHasher = passwordHasher
        )

        log.info { "User created: email=$email, id=${newUser.id}" }
        return userRepository.save(newUser)
    }
}

@Service
class FindUserByEmailInteractor(
    private val userRepository: UserRepository
) : FindUserByEmailUseCase {

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    override fun execute(email: String): User? {
        return userRepository.findByEmail(email)
    }
}

@Component
class GetUserInteractor(
    private val userRepository: UserRepository
) : GetUserUseCase {
    override fun execute(userId: UUID): User {
        return userRepository.findById(userId) ?: throw NotFoundException("User", "id=$userId")
    }
}

@Service
class VerifyUserCredentialsInteractor(
    private val userRepository: UserRepository,
    private val passwordVerifier: PasswordVerifier
) : VerifyUserCredentialsUseCase {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    override fun execute(email: String, rawPassword: String): UUID {
        val user = userRepository.findByEmail(email)
            ?: throw CredentialsInvalidException()

        if (!passwordVerifier.matches(rawPassword, user.passwordHash)) {
            throw CredentialsInvalidException()
        }

        log.info { "User verified: $email" }
        return user.id
    }
}

@Service
class UpdateUserInteractor(
    private val userRepository: UserRepository,
    private val getUserUseCase: GetUserUseCase,
) : UpdateUserUseCase {

    private val log = KotlinLogging.logger {}

    @Transactional
    override fun execute(command: UpdateUserCommand): User {
        val user = getUserUseCase.execute(command.userId)
        command.email?.let { user.updateEmail(it) }
        user.updateTimezone(timezone = command.timezone)
        userRepository.save(user)
        log.info { "User updated: id=${user.id}" }
        return user
    }
}

package ru.teachify.users.application.service

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service
import ru.teachify.security.UserRoleResolver
import ru.teachify.users.domain.repository.ProfileRepository
import ru.teachify.users.domain.repository.UserRepository
import java.util.*

@Service
class UserRoleResolverImpl(
    private val userRepository: UserRepository,
    private val profileRepository: ProfileRepository
) : UserRoleResolver {

    override fun resolveRolesForUser(userId: UUID): Set<String> {
        val user = userRepository.findById(userId) ?: return emptySet()
        val currentProfileId = user.currentProfileId ?: return emptySet()
        val profile = profileRepository.findById(currentProfileId) ?: return emptySet()
        return setOf(profile.profileType.name)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\user-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\users\domain\model\GoogleAccount.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.users.domain.model

import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

class GoogleAccount private constructor(
    val userId: UUID,
    private var accessTokenInternal: String,
    private var refreshTokenInternal: String?,
    private var calendarIdInternal: String?,
    private var googleIdInternal: String?,
    val linkedAt: Instant
) {

    val accessToken get() = this.accessTokenInternal
    val refreshToken get() = this.refreshTokenInternal
    val calendarId get() = calendarIdInternal
    val googleId get() = googleIdInternal

    fun updateTokens(accessToken: String, refreshToken: String?, calendarId: String?, googleId: String?) {
        this.accessTokenInternal = accessToken
        if (refreshToken != null) this.refreshTokenInternal = refreshToken
        if (calendarId != null) this.calendarIdInternal = calendarId
        if (googleId != null) {
            if (googleIdInternal == null) {
                googleIdInternal = googleId
            } else if (googleIdInternal != googleId) {
                throw IllegalArgumentException("Google account mismatch for user $userId")
            }
        }
    }

    fun updateCalendar(calendarId: String) {
        this.calendarIdInternal = calendarId
    }

    companion object {
        fun create(
            userId: UUID,
            googleId: String,
            accessToken: String,
            refreshToken: String?,
            calendarId: String? = null
        ): GoogleAccount {
            require(!refreshToken.isNullOrBlank()) { "refresh_token is required for initial linking" }
            require(googleId.isNotBlank()) { "googleId is required for linking" }
            return GoogleAccount(userId, accessToken, refreshToken, calendarId, googleId, Instant.now())
        }

        fun fromPersistence(
            userId: UUID,
            accessToken: String,
            refreshToken: String? = null,
            calendarId: String? = null,
            googleId: String? = null,
            linkedAt: Instant
        ): GoogleAccount {
            return GoogleAccount(userId, accessToken, refreshToken, calendarId, googleId, linkedAt)
        }

package ru.teachify.users.domain.model

import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

enum class InvitationStatus { PENDING, ACCEPTED }

class Invitation private constructor(
    val id: UUID,
    val userId: UUID,
    val code: String,
    var status: InvitationStatus,
    val createdAt: Instant,
    var acceptedAt: Instant?
) {

    fun accept(now: Instant = Instant.now()) {
        require(status == InvitationStatus.PENDING) { "Invitation not pending" }
        status = InvitationStatus.ACCEPTED
        acceptedAt = now
    }

    companion object {
        fun create(userId: UUID): Invitation {
            val now = Instant.now()
            return Invitation(
                id = UUID.randomUUID(),
                userId = userId,
                code = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", ""),
                status = InvitationStatus.PENDING,
                createdAt = now,
                acceptedAt = null
            )
        }

        fun fromPersistence(
            id: UUID,
            userId: UUID,
            code: String,
            status: InvitationStatus,
            createdAt: Instant,
            acceptedAt: Instant?
        ): Invitation = Invitation(id, userId, code, status, createdAt, acceptedAt)
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\user-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\users\domain\model\Profile.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.users.domain.model

import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

class Profile private constructor(
    val id: UUID,
    val userId: UUID,
    val displayName: String,
    val details: ProfileDetails,
    val createdAt: Instant
) {

    fun update(newDetails: ProfileDetails, newDisplayName: String?): Profile {
        val displayName = if (newDisplayName != null) {
            require(newDisplayName.isNotBlank()) { "Display name cannot be blank" }
            newDisplayName
        } else {
            this.displayName
        }
        return Profile(id, userId, displayName, newDetails, createdAt)
    }

    val profileType: ProfileType
        get() {
            return when (details) {
                is StudentProfileDetails -> ProfileType.STUDENT
                is TutorProfileDetails -> ProfileType.TUTOR
                is ServiceProfileDetails -> ProfileType.SERVICE
            }
        }

    companion object {
        fun create(userId: UUID, details: ProfileDetails, displayName: String): Profile {
            val id = UUID.randomUUID()
            val now = Instant.now()
            return Profile(id, userId, displayName, details, now)
        }

        fun fromPersistence(
            id: UUID,
            userId: UUID,
            createdAt: Instant,
            details: ProfileDetails,
            displayName: String
        ): Profile {
            return Profile(id, userId, displayName, details, createdAt)
        }
    }
}

<<<FILE path="app\user-service\bin\main\ru\teachify\users\domain\model\User.kt" type="kt">>>

package ru.teachify.users.domain.model

import ru.teachify.common.domain.error.DomainException
import ru.teachify.users.domain.port.PasswordHasher
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.*

class User private constructor(
    val id: UUID,
    private var _email: String?,
    private var _timezone: String?,
    private var _passwordHash: String?,
    private var _currentProfileId: UUID?,
    private var _isActive: Boolean,
    val createdAt: Instant
) {
    val timezone: String?
        get() = _timezone

    val isActive: Boolean
        get() = _isActive

    val passwordHash: String?
        get() = _passwordHash

    val email: String?
        get() = _email

    val currentProfileId: UUID?
        get() = _currentProfileId

    fun changePassword(newRawPassword: String, passwordHasher: PasswordHasher) {
        _passwordHash = passwordHasher.hash(newRawPassword)
    }

    fun updateTimezone(timezone: String?) {
        _timezone = timezone
    }

    fun updateEmail(email: String) {
        _email = email
    }

    fun activate() {
        _isActive = true
    }

    companion object {
        fun create(
            email: String?,
            rawPassword: String?,
            passwordHasher: PasswordHasher,
        ): User {
            val id = UUID.randomUUID()
            val now = Instant.now()
            val hashedPassword = rawPassword?.let { passwordHasher.hash(it) }
            return User(id, email, null, hashedPassword, null, true, now)
        }

        fun createEmpty(isActive: Boolean = true): User {
            val id = UUID.randomUUID()
            val now = Instant.now()
            return User(id, null, null, null, null, isActive, now)
        }

        fun fromPersistence(
            id: UUID,
            email: String?,
            timezone: String?,
            passwordHash: String?,
            currentProfileId: UUID?,
            createdAt: Instant,
            isActive: Boolean = true
        ): User {
            return User(id, email, timezone, passwordHash, currentProfileId, isActive, createdAt)
        }
    }

    fun selectActiveProfile(profile: Profile) {
        if (profile.userId != this.id) {
            throw DomainException(
                errorCode = "PROFILE_NOT_OWNED",
                message = "Profile '${profile.id}' does not belong to user '$id'"
            )
        }
        _currentProfileId = profile.id
    }
}

package ru.teachify.users.application.interactor

import io.mockk.every
import io.mockk.mockk
import io.mockk.verify
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test
import ru.teachify.users.domain.error.UserAlreadyExistsException
import ru.teachify.users.domain.model.User
import ru.teachify.users.domain.port.PasswordHasher
import ru.teachify.users.domain.repository.UserRepository

class CreateUserInteractorTest {

    private val userRepository = mockk<UserRepository>(relaxed = true)
    private val passwordHasher = mockk<PasswordHasher>()
    private val interactor = CreateUserInteractor(userRepository, passwordHasher)

    @Test
    fun `execute creates and saves new user when email not exists`() {
        every { userRepository.existsByEmail("a@b.c") } returns false
        every { passwordHasher.hash("secret") } returns "hashed"
        every { userRepository.save(any()) } answers { firstArg<User>() }

        val user = interactor.execute("a@b.c", "secret")

        assertEquals("a@b.c", user.email)
        assertEquals("hashed", user.passwordHash)
        verify(exactly = 1) { userRepository.save(any()) }
    }

    @Test
    fun `execute throws when email already exists`() {
        every { userRepository.existsByEmail("dup@ex.com") } returns true

        assertThrows(UserAlreadyExistsException::class.java) {
            interactor.execute("dup@ex.com", "pwd")
        }
    }
}
